tei:div.tei:p: sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i gsung thor bu'i rigs dang*/ gang gi thugs sprul gnyis pa rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje dang*/ bzhi pa gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ sku sprul lnga pa nges don chos dbyings rang grol bcas dang*/ chos bdag sgo sprul 'phags pa rgyal mtshan dang phyis byon prañdza gho ṣe sogs kyi mdzad pa'i gsung gi cha shas zegs phran ji snyed phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ 'dir gnam lcags zab chos kyi cha shas su bsdu skrun byas pa'i them byang 'god pa la/ ka) sku gsum bla ma'i gsol 'debs puṇḍa'i phreng ba rtsa gsum gling pas mdzad pa/ kha) hūm̐/ 'og min zhing du kun bzang rdo rje 'chang rtsa gling gyis mdzad pa/ ga) sku gsum bla ma'i gsol 'debs dag snang brgyud pa'i gdung dbyangs rtsa gling gis mdzad pa/ nga) o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs/ ca) e ma/ rgyal kun ngo bo kun bzang snang rtsa gsum gling pas mdzad pa/ cha) o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal gdams gsol 'debs smon lam nyid kyis mdzad pa/ ja) rtsa gsum gling pa'i gsol 'debs khyab bdag 'khor lo nyid kyis mdzad pa/ nya) zhabs brtan gsol 'debs rdo rje'i khri 'phang rtsa gling gis mdzad pa/ ta) smug po lha brag la sogs dang khyad par jo bo gze rgyal sogs gnas kyi gsol 'debs gter ma/ tha) gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i rgyang 'bod e ma ho/ rgyal kun ngo bo nyid kyi gnam lcags thugs sprul gnyis pa mi 'jigs rdo rjes gsung*/ da) brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rin po che'i mchod sdong mi 'jigs gsung*/ na) brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa e ma ho/ srid gsum skye dgu'i mgon gyur mi 'jigs rdo rjes gsung*/ pa) rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje'i gsol 'debs zhal gsung ma/ pha) hrī/ rigs kun khyab bdag theg dgu'i yang rtse mi 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ba) o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i che ba dgu ldan gyi gsol 'debs sgo chen sprul sku 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gsung*/

ma) mi 'jigs rdo rje'i zhabs brtan ārya dhwa dza'i gsung*/ tsa) zhabs brtan smon lam om̐ swa sti/ rab 'byams rgyal kun spyi gzugs ārya dhwa dzas mdzad pa/ tsha) gnam lcags bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs shes rab mkhyen brtses mdzad pa/ dza) rtsa gsum gling pa'i chos bdag bcas pa'i gsol 'debs rags bsdus su bkod pa 'chi med grub pa'i dga' tshal shes rab mkhyen brtses gsung*/ wa) bla na med pa'i yang dag par gyur pa'i mchog chen po/ thugs kyi sgrub pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa bde chen lha yi dga' ston rnam par rol pa/ zha) bla ma rtsa ba'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu/ za) gnubs lo'i brgyud 'dzin kun gyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor dgos 'dod lhug stsol yid bzhin nor mchog /'a) o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i sku phreng lnga pa'i bla sgrub thugs rje'i char rgyun/ ༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i sku sprul lnga pa nges don chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung thor bu'i skor la/ ya) rtsa gsum bla ma sgrub pa'i las byang ye shes snying po rā ga'i phreng ba/ ra) bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs char sprin/ la) bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las: gsang sgrub las byang snying gi thig le/ sha) bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las/ gsang sgrub las byang snying gi thig le'i bdud rtsi lag mchod/ sa) bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las: bskang ba bsdus pa dri med shel phreng*/ ha) bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las: gsang sgrub tshe yi 'khor lo yid bzhin nor bu/ a) rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bsang rig 'dzin o rgyan padma 'byung gnas mi 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ki) rtsa gsum gling pas mdzad pa'i mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i bsang*/ khu) dpal ldan lha mo'i bsang mchod mi 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ge) thugs sprul gsum pa gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i drang srong gza' yi bsang bsdus/

ngo) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gter srung las kyi ma mo'i bsang mchod yid bzhin gter 'byung ārya dhwa dzas mdzad pa/ ci) ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyi bsang mchod nges don chos dbyings rang grol gyi mdzad pa/ chu) grib bsang bsdus pa bde chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ je) mu khri'i bsang bdag nyid hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gter chen nyid kyis mdzad pa/ nyo) spu rgyal gyi bsang mchod bde chen rol pa'i dga' ston gter chen nyid kyis mdzad pa/ ti) gze rgyal nor bdag gi rgyal po las/ mngon rtogs bsam phel nor bu/ thu) gze rgyal nor sgrub bsam 'phel nor bu'i g.yang 'gugs zla ba'i 'od zhags/ de) thugs dam bskul ba/ no) gze rgyal nor sgrub kyi tshogs bskang 'dod rgu lhun po/ pi) pra yi lha mo'i shwa mo kun gsal sgron me nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i thugs sprul sku phreng gsum pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ phu) phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon gyi gter srung dge bsnyen gsol mchod

'di gnam lcags zab gter pod tsa)pa ldeb 476 phyag rdor dregs zil gnon gyi sne mor 'dzud par zhu/ bcas bzhugs so/ slar smras pa/ gnubs lo'i rnam 'phrul rtsa gsum gling gang gi /zab chos nor bu'i mdzod kyi cha lag tu/ rim byon mchog sprul brgyud 'dzin bcas pa'i gsung*/ thor bu gang rnyed phyogs gcig bsdus te bkod/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bkam̐' gtem̐r srim̐ zhum̐ ru/ /em̐ waṃm̐ dpem̐ skrunam̐ kham̐ng nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༈(ka) sku gsum bla ma'i gsol 'debs puṇḍa'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ e ma/ /rgyal mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /byin rlabs gcig 'dus kyi rtsa ba/ /rje btsun padma yi 'byung gnas/ /ma cig dbyings phyug gi mtsho rgyal/ /'dren mchog rtsa yi bla ma/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi mnga' bdag /yon tan kun 'byung gi ma ma/ /mtshungs med rigs 'dus khyed mkhyen no/ /gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs shig /deng sang snyigs ma ya dus 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes rang gzigs shig /drin can o rgyan rje mkhyen no/ /sems can rmu rgod kyi 'byung po/ /nag phyogs kha yan gyi dus 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? skye 'gro srid pa yi rdzing chu/ /'dor med rgyun 'khyil gyi dus 'dir/

/bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? mthong tshad chags sdang gi me dpung*/ /dug lnga tshwa ngar gyi dus 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? ma rig zhe sdang gi spu gri/ /bag med rgyun 'thab kyi dus 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? khong khro las rlung gi dpung chen/ /bzod med rgyun 'tshub kyi dus 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /'dod sred gshin chu yi rab med/ /gcong rong rbab byings kyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? nga rgyal ri gzar gyi rbab ltar/ kheg med drag nyil gyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? phan tshun nyon mongs kyi dug rlangs/ /rgyun 'khrigs ngam nag gi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? zhan chags me 'obs kyi thal tshan/ /sdug bsngal ngan 'bag gi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? phan tshun dge sgrub kyi las kun/ /skal chad log lta yi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? tshe rabs byang chub kyi 'dun ma/ /long med lam zad kyi dus 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? dal 'byor rin chen gyi gling 'dir/ /zong zad stong log gi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /bsags nor gzhan spyod kyi sbrang rtsi/ /dkor gzan snying nag gi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? rgyan gos 'ja' tshon gyi mdangs rlom/ /slog rul zhen 'dzin gyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? mi tshe dbyar sos kyi gangs ri/ /rtag med rgyun nyil gyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? chos med drad po yi ngang ring*/ /nam mjug sbrang bu bzhin 'gyur 'dir/ bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? gnas skabs zang zing gi g.yeng ba/ /dbyar chu drag bzhur gyi skabs 'dir/

/bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /gnyen 'dun tshong 'dus kyi mgron po/ /nges med bral nye yi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /'dir snang dga' bde la gol nas/ /'phral yun rgyags zad kyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /bskyed rdzogs ngo sprod cig thob rung*/ /nyams len rlung khyer gyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /skra bregs ngur smrig gis brgyan kyang*/ /nges 'byung gtan bral gyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? dbang khrid dam tshig gis bsgos kyang*/ /srung sdom nyag phra gi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? gzhis dgon bslab sbyang la 'grims kyang*/ /tha mal rang 'dod kyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /mos gus bcos ma re sems kyang*/ /dag snang glog 'gyu yi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? chos brgyad snyan grags la brtson zhing*/ /skyid 'dod sdug nyo yi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /nyon mongs kha yan la 'byams shing*/ /bzod bsran gtan med kyi skabs 'dir/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /nam zhig bde 'gro yi sna thag /nyin zhig mgo dkri ni nus par/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes? drin can o rgyan? /sum ldan drin can gyi bla ma/ /gsol ba 'debs po la gzigs dang*/ /dug 'joms sman bcud kyi rgyal po/ /srin yul gshegs pa yi pha cig /padma 'byung gnas de dran no/ /ma rig mun sel gyi nyi zla/ /'dzam gling mchod sdong gi rgyal po/ /rnga yab bzhugs pa de dran no/ /mgo nag skye dgu yi mgon cig /bod yul gsang sngags kyi sgron me/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje de dran no/ /rjes 'brangs smin byed kyi gtso mo/ /dgongs brda rgya mtsho yi dkyil 'khor/ /ma cig mtsho rgyal de dran no/

/skal ldan grangs med la smin grol/ /'ja' lus bum sku yi a ma/ /mkhar chen bza' mtsho de dran no/ /rig 'dzin rgya mtsho yi brda grogs/ /rten 'brel phyogs med kyi 'byung gnas/ /ḍākki dbyangs can de dran no/ /bka' drin 'khor med kyi bla ma/ /tshogs gnyis stabs gcig la ston pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma de dran no/ /mi 'bral snying ga ru rtag par/ /padma 'dzum pa yi dbus su/ /bsgom zhing gsol 'debs kyi bu la/ /byin rlabs dbang bzhi rnams bskur zhing*/ /mchog thun dus 'di ru smin pa'i/ /rtsol med thugs rje yis skyongs shig /skye dang tshe rabs kun ma lus/ /pad 'byung rig 'dzin rje nyid dang*/ /rtag par 'bral ba rang med pa'i/ /smon lam bzang po zhig 'debs so/ /bla ma mkhyen no/ zhes brgya'am sems nges 'byung skyo shas ma 'byong bar bskyar/ zhes bla ma rgyang 'bod tshigs bcad 'di'ang rje btsun dam pas rjes su bzung ba'i gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje de nyid kyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // (kha) ༈ hūm̐/ 'og min zhing du kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*/ /rigs lnga'i zhing du lnga ldan gangs can mtsho/ /sprul sku'i zhing du thub dbang padma 'byung*/ /sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams zhing du zhi khro rigs brgya'i bdag /gang 'dul der ston rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /snga 'gyur theg pa'i lam bzang sgrub sde brgyad/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos sku'i zhing du yum chen pha rol phyin/ /longs sku'i gnas su mkha' spyod phag mo'i zhabs/ /sprul sku'i zhing du mtsho rgyal ḍākki'i tshogs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum la gsol btab mthus/ /bdag ni skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ /zab gsang rdo rje theg chen la spyod nas/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rnam thar 'dzin par shog /gsang sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du/

/dbang bzhi 'dzin pa'i gzungs mar bdag gyur nas/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan lhun grub kyis/ /'gro rnams smin cing grol ba'i dpal gyur cig /dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /mi 'bral gzungs kyis bsdus pa'i rdo rje mched/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu yang yang 'tshogs pa yis/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin shog /sgo gsum ye shes bla ma'i dkyil 'khor shar/ /phung khams skye mched lha dang lha mor dag /rtsa thig rlung gsum 'gro 'ong rang grol nas/ /gzhon nu bum sku'i klong du sangs rgyas shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ gter ston gnam lcags rdo rjes mdzad pa'o// // (ga)༄༅/ sku gsum bla ma'i gsol 'debs dag snang brgyud pa'i gdung dbyangs bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru ḍākki nī ye hūm̐/ sku gsum bla ma'i gsol 'debs dag snang rgyud pa'i gdung dbyangs rtsom par byed pa la/ thog mar lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bgyis pa'i ngang nas 'di ltar 'bad par bya/ na mo/ rje chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdud nag phyogs kha dar bzlog tu gsol/ /byams longs sku thugs rje chen po la/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdud nag phyogs kha dar bzlog tu gsol/ /pha sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdud nag phyogs kha dar bzlog tu gsol/ /ma ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdud nag phyogs kha dar bzlog tu gsol/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ gnas spyi bo'i gtsug gi nam mkha' la/ /'ja' 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i gur khang du/ /gdan padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng*/ /rang dad mos gang yod bla ma dang*/ /don dbyer med gu ru padma 'byung*/ /zhal dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi ma khro/ /dbu pad zhwa sgro dar me long brgyan/ /sku zab ber chos gos rnam gsum gsol/ /phyag rdo rje bhandha kha ṭwāṃ bsnams/ /zhabs brkyang bskum rol stabs 'gying bag bzhugs/ /g.yas mandha ra ba lha mo'i sku/ /phyag mda' dar tshe yi bum pa 'dzin/ /g.yon ye shes mtsho rgyal btsun mo'i tshul/ /phyag bhandha 'dzin cing mkhyud pa'i tshul/ /'khor gnyis po bzhengs pa'i stabs su bsgom/ /zhing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kun/ /dpe kha ba bun long 'tshub bzhin byon/ /de thams cad spyi bo'i lha la thim/ /skyabs kun 'dus o rgyan sprul pa'i sku/ /yum ye shes mkha' 'gro rnam gnyis la/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ /dus deng sang snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus/ /chos gzhan gyi byin rlabs yal ba'i dus/ /lha gzhan gyi thugs rje nyams pa'i dus/ /bdud lha srin sde brgyad kha dar dus/ /rkyen nad mug mtshon gsum 'tshub pa'i dus/ /lha o rgyan ma gtogs re sa med/ /rje sku gsum bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /ma mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis dngos grub stsol/ /lus 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /sems chos skur rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /nad med pa bde ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /nor longs spyod 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /tshe bsod nams 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /rkyen bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /dgra bgegs srin 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /dus nam zhig mi gnas 'pho ba'i tshe/ /nub bde ba can du lam sna drongs/ /lus dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jigs sla 'di/ /rkyen g.yeng ba'i dbang du ma song bar/

/da tshur ltos rang gi sems la ltos/ /gzhi 'dzin med rtogs na rang rig yin/ /sems bltas pas mi mthong dngos po med/ /de ma mthong ngang la klod kyis zhogs/ /dus rgyun du dran pa'i rgyang so srungs/ /chos phyag rdzogs zung 'jug gzhan la med/ /de yin bzhin kun rdzob don dam gyis/ /bdag dus gsum dge ba ci bsags mthus/ /ma 'gro drug sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ /pha pad 'byung yab yum 'grub gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ gu ru padma dhā ra hrī ma ha ri ni sa ā yur dzñā na siddhi hūm̐/ zhes pa brgyud gsum bla ma'i gsol 'debs 'di thor thun gyi khar sngags 'chang ral pa'i thor tsugs bcings pa/ he ru ka'i rnam pa can bdag gi mdun du byon nas tshig 'di rnams lhang nger brjod du byung nas ma brjed cig gsungs pas/ rtsa gling pas shar mar bris pa'o// // (nga) ༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ e ma/ rgyal kun gcig 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /bslu med bstan 'gro yi skyabs mchog /bka' drin 'khor med kyi bla ma/ /bslab bcas rnam 'dren gyi sa mkhan/ /pha gcig o rgyan gyi rgyal po/ /gsol ba snying khung nas 'debs so/ /skal bzang mos blo yi skyabs gnas/ /'di phyi khyed nyid la re'o/ /byin rlabs cig car gyis smin pa'i/ /dbang bzhi mchog dngos de stsol cig /'og min chos sku yi mkha' la/ /kun bzang snang mtha' yi ngo bo/ /rdor 'chang longs sku yi bla ma/ /rdor sems sprul sku yi rnam rol/ /gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs so/ /za hor singha yi yul du/ /bram ze zla ba yi mtshan can/ /klong gsal snying po yi sgo 'byed/ /tant+ra'i bka' bab ni rdo rje/ /thub pa'i dbang po yi rnam pas/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres su thong zhig /o rgyan bha ta yi yul du/ /dbang bskur byin gyis rang brlabs te/ /las smon skal bzang du grub pa'i/

/mu ṭa dharma yi mtshan can/ /rje cig phyogs med du gshegs tshe/ /pra bha hastī yis rjes bzung*/ /shākya pra bha yi mtshan can/ /'bral med rjes bzung du stsol cig /rgya gar nub phyogs kyi gling du/ /bram ze sa ra yi ha pa/ /grub chen 'gran bral gyi dpa' bo/ /rlung sems dbang thob kyis rtsal chen/ /gnyug ma lhan skyes su 'phrod pa'i/ /rje btsun mtshungs med de mkhyen no/ /stag tshang mchims phu yi dben gnas/ /pha gcig gu ru yis rjes bzung*/ /dpal chen ye shes kyi dbang phyug /rbod stong ma mo yi bka' bab/ /rtsa rlung dbang sdud kyi rjes 'brangs/ /'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan bzhugs shig /li yul dza li yi dbus su/ /dharma rā dza yi mtshan can/ /rngam brjid las stobs la grub pa'i/ /chos rgyal dam pa yi 'byung gnas/ /gang shar las 'brel du mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun chos rgyal de mkhyen no/ /zhang zhung mtha' 'khob kyi gling du/ /ngan sngags mthu bon gyi bdag po/ /g.yu ston a rgyal gyi mtshan can/ /dbang phyug skye rgyud kun bsgyur ba'i/ /rlung zhags dbang bsgyur gyi bdag po/ /gshen bon dam pa de mkhyen no/ /rgya gar lho phyogs kyi gling du/ /lnga ldan dge chen gyi rgyal sras/ /chos srid bstan gnyis kyi mnga' bdag /zhib rtsis mi dbang gi dam pa/ /chos rgyal nor bu de mkhyen no/ /rgya gar bha ga yi yul du/ /gu ru tha tra yi mtshan can/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po yi mchod gnas/ kha ston bslab brjod kyis rgyud sbyangs/ /zang zing longs spyod la ma 'khrul/ /mchod gnas dam pa de mkhyen no/ /srin mo rnga thug gi grong du/ /lha lcam bhi ra ha'i mtshan can/ /rgyal yum 'jigs med kyi sgrol ma/ /dgongs pa gang shar du spyod pa'i/ /rgyal gcig sras gcig gi lha mo/ /ngo bo hūm̐ nag gi drag rtsal/ /gtsang stod ding ri yi lung du/ /rgyal dbang chos rje yi dam pa/ /paṇḍi rab byung gi chas can/ /gnas lnga rig pa yi 'byung gnas/

/mtshungs med skyabs gcig gi sprul sku/ /ngo bo gnam lcags kyi rdo rje/ /stag tshang seṅge yi dben gnas/ /bdud 'dul padma yi thugs bcud/ /yang zab gnyer byang kun gtad tshe/ /ḍākki rgya mtsho yi gtso bo/ /rig ma nyer lnga la dbang ba'i/ /karma las 'brel gyi drag rtsal/ /mon kha smra bo yi sgrub gnas/ /sngags 'chang padma yi dbang drag /zab chos rgya mtsho yi bdag nyid/ /rten 'brel las stobs la spyod pa'i/ /chos bdag bka' bab kyi bu chen/ /ngo bo hūm̐ bdag gi rdo rje/ /'dzam gling gangs can gyi khrod du/ /zab gter sgo 'byed kyi bdag po/ /rig 'dzin gar dbang gi rdo rje/ /'jigs med smin grol gyi bdag po/ /dpal chen ye shes kyi nus ldan/ /gsol ba snying khung nas 'debs so/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres su thong la/ /'bral med rjes bzung gi 'bras bu/ /don dam yongs grol gyi sa thob/ /kun bzang chos sku dang pad 'byung*/ /go 'phang dbyer med du gyur cig /

ces slob ma padma badzra gyis bskul ngor kā la hūm̐ gis bris so// // (ca)༈ e ma/ rgyal kun ngo bo kun bzang snang mtha' yas/ /rang byung cho rol longs sku rdo rje sems/ /sprul sku o rgyan rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /za hor yul du bram ze zla bar grags/ /thub pas byin gyis brlabs der gsol? o rgyan yul du shākya pra bha'i mtshan/ /yo ga'i gsang mdzod 'chang der gsol? li yi yul du dharma rā dza'i mtshan/ khrims srid rgyal khams skyong la gsol? gu rus byin brlabs buddha dzñā na'i mtshan/ /mthu rtsal rmad du byung la gsol? rgya gar lho phyogs gu ru tha tra'i mtshan/ /phyogs med 'gro don 'byung la gsol? rgya gar nub phyogs bram ze sa ra ha/ /grub thob rnal 'byor spyod der? zhang zhung yul du g.yung ston a rgyal mtshan/ /dbang phyug skye rgyud gyur der? byang phyogs lnga ldan dge chen rgyal sras mtshan/ /phyogs spyug dka' ba spyad der? gtsang g-i phyogs su rgyal dbang drug par grags/ /rab byung paṇḍi ta la gsol? srin yul lha lcam bhi ra ha zhes grags/ /dam pa'i skye rgyud dran der gsol? stag tshang singhar karma las 'brel zhes/ /yongs rdzogs smin grol mdzad la gsol? gangs can khrod du smon lam rten 'brel 'dzoms/ /zab gter sgo phyes smin grol thar lam bkod/ /hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal la gsol? padma'i thugs bcud zab chos yang gsang bzhes/ /gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' rgyas smon lam dang*/ /phrin las bka' bab blo gros snying stobs can/ /gsang sngags thar lam ston der gsol ba 'debs/ /skye dang tshe rabs 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog / sprang po rang snang che ba ma yin te/ /nyams mtshar yi ger bkod pa yin lags so/ /'khrul rjes 'brang na dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bshags/ /phyogs nyul sprang po gnam lcags rdo rjes so// // yang 'di ltar/ dpal chos kyi 'khor lo rang byung dkyil/ /sku mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan he ru ka

/rje drang srong gzugs can sa ha ra/ /de bsam bzhin sprul pa hūm̐ gi sku/ /gzhi rig pa dbyer med sngags 'chang rjer/ /bus gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/ / bum pa brtsegs pa mchog gis bskul ngor hūm̐ nag drag pos gnas chen jo bo gze rgyal kyi sgo chen du sbyar ba'o// // (cha) ༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal gdams gsol 'debs smon lam bzhugs so/ e ma/ dge legs phun tshogs dar cig bskyil ba'i dbus/ /'di snang don yod sems pa'i rang cag rnams/ /nye bar bskul na mi rtag yong bar soms/ /'phro 'gyu'i 'jig rten rlung nang mar me bzhin/ /byar yod g.yeng bas dal 'byor stong log nye/ /bsags pa'i nor dang dar cig 'brel ba'i grogs/ /tho rangs gza' skar bzhin du phyi snang nub/ /rang gzhan mi rtag 'brog pa'i bskyas shul 'dra/ /rmi lam lha mo'i snang ba bkod pa bzhin/ /g.yeng ba'i sna thag bdud kyis bslu brid kyis/ /ma mthong bzhin du bdag 'dzin btson rar khrid/ /ci bya dbang med bshas lug mgo 'khor 'dra/ /nges par las 'phros shugs btsan a re 'jigs/ /ny-in bsam mtshan gzhig 'chi bdag khong zon gyis/ /mi tshe stong zad 'di snang la g.yeng na/ /bya byed don med chu nag lag myong 'dra/ /shes shes pher pher rna ba'i tshig sgros la/ /dgos dgos zin med 'ja' tshon rgyan spyod 'dra/ /des na ci bzhin 'grub pa snying po'i chos/ /dang po thos bsam sgom pa'i rgya yis thob/ /bar du bsnyen sgrub las gsum gnad du bsnun/ /tha ma rang gzhan don du smon lam thobs/ /rjes shes btang snyoms mi bzhag brtson 'grus sbran/ khyad par nyin snang mtshan mo'i rmi lam kun/ /gang shar 'dzin med cir snang bdag med skyongs/ /sngon bsu rjes 'brangs rnam rtog sgro mi btags/ /byar med ngang la yengs med chu rgyun bzhin/ /sgom dang mi sgom a 'thas blos mi bslad/ /blos byas sgom rnams blos gzh-ig phyi 'phrengs bcad/

/rang sems nya mo drwa rgyar ma 'dzin par/ /rgya yan lhug bzhag mtsho dang nya chen bzhin/ /rig pa nyin srib med pa'i mtsho mtha' skyongs/ /lta ba'i rgya mtsho 'khyil na nya tshang bde/ /bstan pa ma thob bar du byi dor gtso/ /lta ba'i klong la sgom pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /spyod pa rgya yan lhug bzhag gzhon nu'i byad/ /rang bzhin chos sku mdzes ma'i bzhin ras la/ /blta ba'i zur mig yid kyi ku mud bzhad/ /chos nyid lang tsho'i ze'u 'bru phrums pa'i ngog /rig pa'i bung bas dga' bzhi'i nyams dbyangs len/ /rnal 'byor ma khyod bdag gi zab lam dpal/ /sku gsum dbu ma'i 'khri shing shin tu ldem/ /dga' ma'i lam 'di mngon thob yid rab phyogs/ /bzang mo'i chu skyes bde dga'i mgron du khug / ces tshigs su bcad pa'i zhal gdams te dang po'o/ zhes pa'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs 'dzin pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal ngor/ phyogs nyul du rgyu ba sngags 'chang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas bgyis pa don dang ldan par smon no// // (ja)༄༅/ rtsa gsum gling pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i gtsug rgyan gar gyi dbang*/ /rgyal kun ngo bo o rgyan chos kyi rje/ /dam pa'i yang sprul rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling*/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rnying ma ba'i/ /gsang sngags bka' bab brgyud par gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho bka' 'dus bla ma'i mchog /thugs sgrub rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor dpag yas kyi/ /gter la spyod cing rnam 'dren mchog gi lha/ /bde chen rgyal po'i zhal mthong rnga yab tu/ /'tshogs shing sa gsum skye dgu'i mgon dam pas/ /bstan 'gror chos 'khor rlabs chen bskor du gsol/ /phrin las sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba kun/ /'dren pa'i dpal du don kun lhun grub shog / ces theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ rtsa gsum gling pas chu bya'i hor zla gsum pa'i dkar phyogs su bris pa dge'o//

// (nya) ༈ zhabs brtan gsol 'debs rdo rje'i khri 'phang ni/ rje btsun dam pa rig 'dzin padma yi/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ /bden pa'i dpal yon nus pas bdag skyongs la/ /gnubs lo'i skyes sprul gar dbang rtsa gsum gling*/ /'jigs med gnam lcags rdo rje'i go cha ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor bar mdzod/ /bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /rab brtan glang chen zil gnon seṅgai'i khri/ /cang shes rta mchog mdangs ldan rma bya'i khri/ /mkha' gdeng khyung chen gyad chen shang shang khri/ /mi shigs rdo rje mi 'gyur g.yung drung khri/ /skyon bral padma mun sel nyi ma'i khri/ /mdangs ldan zla rgyas dwangs ma 'od kyi khri/ /kun khyab mi shigs rang bzhin chos dbyings khrir/ /rtag tu zhabs pad gser gyi 'khor lo ltar/ /g.yo med 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhugs nas bdag gzhan ma lus byin brlabs te/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don bgyis pa dang*/ /mkha' mnyam ma lus tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs te/ /mthar thug dam ba'i chos la spyod pa dang*/ /lha dang srung mas rtag tu skyong ba shog /bkra shis bde legs yar zla ltar 'phel zhing*/ /gong nas gong du rgyas pa'i smon lam shog / ces grwa slob rnams kyis bskul ngor gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // (ta)༄༅/ smug po lha brag la sogs dang khyad par jo bo gze rgyal sogs gnas kyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so: de nas gnas bskor gyi skabs gsol ba lhang lhang btab na bar chad sel zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'byung ngo : na mo hūm̐: ka dag dang po sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: chos sku bla ma kun bzang snang mtha' yas: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: longs sku rdor sems spyan ras gzigs: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol:

nad gdon rkyan ngan zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku bla ma dga' rab padma 'byung : gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: dmag 'khrugs mu ge zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: rdo rje phag mo mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro'i gtso: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char bar byin gyis rlobs: sangs rgyas ye shes rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: mchog thun dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐ nag drag rtsal thugs mchog rdo rje dang*/ /lung zin chos bdag brgyud par bcas pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol/ /'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'dzin rdo rje chos: rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchog: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: tshe rabs lha skal mjal bar byin gyis rlobs: bstan pa'i bya ra chos skyong gter srung la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: dge chos lam du slong bar byin gyis rlobs: smug po lha rtse thugs kyi gnas mchog la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: tshogs bsag sgrib pa byang bar byin gyis rlobs: bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can ma lus kun: 'di nas mi gtsang lus brjes gyur ma thag: mkha' spyod dag zhing bgrod par mdzad du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: oṃ wa gi shwa ri mūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: hūm̐ badzra phaṭḥ oṃ padma dhā ra ā yur siddhi hūm̐: zhes gnas kyi gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel bsam pa lhun grub ma 'di/ thams cad kyis rgyun du kha 'don byas na dag zhing bgrod par the tshom med do: gnas bskor ba thams cad kyis 'don chog yin: khyad par gze rgyal bskor dus 'don: gnas bskor thams cad kyi rim gro'i don du ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi mdzad pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gab rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ mdo khams lci rgyud smug po lha rtse rong gi brag laṅka mgrin bcu'i gnas rigs ldan grogs dang bcas te lcags phag lor gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // (tha)༄༅/ bla ma rgyang 'bod bzhugs so// // gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i rgyang 'bod ni/ e ma ho/ rgyal kun ngo bo pad 'byung*/ /gsang sngags mdzod 'dzin mtsho rgyal/ /gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes/ /gsol 'debs thugs rjes gzigs shig /g.yung ston ngan sngags kyi rgyal po/ /rgyal sras padma dbang chen/ /mthu chen dum rgya yi zhang khrom/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzod/ /sprul sku nam mkha'i nor bu/ /karma las 'brel gling pa/ /chos rje 'gro ba kun grol/ /padma gter bdag gling pa'i/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus drongs shig /gu ru dri med 'od zer/ /gar dbang grub pa'i dbang phyug /sngags nag zhwa gos rgyan can/ /kā la hūm̐ gi ngo bo/ /thugs rjes gzigs par zhu dang*/ /bstan dgra thang ma'i gnyen po/ /phung byed shāntiṃ garbha/ /bya rog prog gi zhu gsol/ /ber phod gza' bdud kyi chas mdzad/ /gnam lcags thog rgod kyi rdo rje/ /gsol 'debs bar chad kun zlog cig /rdo rje khrag 'thung gi skur bzhengs/ /dmod pa phyung rdeg gi spu gri/ /pha rol rgol ba'i sgyogs chen/ /hūm̐ nag drag rtsal khyed mkhyen no/ /ma rungs byad ma 'dul mdzad/ /drag rdzas thun dang zor 'phen/ /gnam lcags phur pa'i mtshon thogs/ /artsig khro rgyal gyi sngags bdag /log 'dren cham la phob cig /che mchog dpal dgu dang dbyer med/ /rdo rje gzhon nu dang sku mnyam/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi gling pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po khyed mkhyen no/ /gang bsam thogs med du sgrub mdzad/ /mtshungs bral mgon po khyed mkhyen no/ /kun 'dus sprul sku khyed mkhyen no/

/gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin khyed mkhyen no/ /gter ston klong yangs khyed mkhyen no/ /'pho ba kun 'grub khyed mkhyen no/ /'ja' lus zag med khyed mkhyen no/ /pad 'byung dngos 'dra khyed mkhyen no/ /bdag gis dus rnams kun tu/ /gsol ba rtse gcig 'debs so/ /bar chad rkyen ngan zlog cig /tshe 'dir dngos grub stsol cig /dbang bzhi lus la bskur cig /sku bzhi yongs rdzogs su gyur cig /snang sems chos skur rtogs nas/ /snang bzhi ro gcig 'char zhing*/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob mdzod/ rgyang 'bod rig 'dzin ming gis sbyar ba'o// // (da)༈ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rin po che'i mchod sdong ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na mo hūm̐/ gdod ma'i gshis lugs ye stong pho brang nas/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes kun khyab phyogs ris bral/ /spang rtogs ris bral 'khor ba dongs nas sprugs/ /ye gzhi kun tu bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhi snang rang rtsal 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bzod nas dag pa 'khor lo'i pho brang nas/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /ma 'gags thugs rjes mtha' med 'gro ba 'dul/ /rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang shar thad kar chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /'og min bde chen dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /ma 'gags rig rtsal ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /snang ba'i cho rol dug lnga dbyings su dag /rigs lnga yab yum bcu la gsol? dga' bzhi ye shes 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gshis lugs snang ba lha sku'i pho brang nas/ /dran rtogs rtsal las ma 'gags so sor shar/ /spros pa'i mtshan mas log rtogs sems can bsgral/ /dga' rab rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol? sprul skus 'gro don nus par byin? mkha' dbyings dag pa rab 'byams pho brang nas/ /gang shar ma zhen shar shar shar ma zhen/ /shar grol dus mnyam ye stong ye ma 'gag /rig 'dzin shrī singhar gsol? bde stong spros dang bral bar byin?

mngon spyod las la grub pa'i pho brang nas/ /gshin rje'i bdag nyid lha srin dal kha 'phen/ /mañdzu mi tra'i zhabs la gsol? nus pa mtha' ru phyin par byin? dri med mdangs ldan ko sha'i mtsho las skyes/ /padma las 'khrungs rgyal khams bde la bkod/ /zab rgya'i gter sbas raksha 'dul du gshegs/ /padma 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol? 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin? mi mngon tshangs pa lha yi mdun sa nas/ /dbyangs can rol gar mi ro gser du bsgyur/ /mi brjed gzungs thob bod yul gter gyis bkang*/ /dbyangs can mtsho rgyal zhabs la gsol? rten 'brel phyogs med 'char bar byin? rgya bod 'phags pa'i chos grwa chen po nas/ /dam chos bod bsgyur mdo sngags bstan pa spel/ /drag sngags bka' bab brag la phur pa gtab/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la gsol? tshe rabs rjes su bzung bar byin? zab rgya mi zad gter gyi pho brang nas/ /dregs pa dam 'dogs zab mo'i gter sgo phyes/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang mngon spyod rol rtsal 'gyed/ /gnam lcags rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol? nyams rtogs rgyud la skye bar byin? /rtsa thig rlung gsum gar dgu'i pho brang nas/ /rig rtsal thogs med rlung sems dbu mar tshud/ /lha srin dbang sdud sgrub sde'i rgyun bzang btsug /mi 'jigs rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol? rig pa tshad la phebs par byin? las dang skal bar ldan pa'i pho brang nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsam dang sgom sgrub nus rtags rdzogs/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad/ /bstan 'dzin bu slob rnams la gsol? sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol btab gdung bas 'bod lags na/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis nyon mongs mun pa sangs/ /ye shes lnga yis 'gro rgyud nyin mor byed/ /skye dang tshe rabs pad 'byung 'bral med zhing*/ /dpal ri padma'i rgyal sa 'dzin par shog /

ces sgrub rgyud bla ma dam pa dang dad ldan grwa slob mang pos bskul ngor rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // (na)༈ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa ni/ e ma ho/ srid gsum skye dgu'i mgon gyur padma 'byung*/ /mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal ma/ /drag sngags rtsal 'chang buddha dzñā na ba/ /zab gter sgo 'byed rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling*/ /rlung sems dbang thob rig 'dzin mi 'jigs sogs/ /drag sngags rtsal 'chang brgyud par gsol ba 'debs/ /nam zhig mi rtag 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde chen padma 'od kyi zhing du drongs/ /sku gsum mnyam nyid phrin las mtha' yas nas/ /rig rtsal bstan 'gro'i don chen mthar phyin shog / rig pa 'dzin pa mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // (pa) rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ hrī/ rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus padma 'byung*/ /gsang gsum mi zad mdzod 'dzin rtsa gsum gling*/ /rlung sems dbang bsgyur mi 'jigs rdo rje rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gsal stong bskyed rim rtsal rdzogs chu zla'i gar/ /grags stong nus pa'i rtsal 'byin rdo rje'i bzlas/ /rig stong dug lnga'i thug phrad lam khyer rdzogs/ /klong yangs rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /sna tshogs snang ba rang grol byin gyis rlobs/ /gar dgu'i rtsal 'chang sde brgyad ar la gtad/ /snying rje'i rgyud bskul stong gsum lha srin btul/ /nus pa'i rtsal 'chang mi 'jigs rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /'byung bzhi lus kyi nad gdon bar chad zlog /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bden tshig gis/ /mi rtag 'byung 'dus lus 'di bor ma thag /bde chen dag pa'i zhing der skye bar shog khri dmar gdung rigs dpal mos bskul ngor/

rig pa 'dzin pa mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // (pha)༈ hrī/ rigs kun khyab bdag theg dgu'i yang rtse mdzod/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dbang snang mtha' yas/ /chos sku'i lha tshogs rnams la gsol? gdod ma'i rang ngo 'phrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhyen rab snying rje'i mthu thob mthar phyin pa'i/ /'jam dpal spyan gzigs phyag na rdo rje sogs/ /longs sku'i lha tshogs rnams la gsol? dbyings rig ka dag rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /dga' rab shrī sing bshes gnyen padma 'byung*/ /sprul sku'i lha tshogs rnams la gsol? dag snang phyogs med 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gsal stong bskyed pa chu zla'i dkyil 'khor bkra/ /grags stong 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa rdzogs/ /rig stong gang shar thug phrad lam du khyer/ /rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /sna tshogs snang ba gcig 'dres byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bden tshig mthus/ /nam zhig mi rtag lus bor gyur ma thag /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skyes nas kyang*/ /dpal ri padma'i zhing mchog 'dzin par shog / dam chos kyis bskul ngor mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // (ba)༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i che ba dgu ldan gyi gsol 'debs ni/ na mo/ gu ru lo ha badzra ye/ ko sha'i mtsho dbus ge sar las 'khrungs pa/ /log 'dren dam btags dregs pa bran du bkol/ /rdo rje'i theg chen chos kyi sgron me sbar/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pad 'byung khyod la bstod/ /gang gi thugs kyi rnam rol gnubs lo'i gar/ /rigs ni rlangs chen dpal seng gdung rgyud las/ /skye ba 'khrul med spa rong yul gyi char/ /sha gzan gshog sdeb nags tshal mdung gzeng 'dra/ /rgyal khams rngam sgra gcan gzan ngar ba'i rong*/ /drag po gshed bzhi zhe sdang shing khyi'i lor/ /mi mchog sha gzug skur bltams gar gyi dbang*/

/phyi yi mtshan 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rjer bstod/ /sngon sbyangs stobs kyis lo chung byis pa'i dus/ /blo gros pad tshal rgyas ba'i dpal yon dang*/ /rtags mtshan du ma ldan pa'i mtshan dpe can/ /ye shes las rab rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/ /lo lnga bzhes tshe dag snang rmi lam du/ /slob dpon yab yum zhal gzigs lung bstan cing*/ /brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i go cha rab rdzogs pa'i/ /rdo rje grub mchog rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/ /drag po'i rtags rgya spyi gtsug me ris brgyan/ /dam can bka' gter bran khol gsang bdag dngos/ /bdud bzhi log 'dren rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa/ /dregs pa kun 'dul rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/ /rgyud smin dbang rnams rdzogs pa'i brda rtags su/ /so zho tshe bum rang byung ngo mtshar can/ /ngag gi sgrib byang rtsa mdud rang sar grol/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/ /stong nyid don rtogs brda mtshon snying ga ru/ /sme ba'i rgyan can rdzogs chen rnal 'byor pa/ /rlung sems dbang thob rig pa rang babs shar/ /hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/ /mi 'gyur phrin las 'grub pa'i brda rtags la/ /gsang bar hūm̐ mthing mtshan pa'i ri mo bkra/ /las bzhi phrin las grub pa'i mnga' dbang phyug /dmod las thogs med rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/ /dbus yul bsam yas thugs sgrub gter bzhes tshe/ /padma 'byung gnas 'ja' 'od tshul gyis shar/ /mthong thos kun kyang mos gus dag snang 'bar/ /karma las 'brel rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/ /sbas tshal rngam pa rong gi gnas mchog nas/ /seṅge'i gdong can gter sgrom dngos su phul/ /thams cad pad 'byung mjal ba'i snang ba thob/ /gnod sbyin dbang sdud rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/ /de bzhin rmad byung zab gter dpag yas kyi/ /gter rgya bkrol ba'i 'gran bral ya mtshan can/ /padma'i brda yig tshig rnams lam mer gsal/ /rdo rje me 'bar rtsal zhes bya bar bstod/

/mkha' 'gros gdan drangs rnga yab pad 'byung drung*/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor dbang chen 'bog pa'i tshe/ /me tog nub phyogs phog pa'i yang gsang mtshan/ /padma gter bdag gling zhes bya bar bstod/ /rgyal khams 'gro don brtul zhugs smyo spyod can/ /gsang mtshan dgu ldan chos rgyal 'gro mgon rje/ /che ba'i mthu stobs mnga' bdag dregs pa'i gshed/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling zhes bya bar bstod/ khyed la bstod cing sgo gsum gus pa'i mthus/ /rnam dkar dge tshogs yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /rtag tu sngags bstan la gnas gang bsam kun/ /thogs med myur 'grub bgegs rnams rab bzlog cing*/ /bla med gu ru rje dang mdzad phrin mnyam/ /mkha' khyab mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun/ /sa chen theg dgus rtse mor bsnyeg gyur cig / ces pa 'di arya dhwa dzas zla tshes bzang por sbyar ba'o// // (ma)༈ mi 'jigs rdo rje'i zhabs brtan ni/ khyod nyid gang 'dul sprul bsgyur zlos pa'i gar/ /mi shigs mkhyen brtse'i lha lam yangs pa nas/ /'jigs med 'gro 'di'i dpal gyur nyin mo'i mgon/ /mi zad rdo rje gsum gyi zer 'gyed mkhan/ /yongs 'dzin dpal ldan bla ma rin po che/ /bskal mang rdo rje'i khri la rab brtan nas/ /ring lugs bstan pas sa chen khyab gyur nas/ /phyogs bcu'i ma rig 'gro mun mthar bskrad shog / ces pa'ang ārya'i ming gis so// // (tsa) ༈ de nas zhabs brtan smon lam bya ba ni/ om̐ swa sti/ rab 'byams rgyal kun spyi gzugs o rgyan rje/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya tsho'i lha lam nas/ /gling bzhi'i 'gro 'dren dam pa nyin mo'i mgon/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /mtshan 'chang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje'i/ /zhabs kyi padmo ji srid brtan gyur cig /pad 'byung bden tshig stobs kyis skyong bar shog khyab bdag gang de skyes mchog gtsug gi rgyan/ /mi 'jigs chos sku'i mkha' klong yangs pa nas/

/thon pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes rta bdun dbang*/ /gar bzhad shar ri las mngon skye dgu'i mgon/ /brtse mkhyen chos kyi 'od stong rab 'phro ba/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rgyal tshab rin po che/ /zhabs pad gser gyi 'khor lo rab brtan nas/ /dam ldan srung mas g.yel med skyong byas te/ /pad 'byung bden mthu'i stobs kyis phyug par shog /'gran bral ring lugs chos srid mdzad phrin rnams/ /gong nas gong 'phel 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khyon/ khyab ste smin grol bstan pa yun gnas shog /der 'dzin 'phags pa'i 'dus sde dam pa kun/ /bslab gsum khrims gnas bsod nams dge bcu yis/ /dpal stobs mnga' dbang du mas phyug byas nas/ /'gro don sangs rgyas stong dang bstan pa mnyam/ /skye dgu yongs la chos kyi char 'bebs shing*/ /thar pa'i lo 'bras myu gu rab smin nas/ /bla med rim dgu theg pa'i rtser saun shog /mchog gsum rtsa gsum rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso/ /drang srong grub thob skyes chen rgya mtsho yi/ /rnam rol mgon de'i thugs rjes zlos gar mthus/ /mchog gi sprul sku'i zhabs brtan bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang brgyud 'dzin pa ārya'i ming gis rten 'brel ched du bris pa'o// // gzhan yang*/ gsang sngags rnam rgyal khang bzang mthon pa'i rtser/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan snyan grags phyogs mthar rgyas/ /mi shigs gdaung lnga'i khri 'phang mthon po la/ /g.yo med zhabs pad bskal brgyar srid mthar brtan/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gro ba sems can don/ /thugs rje'i brtse bas bsam don lhun rdzogs shog / ces pa'ang ārya dhwa dzas so// // (tsha)༈ gnam lcags bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la gsol ba 'debs/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /ston mchog rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/

/sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin chos mchog rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin klu rgyal 'jog po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin ind+ra bo dhi la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /che mchog 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin shrī singha la gsol ba 'debs/ /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha lcam mandha ra ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /bal po ba su dha ra la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes la gsol ba 'debs/ /klong chen nam mkha'i snying po la gsol ba 'debs/ /lo chen bai ro tsa na la gsol ba 'debs/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /ā yu dhe wa dhā ra la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku sprul o rgyan rig 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /nges don chos dbyings rang grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun bzang 'chi med nor bu la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin snyan grags rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog phrin las bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /drin can bzod pa rab brtan la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos bdag las can rnams pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang dkon mchog seṅge la gsol ba 'debs/ /brgyud 'dzin ārya dhwa dza la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang sngags phrin las dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan 'dzin padma phrin las la gsol ba 'debs/ /karma au ḍī ya na la gsol ba 'debs/ /gu ru shrī bha dra la la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje btsun prañdza gho ṣa la gsol ba 'debs/

/drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs sems la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe gcig 'ja' lus grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ prañdza gho ṣas so// // (dza)༄༅/ rtsa gsum gling pa'i chos bdag bcas pa'i gsol 'debs rags bsdus su bkod pa 'chi med grub pa'i dga' tshal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs so/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs so/ /longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs so/ /ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs so/ /'phags mchog thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkhas pa shrī singha la gsol ba 'debs so/ /paṇa chen bi ma mi tra la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /slob dpon bai ro tsa na la gsol ba 'debs so/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la gsol ba 'debs so/ /lha lcam manda ra ba la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la gsol ba 'debs so/ khye'u lha bu 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge bshes ku sa chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug la gsol ba 'debs so/ /shākya pra bha wa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bram ze sa ra ha la gsol ba 'debs so/ /lha lcam bde chen mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gnubs chen buddha dzñā na la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhang khrom rdo rje 'od 'bar la gsol ba 'debs so/

/gter ston bon po drag rtsal la gsol ba 'debs so/ /padma tshe dbang rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gter ston dri med kun dga' la gsol ba 'debs so/ /padma dbang gi bdag nyid la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkhas chen shākya pra bha la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gter ston rtsa gsum gling pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /ā yu dhe wa dha ra la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ /lha lcam 'od ldan 'bar ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sku sprul rong smyon chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las la gsol ba 'debs so/ /nges don chos dbyings rang grol la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gsung sprul 'chi med nor bu la gsol ba 'debs so/ /thugs sprul mi 'jigs rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rig 'dzin snyan grags rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gnam sprul bzod pa rab brtan la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bstan 'dzin padma'i 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dkon mchog phrin las bzang po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rtogs ldan a mdo gsang sngags la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zur mkhar theg chen gling pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /kun bzang bde chen rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mthu chen kra ti sngags 'chang la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sngags btsun kun dga' blo gros la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkhas grub dkon mchog seṅge la gsol ba 'debs so/ /'gro mgon ārya dhwa dza la gsol ba 'debs so/ /grub brnyes o rgyan bstan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs so/ /chos dbyings padma rang grol la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sngags 'chang rdo rje don 'grub la gsol ba 'debs so/ /karma au ḍī ya na la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma tshe brtan rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs so/

/gsang sngags phrin las dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bstan 'dzin padma phrin las la gsol ba 'debs so/ /brgyud 'dzin shrī bha dra la gsol ba 'debs so/ /prañdza dzñā na sa twa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dbang lung brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rig 'dzin snang srid bder 'dus la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bka' brgyad gsang zil lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gsang ba ye shes lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rdor sems kun 'dus yab yum la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gshin rje dug ri me 'bar la gsol ba 'debs so/ khro rgyal rta mgrin lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dpal chen nā ga klu 'dul la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zil gnon phyag na rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ /drag po kī la'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /padma khrag 'thung lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /yang gsang khro 'dus lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zil gnon thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /tshe lha rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /pad rgyal nor lha'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mgon po zhing skyong lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zab gter bdun cu don lnga la gsol ba 'debs so/ kye ma kyi hud/ bla ma'i sku gsum thugs rjes rang drongs mdzod/ /bdag sogs rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /bdag gzhan lus 'di nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor bar zhen pa log par byin gyis rlobs/

/tshe 'di blo yis thung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nges 'byung skyo shas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dzin mdud pa grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi med btsan sa zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /bskyed rim nus pa thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rdzogs rim dgongs don rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa rlung rang dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'od gsal rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /'ja' lus chos skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ bla ma mkhyen no/

zhes lan grangs mang du brjod mthar/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi gnas bzhi nas/ /'od zer 'phros pas rang gi gnas bzhir thim/ /sgrib bzhi dag nas sku bzhi mngon du gyur/ /bla ma dgyes pas 'od zhu rang la thim/ /dbyer med rang byung 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /chos kun ye rdzogs chen po'i dgongs pa bskyang*/ /dge 'dis pha mas thog drangs mkha' khyab 'gro/ /rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog / ces gsol 'debs 'di yang dgos zhes rig 'dzin chos mchog gis bskul ngor/ zhal ngo ma ldog tsam du/ mi tshe gtan 'khrul du song ba'i ban rgan smyon pa prañdza zhes pas 'khrul gtam dad mos ltar bris pa dge'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // (wa)༈ bla na med pa'i yang dag par gyur pa'i mchog chen po/ thugs kyi sgrub pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa bde chen lha yi dga' ston rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ e ma ho: gang zhig rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs: kho bo padma'i thugs bcud zab mo'i don: cha rkyen spel ba rin chen gtair gyi bdag: padma gter bdag gling zhes zhabs la 'dud: bla ma lha dang ḍā ki chos skyong gis: bka' yi gnang ba stsol la byin gyis brlab: sa ma ya: de yang mchod pa gzhung bzhin ci 'byor legs par bshams: rgyas pa byas na gtor ma zlum po lam: pad 'dab bzhis brgyan 'khor ni lha bshos bzhin: phyogs bzhir dag la ci mdzes rgyan gyis spras: mtshams bzhir rim dgu mtheb skyu bzhag par bya: bsdus pa bya 'dod rtsa gsum gtor mas chog: rgyun du kha 'don byed par spros med lugs: de la gsol ba 'debs pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma 'gags gsal stong 'od lnga 'khrigs pa yi: ye shes sku mchog ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang : rdzu 'phrul gar gyi dbang phyug kun khyab cing : dbyings rig dbyer med skye 'gag mi mnga' yang : bya bral lhun rdzogs bde chen yangs pa'i klong : skye 'chi bsgres rgud bral ba'i padma 'byung :

lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas gsol ba 'debs: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa: byang chub thar lam bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: ma chags skyon bral bla ma o rgyan rje: bzod med gdung shugs drag pos 'o dod 'bod: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis: byang chub 'bras bu myur du 'thob phyir du: skyabs su mchi'o 'gro sgrol sems bskyed do: lan gsum: de nas bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs tshogs ma lus 'dir 'dus shig: byang chub bsgrub la bar du gcod pa yi: gdon bgegs 'byung po thams cad kyis nyon la: dkyil 'khor 'di la gnod pa'i sems 'dug na: bdag nyid dpal chen padma'i thugs ka nas: khro tshogs rab 'phros mtshon chas dum bur gtub: de bas bgegs tshogs bka' las ma 'da' bar: rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig: oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni? sogs thun gyis brab: gsum pa srung 'khor gyi gur khang ni: hūm̐: mi shigs sra brtan rdo rje mtshon cha'i gur: phyogs mtshams me ri rab 'phros 'od zer 'khrigs: glags ltas mi tshugs srung ba'i gur du gyur: oṃ badzra padma rakṣa dzwa la raṃ: bzhi pa mchod pa byin rlob ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo mthun rdzas maṇḍal sogs: nang mchod sman raka gtor ma bla na med: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bde chen rig ma dang : gha na 'byor rdzas stong gsum khyon gang la: yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mri ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ? sogs nas shabda pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐: lnga pa byin 'baibs pa ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs thugs rje can: sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po rjes dgongs la: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob:

'dir tshogs skal ldan rnams la dbang chen bskur: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag la nyams rtogs spel: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dza: phaiṃ phaiṃ a bāe sha ya a āḥ drug pa lha bskyed bya ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung rnam dag e yi dkyil 'khor la: rang grub las byung 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i gur: rang snang rnam dag rtsa gsum pho brang bkra: de dbus nyi zla padma brtsegs khri la: gu ru padma snang srid zil gnon sku: sku mdog dkar dmar zhi ma khro ba'i nyams: pad zhwa ber phod chos gos sham thabs gsol: phyags g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdeng thabs 'dzin: g.yon pas bhandha kha ṭwāṃ mnyam par bzhag: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs lhun chags brjid: de yi phyir rol mtsho rgyal manda ra: rje 'bangs nyer lnga lung zin skyes chen dang : phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: yi dam nor lha chos skyong dregs sde sogs: gzhan yang 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i: lha srin gzhi bdag rigs drug ma lus pa: skar tshogs bkra ltar gsal snang mi g.yo'i ngang : 'ja' 'od gur chen thig le'i klong du gsal: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'od zer gyis: 'og min chos dbyings dpal ri padma 'od: gang du bzhugs kyang gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bdun pa spyan 'dren pa ni: dri zhim spos bdug rol mo dbyangs snyan bya: hūm̐ hrīḥ lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: o rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : bla med gsang ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: chos dbyings bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: rje 'bangs nyer lnga rig 'dzin grub thob dang : drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma gshegs su gsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i pho brang nas: yi dam nor lha chos skyong ma lus dang : bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: brtse zhing gdung ba'i thugs rjes gshegs su gsol:

rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ brgyad pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: seng khri nyi zla padma rin chen dang : dar 'bol la sogs rang rang dgyes gdan la: mi g.yo bde stong rol pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: gnyis su med par gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ dgu pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi mchod sna bdun nang mchod sman raka gtor: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bde chen rig ma dang : rin chen maṇḍal gha ṇa 'dod 'byung rdzas: sna tshogs mchod pa ma tshang med pa 'di: bla med gsang ba'i lha tshogs bcas la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhūṣpe sogs? āḥhūm̐: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa parshe pū dza hoḥ sarba pañtsa a mri ta rakta bha lingta la khā hi khā hi: bcu pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: ya mtshan ngo mtshar rmad byung chos kyi rgyal: 'gro mgon pad 'byung sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i mnga' bo che: mtsho rgyal lha lcam gsang ye ḍākki'i tshogs: rje 'bangs nyer lnga rig 'dzin tshogs la bstod: sgrub la dngos grub gter ba'i las mdzad pa'i: yid bzhin nor lha chos skyong srung ma dang : bla med gsang ba'i lha tshogs bcas la bstod: de ltar bstod cing phrin las bskul phyir du: sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes gtso bo'i bsnyen pa bya ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: ci mang bzlas: thams cad rigs 'dus spyi sngags ni: oṃ ha ri ni sa dharma pā la sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: mchod bstod yig brgya dbyangs gsal bya/

thun mtshams gtor 'bul: las bzhi'i sham bu ni: zhi ba la: shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa la: puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang la: wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drag po la: mā ra ya phaṭ: ci 'grub bzlas: skabs 'dir gtor bsngos bya: rang rang gi chos skyong gang 'os mchod: de nas tshogs rdzas bsangs shing tshogs bdud rtsis bran: rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi: thugs las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros pa yis: tshogs kyi ma dag 'bag btsog bsregs gtor bkrus: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa las: tshogs rdzas stong gsum khyon gang gsal bar gyur: ha ho hrīḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: skye med snang stong chos sku'i pho brang nas: 'gags med gsal stong 'od lnga'i thig le'i klong : bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs nas kyang : dam tshig mchog gi tshogs mchod 'di bzhes la: byang chub sgrub pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang : 'dir tshogs skal ldan bdag cag rjes 'dzin la: mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī gha na tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: zhes tshogs phud phul: gnyis pa thugs dam bskang ba ni: hūm̐: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dang : phyi mchod nang mchod dar gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs: rten rdzas sgrub rdzas dngos 'byor yid kyi sprul: mchod rdzas bskang rdzas ma tshang med pa 'dis: rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam bskang : mtsho rgyal lha lcam ḍākki'i thugs dam bskang : rje 'bangs rig 'dzin grub thob thugs dam bskang : gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes thugs dam bskang : e haṃ lo ha badzra thugs dam bskang : drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : yi dam rgya mtsho nor lha'i thugs dam bskang : chos skyong drag po sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : bka' gter lha btsan chen po'i thugs dam bskang :

bla med gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : gzhan yang 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das dang : rigs drug lha srin gzhi bdag ma lus pa: kun tu rol rtsal chos sku'i klong du bskang : de ltar thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i phyir: rang bzhin thig le chen po ro gcig tu: rdzogs pa chen po chos dbyings rang grol shog: gsum pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag gi tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las gyur pa'i: sdig pa mi dge'i las rnams ci mchis pa: snying nas 'gyod pas khyed mdun mthol lo bshags: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya bzlas: de nas lha tshogs thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: deng 'dir drag po'i las la sku skyod cig: dgra bgegs log 'dren byad ma ma lus par: rno ngar mtshon gyi char pa dbab pa'i phyir: las byed pho nya 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: myur du bkug cing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: bzhi pa hom bskyed pa ni: liṅga chu gtsang gis bran la: phaṭ: mdun du drag po gru gsum lcags kyi khang : nga rgyal ri nyil 'dod chags chu tshan khol: zhe sdang me 'bar gti mug mun pa gtibs: phrag dog rlung 'tshub thog ser 'brug sgra sgrogs: bskal pa'i rlung yang bgrod du mi rung nang : bar chad dgra bgegs gnod byed gang yin pa: gzugs phung skam rid yan lag lcags sgrog bsdams: 'gul byed med par nyam thag nyon mongs gyur: phaṭ: lnga pa bsgral 'dren bya ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bla med rtsa gsum dkon mchog kun 'dus pa: dpal chen padma drag po'i lha tshogs kyis: bden pa chen pos gnod byed ma lus pa: gzugs ling 'di la rang dbang med par khug: phur pas sgrol la ral gris gtub par gyur: rnam par shes pa chos dbyings klong du ho: ye grol mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas thob par shog:

hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ ral gris gtubs la: drug pa zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba'i lha tshogs zhal phyes la: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: skye med ye shes lnga ldan zhal du bstab: 'gags med bag chags chos dbyings klong du rol: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: bdun pa lhag ma ni: hūm̐ bhyo: gnas nyul dur khrod brgyad la 'gyu ba ni: lhag bdud ma mo ging dang laṅka'i tshogs: g.yang gzhi gos gyon bhandha phyag na bsnams: dur khrod 'grim zhing rnal 'byor tshogs khang nyul: 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i sems bzlog sdang ba'i dgra bgegs bsgral: u tstshiṣṭa bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: dgu pa chad tho bya ba ni: hūm̐: bsam yas ma la mchims phu gnas mchog nas: padma 'byung gnas ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : rje 'bangs nyer lnga rig 'dzin grub thob kyis: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: chos skyong dregs pa che btsan thams cad kyis: rang rang srog snying phul nas khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran gyis la: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus tshod 'dir: rmu rgod gdug pa 'dre rgod kha dar na: dgra bgegs log 'dren byad ma rdul du rlog: phyi yi snang ba thams cad dbang du sdud: nang gi rtsa rlung thig le'i bkrag mdangs spel: gsang ba dug lnga'i bar chad dbyings su sol: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bcu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐ bhyo: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ma: dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i brtan skyong ya ma'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas bka' yi gtor ma long : rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam don chos 'phel mdzod: ma ma dung dung sarba i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bcu gcig pa rta bro brdung ba ni:

hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag padma drag po rtsal: stong gsum shig shig 'gul ba'i bro brdungs pas: dam sri dgra bgegs bar chad thams cad ni: ri rab 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong 'og tu mnan: nam yang mi ldang mi shigs rgya yis gdab: bag chags chos sku ka dag ngang du grol: oṃ nan: a nan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bzed: dngos grub zhu chog bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla med bde ba chen po'i mkha' dbyings nas: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bo pad 'byung gi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dngos grub kun: da lta nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol: 'gyur med 'gags med 'khrul med dbang thob nas: lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs smin shog: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥsarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ dkyil 'khor rdzogs rim dgongs pa lta ba ni: lha tshogs mi dmigs 'ja' tshon lta bur yal: bzlas brjod mi dmigs brag cha lta bu rdzogs: dran rig ngo bo ka dag blo las 'das: ye grol chos nyid lta ba stong nyid bya: a āḥ hoḥ bdag gis tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i dge ba yis: sgrib gnyis byang zhing ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: mngon rdzogs thog ma'i sangs rgyas sku 'grub shog:

smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i nus mthu byin rlabs kyis: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa ni rab thob nas: mthar thug rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams su: rig 'dzin padma'i zhabs drung skye ba yi: smon lam rgya chen btab bzhin 'grub par shog: bkra shis ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: rnam dkar dge tshogs bsod nam gong 'phel zhing : deng 'dir bkra shis bsam don yar zla ltar: gong nas gong du 'phel rgyas bkra shis shog: ces gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs par bya: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos nyid 'od gsal rdo rje'i tshigs rkang 'gyur ba med pa bde chen lha yi dga' ston zhes bya ba'am: rnam rol sgo chen theg dgu'i yang rtse zhes bya ba 'di yang : dam med log lta can la rdo rje rgya: kha tham rgya: -ithi rgya: 'di'i mdzad byang mi gsal yang mchod brjod padma gter bdag gling par mdzad 'dug pa dang sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs dang*/ tshig don mthun zhing zab pa byin che bar snang la sngar bdag gi yab mes kyi gdan sa gnam lcags ri khrod du tshes bcu dus mchod sogs phal cher 'di nyid la mdzad par snang ba'i tshul sogs la dpyad na/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje'i dgongs gter skor yin nam snyam mau/ 'di la dbang sogs mi snang zhing bsam lhun dbang bskur rgyas bsdus gang rung thob na chog par mngon no/ bab bcol smra ba kha cig rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma yin no zhes u tshugs smra ba snang mod rang gi rang la mchod brjod mdzad pa mi srid pas ches mi 'thad do zhes gu hyas smras so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // (zha)༄༅/ rtsa gsum bla ma sgrub pa'i las byang ye shes snying po rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki ni buddha lo ha badzra sarba siddhi hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /o rgyan pad 'byung thugs kyi sras gcig pu/

/sku gsum mngon gyur zab gsang bstan pa'i bdag /rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ sa ma ya/ zhes pa ni o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zab gter bka' bab shog ser bdun cu tsam gter las bzhes mdzad padma bka' thang dang*/ mi nub 'jam dbyangs grags pa pad gling sogs dang*/ gter kha so so nas mtshan nyer lngar grags pa/ gzhan yang rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' lung thams cad las bsngags pa'i rtags mtshan dang mthun par/ sems can thams cad smin grol byang sems lam la 'god nus pa'i 'gro don rgya chen 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid do/ de'ang bla ma sgrub pa'i rgyun khyer 'di'i dgos don mdo tsam brjod na/ bka' gter gsar rnying thams cad du/ sgrub pa kun gyi nang nas ni/ bla ma sgrub pa mchog tu gsungs/ gsang 'dus las/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje las/ tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs snying po ru/ don rtogs med na bla ma sgrub/ ces dang*/ dgongs 'dus las/ bskal pa 'bum gyi sangs rgyas kyang : bla ma gnyen par shes par bya: ci phyir bskal pa'i sangs rgyas kyang : bla ma dag la brten nas byung : gsang ba 'dus pa las/ gang gi gdul bya'i zhing bzhin du/ /bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs brtsams te/ /de nyid don du sus gnyer ba/ /theg chen bla ma'i sa non cing*/ /kun gyi bdag nyid chen por gyur/ zhes dang*/ rang gter bder 'dus las/ bla ma sgrub pa grub gyur nas: bcu gsum bla ma'i sa 'grub ste: 'chi med rdo rje'i skur gyur nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su 'god: ces so/ rab 'byams rgyal kun spyi 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma sgrub par byed pa la/ thog mar gnas dben zhing sa gtsang yid du 'ong ba'i stegs bu'i khar bla ma'i sku 'bag /gsung rten glegs bam/ thugs rten mchod rten gzhan yang bla gtor zlum po bag dro byin chags rgyan mdzes dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gsol mchod rgyun gtor sogs dang*/

sman raka gtor gsum phyi nang gi mchod pa sgrub pa'i yo byad nyer mkho sogs gang yod bkod la/ dang po mi phyed dwang ba'i gdung dbyangs drag po'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na moḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo bla ma'i sku/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mgon po rdo rje 'chang*/ /nges don rang rig bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /skyabs su mchi'o thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ gnyis pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ ma gyur 'gro ba shing rta'i 'phang lo ltar/ /gnyis snang 'khrul pa ma rig sdug bsngal myong*/ /bde ba byang chub lam la 'god bya'i phyir/ /yang dag bla med sa la sems bskyed do/ / gsum pa yan lag bdun pa bla med sa thob ni/ na moḥ chos rnams ngo bo skye 'gag bral ba la/ /gnyis med khyab brdal klong nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros med de bzhin nyid kyis mchod pa 'bul/ /dug lnga rang sar ma grol mthol lo bshags/ /bde stong zung 'jug ngang nas rjes yi rang*/ /theg chen chos 'khor bskor bar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dus gsum dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo/ gsum pa gnyis 'dzin bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig nga bdag 'byung po bgegs tshogs rigs/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir khug /a 'thas nyon mongs 'khor bar ma 'khyams par/ /dengs phyir chos dbyings klong nas bde bar dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro gnas cing sdod pas na/ /nga nyid ye shes lnga yi rtsal chen 'gyed/ /rnam rtog lnga phung gnyis snang rdul du rlog /re dogs zhen pa'i bag chags rdul brlag gyur/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod cing*/ oṃ badzra kro ta hya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ bzhi pa lta ba'i gur khang ni/ hūm̐/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i gur khang phub/ /dmigs med lta ba'i dgongs yangs nas/ /'dzin med 'ub chub gur khang gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ bzhi pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs/ /dus gsum spros bsags dmigs med mchod pa 'bul/ /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i mchod rdzas kun/ /bla ma yi dam rgyal ba mnyes gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ sman raka gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ lnga pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur dang snang mtha' yas/ /rang rig ka dag chos skus byin phob cig /shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i pho brang nas/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*/ /rang bzhin gsal ba longs skus byin phob cig /dpal ri padma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /sprul sku dga' rab pad 'byung bi ma la/ /sna tshogs ma 'gags sprul skus byin phob cig /bod yul dben gnas so so'i sgrub gnas nas/ /buddha dzñā na rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis byin phob cig /zab mo rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas/ /pad 'byung gnyis pa rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /zab mo'i bka' bab rnams kyis byin phob cig /chos dbyings bde chen yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /drin can rtsa brgyud bla mas byin phob cig /chags med bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas/ /ma sring ḍākki kun gyi mnga' bdag mo/ /ā yur dhe wa dhā ras byin phob cig /gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang nas/ /dbang gi rgyal po rta phag yab yum dang*/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis byin phob cig /dur khrod rngam brjid rol pa'i pho brang nas/ /dam can chos skyong gter bdag dang bcas pas/ /bar chad dgra bgegs sel phyir byin phob cig /zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'dzum mdangs ya la la/ khro bo'i lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri/

/ma mo mkha' 'gro'i glu dbyangs kyu ru ru/ /chos skyong srung mas las byed sha ra ra/ /dpa' bo dpa' mos bro brdung khrabs se khrab/ /rol mo glu dbyangs dga' bro khrigs se khrig /dri zhim spos dud na bun thu lu lu/ /dug lnga rang grol rtog tshogs ta la la/ /bla ma yi dam byin rlabs thibs se thib/ /gnas gsum dbang bskur snang bzhi zad sar skyol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen myur du phob/ oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī dharma pā la sarba sa ma ya a āḥ drug pa brda sgo dbye zhing mjal phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang rig gdod nas yang dag bla ma'i sku/ /skye 'gag blo 'das bral ba'i brda sgo dbye/ /ma yengs mi sgom rig stong rjen pa'i ngang*/ /ma byas lhun grub dkyil 'khor mjal phyag 'tshal/ oṃ gu ru lo ha badzra shuddhe āḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ bdun pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol pa 'byams klas pas/ /mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig srog ltar bsrung*/ /skye ba tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral bar/ /dpal ldan bla ma nam yang mi btang bzung*/ brgyad pa ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐/ 'di ltar bden gnyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ye stong spros bral rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /gzung 'dzin spang blang mtha' bral chos nyid ngang*/ /rig stong chos dbyings khyab gdal de ltar smras/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā haṃ/ dgu pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ hūm̐/ stong pa'i ngang las e yi gur khang ni/ /e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ suṃ keṃ bhrūm̐ yig las/ /mkha' rlung me chu sa gzhi zang thal klong*/ /bhrūm̐ las rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang*/ /shar grol blo yis bkod pa bsam las 'das/ /sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor brgyad dang ldan/ /drwa phyed mda' yab rin chen chun pos spras/ /'phan gdugs bla re tog dang rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba ris/ /shar lho nub byang kun kyang rang mdog gsal/

/zhing khams bkod pa dran rdzogs wal gyis bsgom/ bcu pa lha tshogs gsal ba ni/ hūm̐/ de dbus dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /padma nyi zla baṃ ro'i gdan steng du/ /dbang chen yab yum zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas thod khrag 'dzin/ /bdud bzhi zil gnon zhabs gnyis dor thabs bgrad/ /dbu gtsug rta zhal ljang khu phag zhal nag /dur khrod chas brgyad rus rgyan stag sham gsol/ /mgo phreng do shal glang ko zhing lpags brgyan/ /sku mdog dmar smug 'od zer me dpung bzhugs/ /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /rigs kun khyab bdag o rgyan rtsa gsum gling*/ /phyag g.yas rig stong gser rdor thugs kar bsnams/ /g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bhandha tshe bum bsnams/ /sprul sku'i cha lugs dbu la pad zhu gsol/ /thugs dbus gsal byed sangs rgyas ye shes ni/ /sku mdog dmar smug he ru ka pa'i chas/ /rdo rje phur pa gdeng thabs mkha' la phyar/ /de dbus o rgyan rdor 'chang chos kyi sku/ /nam mkha'i mdog can mthing 'tsher gzi brjid 'bar/ /phyogs bzhi padma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng du/ /shar du rdo rje thod phreng yab yum ni/ /sku mdog dkar po dar dkar rus rgyan spras/ /rdo rje lcags kyu gri gug bhan mar bsnams/ /lho ru rin chen thod phreng yab yum ni/ /sku mdog ser po dar dang rus rgyan gsol/ /ratna zhags pa gri gug bhandha 'dzin/ /nub tu padma thod phreng yab yum ni/ /sku mdog dmar po dar dang rus rgyan spras/ /padma lcags sgrog gri gug bhandha bsnams/ /byang du karma thod phreng yab yum ni/ /sku mdog ljang gu dar dang rus rgyan spras/ /rgya gram dril bu gri gug bhandha bsnams/ /thugs dbus buddha thod phreng yab yum ni/ /gnam lcags 'khor lo gri gug bhandha 'dzin/ /sku mdog smug po dar dang rus rgyan gsol/ /zhi ma khro la gzi brjid ldan par bsgom/

hūm̐/ de yi phyi rim bar mtshams su/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can dang*/ /nor lha gter bdag gter srung tshogs/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi phyogs skyong bcas/ /sprin dang khu rlangs 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /snang la rang bzhin ma grub par/ /yid yul gsal stong 'dzin med bsgom/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal buddha dzñā na lo ha badzra ratna padma karma hya gṛ wa badzra ra hi hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya badzra ḍākki ging ka ra badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dang po spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang 'tshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: yul ni bod yul mchims phu ru/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dngos grub brnyes/ /rdzu 'phrul brag la phur pa btab/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gshegs su gsol/ /ma bcos lhun grub gzhal yas nas/ /zab mo'i gter rgya dngos grub brnyes/ /rdzu 'phrul mkha' la bya ltar lding*/ /gter bdag gling pa gshegs su gsol/ /rang snang ka dag gzhal yas nas/ /skyes mchog sprul pa'i skur ston pa/ /rig pa rang grol dngos grub brnyes/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /sgyu lus dag pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /yi dam dbang chen yab yum dang*/ /rigs bzhi yab yum ging bzhi bcas/ /bde ba chen po'i dngos grub stsol/ /bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas/ /chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho dang*/ /mo rgyud ma mo 'khor dang bcas/ /bar chad sel phyir gshegs su gsol/ gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ

'dzab dbyangs bzla ba ni/ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ yid 'ong 'ja' tshon pad zla'i gdan/ /bde stong gnyis med dgyes par bzhugs/ /dam tshig ye shes dbyer med par/ /thugs yid gnyis med sku bzhugs 'tshal/ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī tiṣṭha lhan/ gsum pa mjal phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na moḥ bde chen ngo bo chos kyi sku/ /gsal stong rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje ma 'gags sprul pa'i sku/ /sgrib gnyis 'dag phyir mjal phyag 'tshal/ a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ bzhi pa phyi nang gsang mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma rtsa gsum lha tshogs la/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo'i mchod pa phul/ /nang mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg /gsang mchod bde stong sbyor sgrol dang*/ /sman dang rakta gtor ma dang*/ /dug lnga ru tra ma rungs bsgral/ /snang srid 'khor 'das mchod sprin gtibs/ /ji snyed lus dang longs spyod bcas/ /blos blangs yid sprul mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ ma traṃ ru tra mā ra ya phaṭḥ

lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma bcos lhun grub ka dag ngang nyid las/ /'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan rtsa gsum gling*/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs dbus padma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /gnubs kyi lo tsā dmar smug khro 'dzum nyams/ /he ru ka pa longs sku'i cha lugs can/ /zhabs gnyis rol stabs buddha dzñā nar bstod/ /de dbus pad zla bde stong yangs pa'i gnas/ /chos sku rdor 'chang padma 'byung gnas ni/ /phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs/ /o rgyan rdor 'chang yab yum sku la bstod/ hūm̐/ stong gsal ma bcos thugs rje chen po'i sku/ /rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i klong*/ /yum mchog phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs las 'od zer phyogs bzhir spros pa las/ /rigs lnga thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mngon spyod las la rngam pa'i dur khrod nas/ /bka' sdod chos skyong yongs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs/ /rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yin pa la/ /ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa mthol lo bshags/ /dbyer med dgongs klong ngang du bzod par gsol/ oṃ gu ru badzra sa twa sa ma sogs sa twa āḥ 'dzab dbyangs bzla ba ni/ bde mchog chos dbyings pho brang du/ /rang nyid dbang chen yab yum gsal/ /spyi gtsug padma zla ba'i steng*/ khyab bdag bla ma rtsa gsum gling*/ /thugs kar rigs bdag sngags phreng rnams/ /grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs/ /spros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod/ /bsdus pas byin rlabs bdag la thim/ /'gro drug sems can sgrib pa sbyangs/ /bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru ma phyin bar/ /srog phyir mi gtong sgrub la brtson/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob gyur cig /oṃ gu ru lo ha badzra sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/

sangs rgyas ye shes sngags ni/ oṃ gu ru buddha dzñā na ā yuḥsiddhi hrīḥ rigs 'dus pad 'byung rdor 'chang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: spyi dril sgrub pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ las sbyor/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsitta hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ sarba siddhi hrīḥ bsnyen mtshams su gsol ba btab pa ni/ na mo gu ru lo ha badzra sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas dbang po/ rgyud lung man ngag mdzod 'dzin/ o rgyan pad 'byung rang mkhyen no/ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin/ gu ru padma'i rnam rol/ /sa steng grub thob dbang po/ sangs rgyas ye shes mkhyen no/ bdud 'dul sngags kyi gling nas/ gter chen brgya rtsa'i dbang po/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gnam lcags rdo rje rang mkhyen no/ zab mo klong yangs ngang nas/ lta ba khyung chen rgyal po/ gter kha mtsho las zab pa'i/ gter bdag gling pa mkhyen no/ spros med spros bral ngang nas/ bya bral rdzogs chen rnal 'byor/ /gdod ma'i mgon po'i pho nya/ /rtsa gsum gling pa mkhyen no/ zab gsang brda bzhi'i bka' bab/ rgyal dbang chen po'i thugs sprul/ gsang mtshan nyer lngar grags pa/ hūm̐ nag drag rtsal mkhyen no/ bdag cag snying dbus zhugs nas/ mos ldan bu slob rgyud la/ thugs rjes yal bar ma dor/ /rtse gcig 'bral med bzhugs mdzod/ 'o dod lhang lhang 'bod na/ gdong pa mchil mas 'dag pa'i/ kha tshig tsam gyis min par/ snying khung rus pa'i gting nas/ skye ba tshe rabs kun tu/ mi 'bral rtag tu bzhugs mdzod/ rang gzhan don gnyis kun la/ thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad nas/ thugs rjes phyogs bcur khyab pa'i/ gsol ba rgyun du 'debs so/

dal 'byor rin chen mi lus/ nor bu gling du sleb dus/ stong log lag stong min par/ snying po lon par shog cig /tshe 'di'i snang zhan bya gzhag /mi rtag rkyen gyi phung po/ rtag par 'dzin med ngang nas/ mi rtag rgyud la skyes shog /'gro ba drug gi 'khor lo/ sdug bsngal thar med rgya mtsho'i/ las 'bras bslu ba med par/ byang chub sems mchog thob cig /sdom pa dam tshig gtsang zhing*/ /mthun rkyen dben pa'i phyogs su/ /re dogs mdud pa grol nas/ gsang sngags nyams su len cing*/ /ma dag sgyu ma'i lus 'di/ rtsa thig rlung gsum sbyangs nas/ rlung sems dbyer med 'dres te/ dwangs ma lha skur smin shog /lha 'dre sems su shes shing*/ snyems thag nang du chod nas/ brtul zhugs 'gro don nus par/ pha yis byin gyis rlobs shig /thogs med sems kyi rta pho/ srid pa drug la 'khor ba'i/ ngo sprod gdams ngag don rtogs/ skad cig yengs med bsgom med/ mnyam rjes nyin mtshan gcig 'dres/ rig pa thog mtha' med pa'i/ 'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i/ sku ru byin gyis rlobs shig /bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ brgya rtsa brjod/ bla ma'i gnas gsum las dbang bzhi len cing lag thal mo sbyar/ gdung dbyangs drang po'i ngang nas 'd-i skad do/ / hūm̐/ bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor du/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las/ /'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ /bdag gi sgo gsum thim nas kyang*/ /snang grags ting 'dzin bsgom par dbang*/ /sku gsum rang la smin par gyur/ /'gyur med sku dang 'gags med gsung*/ 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /yon tan re skong phrin las sgrubs/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung dngos grub stsol/ 'chi med tshe dang zad med nor/ /dbang thang snyan grags rgyud 'dzin dang*/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol/
