oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rdo rje'i skur ldang ba ni/ hūm̐/ gsal snang bskyed rim dkyil 'khor nas/ /dmigs med lha tshogs 'ja' ltar gshegs/ /slar yang dam tshig sems dpa' yi/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang bzhugs 'tshal/ badzra muḥ a a āḥ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod pa ni/ e ma hoḥ bdag gzhan dus gsum dge bsags 'dis/ /rigs drug bla ma'i sa thob nas/ /byang chub mchog tu bsngo bar bya/ /yang dag sangs rgyas thob par shog /hūm̐/ chos sku'i bkra shis drug pa rdo rje 'chang*/ /bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /longs sku'i bkra shis buddha dzñā na ba/ /gsal stong mtha' dbus bral ba'i bkra shis shog /sprul sku'i bkra shis sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling*/ /thugs rjes phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /yang sprul bkra shis mchog gi yang srid dang*/ /gdul bya 'gro don rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis ḍākki seṅge'i gdong*/ /sgrub pa'i bar chad sel ba'i bkra shis shog /yi dam bkra shis dbang chen yab yum rnams/ /mchog gi dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog /chos skyong bkra shis dpal mgon sde lnga rnams/ /bstan dgra gdug pa tshar gcod bkra shis shog /bla ma slob dpon mched lcam thams cad rnams/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs pa'i bkra shis shog / bkra shis gang shes brjod/ dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang la gnas/ man ngag kun gyi yang bcud bla sgrub 'di/ /thun mong ma yin khyad du 'phags pa'o/ /skal ldan kun gyis nyams su blang gyur na/ /'bras bu gsang sngags theg chen rgyas pa dang*/ /tshe gcig nyid du grol bar the tshom med/ ces pa 'di'ang mched grogs sras nor 'grub dang dge slong gtsang sprug bcas slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor ldog ma shes shing*/ rang la yang rig 'dzin bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i ltas dang dag snang phran bu shar bas/

rab byung bcu drug pa sbrul lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin padma gter bdag gling pa'i skyes phreng lnga pa nges don chos dbyings rang grol pas 'phral du smras bzhin yi ge pa ni ratna karmas 'du bgyis pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // (za)༄༅/ bla ma rtsa ba'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu dbu phyogs bzhugs so/ rtsa gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa ni/ rtsod med gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma las/ tsha ba'i yul med na rgya skyegs kyi nus pa mi 'go: dad pa'i zhing sa med na byang chub kyi myu gu mi skye: zhes dang*/ rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' las/ nges don ston pa'i bla ma de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa yin/ /rang la sangs rgyas kun las lhag /ces pa bzhin/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i sku brnyan bye ba phrag brgya/ bla ma la tshang zhing mchog thun gang 'dod kyi dngos grub gegs med myur char 'bebs pa'i bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la/ lus ngag yid gsum mos gus gdung ba drag po'i 'chi ba srog dang bral yang dam tshig mig 'bras ltar srungs shing*/ 'di phyi kun tu re sa yin snyam pa'i blo rgya 'gyur med brtan po zhig dgos pa yin no/ de lta bu'i bsgrub na 'grub sla zhing nam yang mi bslu nges pas/ tsha shas can chu la gdung ba ltar dben gnas su phun sum tshogs par maṇḍal mda' gang gdab pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ sku rten 'dra 'bag gam slob dpon gyi sku dang*/ bum pa dar gyi mgul chings can/ gsung rten glegs bam/ thugs rten rin po che'i mchod gdung*/ yon tan gyi rten la gtor ma gdan gor mo gsum brtsegs kyi steng bshos bu dkar zlum pad 'dab bzhi'i spras pa/ rtse mor bla ma'i sku dang 'ja' 'od pa tra sogs yid mgu ba'i bzo khyad par can bzhag /phrin las kyi rten la rdor dril gzhan/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs phyir bla ma la 'os tshad kyi spel mchod sogs yo byad phra zhib phun sum tshogs par bya ste/

bdag mdun zhal sprod kyi bde ba'i stan la bag pheb par 'dug la/ rlung sems yeng med ngang nas spos bsreg /skyil krung bcas gu gul bdug ste bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ mtshams sbyar gsol 'debs ni/ hrīḥ rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus padma 'byung*/ /gsang gsum mi zad mdzod 'dzin rtsa gsum gling*/ /rlung sems dbang bsgyur mi 'jigs rdo rje rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gsal stong bskyed rim rtsal rdzogs chu zla'i gar/ /grags stong nus pa'i rtsal 'byin rdo rje'i bzlas/ /rig stong dug lnga'i thug phrad lam khyer rdzogs/ /klong yangs rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /sna tshogs snang ba rang grol byin gyis rlobs/ /gar dgu'i rtsal 'chang sde brgyad ar la gtad/ /snying rje'i rgyud bskul stong gsum lha srin btul/ /nus pa'i rtsal 'chang mi 'jigs rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /'byung bzhi lus kyi nad gdon bar chad zlog /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bden tshig gis/ /mi rtag 'byung 'dus lus 'di bor ma thag /bde chen dag pa'i zhing der skye bar shog khri dmar gdung rigs dpal mos bskul ngor/ rig pa 'dzin pa mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // de ltar sprul sku'i gsol 'debs ni/ zab gsang rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rgyal ba'i dbang*/ /ma lus gcig bsdus yongs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku/ /gsang sngags cho sgra'i snyan dbyangs phyogs bcu ru/ /grags pas sa gsum khyab mdzad padma 'byung*/ /gang de'i thugs rje rgya mtsho'i zlos gar las/ /sprul pa'i gar rol rig 'dzin rje/ /mchog gsum ngo bo khyed kyi zhabs pad drung*/ /gus pa chen po'i sor bcu thal sbyar nas/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i mgon gyi dad dpon ru/ 'di phyi bde ba'i rtsa lag 'phel rgyas nas/

/ris med 'gro la rtag tu skyong gyur cig / ces pa'ang rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje rin po che de nyid kyi yang srid gtsug phud yang dgon 'phags mchog sprul skus mtshan gsol ba'i tshig don dang sbyar ba'i gsol 'debs ārya dhwa dzas sbyar ba'o/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid ye nas ma hā gu ru'i sku/ /rang bzhin snying rje lcags kyu phyogs bcur 'phros/ /ma rig log 'dren gnyis 'dzin bgegs rnams khug /ting 'dzin drag pos dbang med dam du bcing*/ /oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ nyon gcig log 'dren 'khrul 'byams gdon gyi tshogs/ /deng nas brtsam ste thal ba'i rdul phran gtor/ /de bas ma 'dug sgom med klong du dengs/ /oṃ ma hā gu ru swa bhā wa gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭ/ srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma'i thugs las las bzhi'i phyag mtshan 'phros/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar med khyab par gtams/ /nang rnams ting 'dzin mi shigs go char ldan/ /rgyud 'dzin grwa slob badzra rakṣa bhrūm̐/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐/ phyi mchod ratna'i snod mchog rgya che dbus/ /nang bcud dpag yas kun bzang mchod sprin gtib/ /nang mchod sman gtor rakta'i lha mo 'phros/ /gsang mchod bde stong sbyor sgrol bla na med/ /spyan gzigs mchod pa maṇḍal phun sum tshogs/ /don mchod bsgoms med blo 'das lhun grub gyur/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭha/ byin dbab pa ni/ spos bsreg dar tshon g.yab/ rol mo dkrol/ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ 'og min phyogs bcu'i zhing khams klong yangs nas/ /rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus rnams/ /gzi byin dpal 'bar lam me byin phob cig /byin chen phob la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /mthu stobs gad rgyangs rab sgrogs dkyil 'khor nas/ /rngam klong me 'od khro char dang bcas te/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde'i yi dam byin phob cig /byin chen phob la dge bcu'i bar chad sgrol/

/rnga yab dpal ri 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i lha tshogs khrom tshogs ltar/ /pha gcig padma 'byung gnas? byin chen phob la zhwa dmar bstan pa rgyas/ /shes rab rtsal shar rgyud sde'i dbyings klong dbus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro char sprin gtib gnas su/ /ma gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal? byin chen phob la byin 'bebs myur shugs stsol/ /mnyam med rjes 'brangs rgya mtsho'i gral ring la/ /sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs lo paṇa rnams/ /byin chen phob la ring lugs rgyas par stsol/ /zab rgya mi zad rdo rje'i lde mig nas/ /gnubs ston mi gzugs bzhad pa 'gro ba'i mgon/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes? byin chen phob la mkhyen gnyis yon tan stsol/ /spyi gtsug dung khang bde chen 'khor lo nas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yid bzhin nor bu nyid/ khyab bdag mi 'jigs rdo rjes? byin chen phob la mchog thun char ltar phob/ /'dzam gling gangs can phyogs bcu'i dgon sde nas/ /'gro la ma nor lam mchog ston mdzad pa/ /chos bdag las can 'dus sdes byin? byin chen phob la bsod nams dbang thang stsol/ /bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bstan la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs bcom mdzad pa/ /dam can bka' skyong 'bum sdes byin phob cig /byin chen phob la phywa g.yang dkor nor sdud/ /chos sku'i byin 'bebs thugs rje sha ra ra/ /longs sku'i byin 'bebs bag dro me re re/ /sprul sku'i byin 'bebs nus rtsal khyugs se khyug /zhi ba'i lha tshogs gzi brjid dpal 'bar ldan/ khro bo'i lha tshogs gar dgu shigs se shig /chos skyong dam can las byed khyugs se khyug /nor lha dbang sdud dngos grub char ltar 'bebs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rol mo dar dpyangs bklubs/ /dri zhim spos ngad na bun thibs se thib/ /skal ldan bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la/ /'dod rgu dpal 'byor lhug par deng stsol cig /oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī dharma pā la a be sha ya tiṣṭha na ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/

zhes lha tshogs rnams nam mkha' gang bar skad cig gis glo bur mkha' la sprin tshogs ldang ba ltar/ dri zhim spos ngad ldan par byin thibs se byon te rang sems dang rten la thim par mos/ brda sgo brda bshags ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /mos pas mjal phyir brda yi sgo dbye 'tshal/ /ye nas don dam bla ma dbyer med kyang*/ /de don ma gtogs gdung bas bshags par bgyi/ oṃ gu ru badzra shuddhe āḥ dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐/ skal bzang rnam dkar dge ba'i smon shugs mthus/ /dam tshig srog gis bsdus pa'i lu gu rgyud/ /mi 'bral skye ba tshe rabs byang chub bar/ /nam yang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mi gtong bzung*/ /gu ru badzra sa ma ya tsitta āḥ ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐/ snang zhing stong pa brjod bral blo las 'das/ /de yi rang mdangs 'gyu ba gdod ma'i gshis/ /sna tshogs snang ba ma 'gag sa bon las/ /snang srid 'khor 'das ris med zhal phyag rdzogs/ oṃ badzra swa bhā wa haṃ/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs gzhal yas bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ ye nas e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐/ nam mkha' rlung me dbang chen gser gyi gzhi/ /de steng bhrūm̐ las rang byung gzhal yas khang*/ /phyi nang ris med ye shes 'od lnga brtsegs/ /tshad med sgo bzhi mi shigs rdo rje'i rwa/ /shar grol blo 'das rgya khyon rgyan bkod rdzogs/ /yul brgyad rnam dag 'phan dang phyogs bcur bklubs/ /blang dor 'dzin med shes rab tog gi spras/ /gdod ma'i kun bzang chos sku'i klong dgus gtams/ /zhing khams ma lus rang tshang gzhal yas khang*/ khang bzang lhun grub ma bcos lam gyis gsal/ / lha bskyed ni/ rgyu a ti bkod pa chen po las/ gang gi lha sku 'bum 'bum phrag bsgom pa bas/ /bla ma'i sku la dmigs pa ma log na/ /bsod nams stong phrag stong gis char mi 'gro/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bskal ba'i bar du'ang*/ bla ma rang sems dkyil du shar ba tsam/

/bsod nams stong phrag bcu yis char mi phod/ ces gsungs so/ hūm̐/ de dbus seng khri nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng*/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mi 'jigs rdo rje nyid/ /dmar zhing smug la snum pa'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /dpral mthongs 'bur zhing spyan gnyis nam mkhar gzigs/ /zhal ras khro 'dzum sma ra mdzes pas dkyud/ /dbu skra kham 'bol sku stod rgyab tu gzhol/ /phyag g.yas rig stong rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yon pas shes rab dril bu dku la brten/ /za 'og smug nag rdo rje'i gong lag can/ /stod 'bog gsol zhing dmar po'i sham thabs bklubs/ /dmar smug chos gos spras nas skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams/ /sku yi ba spu bye ba phrag brgya la/ /til gyi gong bu kha bye ji bzhin du/ /'ja' 'od dri zhim dang bcas lam mer gsal/ /spyi gtsug rigs bdag 'gro mgon padma 'byung*/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis snang srid zil gnon tshul/ /g.yas su yi dam bka' brgyad rgya mtsho dang*/ /g.yon du gsang ye ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor/ /de 'og g.yas zur gnod sbyin nor bdag gsal/ /g.yon zur dpal mgon chos skyong las byed ste/ /mtshan brgyad tshe lha dpag yas grangs med rnams/ /rgyab yol klong du mkha' la skar ltar bkra/ /tshangs dbang brgya byin la sogs lha brgyad kyi/ /gyad chen tshul gyis phyogs mtshams brgyad du gnas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros rol mo sna tshogs thogs/ /lha yi khye'u bye ba sprin tshogs ltar/ /dar gdugs rgyal mtshan phye 'phur dpag med phyar/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi phyogs skyong bcu rnams kyi/ /gus pa chen po'i seng khri btegs par byed/ /de mthar klu chen brgyad kyis nor bu 'bul/ /lha srin sde brgyad bka' gnyan gsung 'dod bsgrub/ /gzhi bdag yul skyong dam bsgrags phrin las gnyer/ /dzam lha nor bdag 'dod rgu'i gter rnams 'bul/ /gling bzhi skye 'gro 'byung bas bsdus pa yis/

/mi dang lha 'dre ji srid maṇḍal 'bul/ /dkar phyogs chos sbyin zab dgu'i gdams pa ster/ /rnam rol mchog gi bde la 'god par mdzad/ /thugs kar o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa ni/ /longs sku cha lugs phyag gnyis phur bu 'dril/ /de yi thugs kar gnubs ston buddha'i mtshan/ /sku mdog dmar gsal snang mtha'i cha lugs rdzogs/ /thugs dbus yid bzhin nor bu dbang rgyal la/ /rdo rje dmar smug hūm̐ mtshan sngags kyis bskor/ /de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer ni/ /mos ldan bu la thugs rje lcags kyu spros/ /skad cig ma la brtse bas bu gdung ltar/ /'ja' 'od dri zhim dang bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ spos bsregs rol mo sna tshogs ldir/ dar tshon g.yab/ dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ mi mngon rang snang chos dbyings dag pa'i klong*/ /ma bcos gang shar stong nyid zhing khams nas/ /'gro mgon drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje/ khyab bdag mi 'jigs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /gnas 'dir gshegs shing lus ngag yid la bstim/ /ci shar khyab gdal rgyun du gnas par stsol/ oṃ gu ru badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ a be sha ya kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ lhun grub rang byung pad nyi seng chen khri/ /bde stong gnyis med dgyes par bzhugs gnas su/ /'gro la smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣṭha badzra satwaṃ/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa ba'i bla ma mnyam med rin po che/ /thugs rje'i stobs mnga' khyed kyi zhabs pad drung*/ /sgo gsum gus pas snying dkyil kun bslang nas/ /sgyu lus 'dor nus 'phags med phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags ma lus bshags par bgyi/ a ti pu ho badzra shuddhe āḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla med kun bzang rmad du byung ba yis/ /phyi mchod rang byung dpag yas mchod sprin gtib/

/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rgyu mchog las/ /ye shes lnga sbyor sa bon yig 'bru zhu/ /rgyal ba rab 'byams bla ma'i tshogs lar 'bul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe? shabda āḥhūm̐/ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza āḥhūm̐/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ mtshan don sbyar ba ni/ oṃ āḥham̐'u/ kun bzang rdo sems dga' rab shrī seng*/ /zla bral 'gro mgon padma 'byung gnas sogs/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /bka' yi bsdu ba sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ /shog ser tshig brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /sman mchod 'bul? chos rgyal o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa dang*/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs/ /gter rgya brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ sman mchod? smon lam lung bstan brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ /'dzin skyong spel mdzad skyes chen thams cad la/ /sman mchod? sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon byin rlabs zhu/ /gnas gsum la thim chos sku rang bab shar/ /ma bcos mchog gi gnas lugs ngo mtshar che/ /bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med gcig tu gyur/ kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ gtor ma dang rakta ni/ hūm̐/ thugs rje'i rang mdangs gang shar snod mchog tu/ /rgyu rtsal ma 'gags chos sku'i gtor ma bsham/ /gdod ma'i lhun grub sna tshogs rgyan khra mdzes/ /dgag sgrub khregs chod lhug bzhag ngang nas 'bul/ /dbyings kyi lha mo'i mkha' nas babs pa yi/ /phar phyin drug ldan ma hā rakta 'bul/ /oṃ ma hā ba lingta rakta la kha kha khā hi/ don dam mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab rgyu rkyen snang cha las/ /rang rtsal ma 'gags sbyor ba'i byang sems dang*/ /nyon mongs gnyis 'dzin logs 'dren dgra gdon la/ /dpal chen phur gdab rnam shes mkha' ru spar/ /don dam mnyam rjes dbyer med ngang du 'bul/ oṃ swa bhā sha truṃ badzra padma pū dza kha kha khā hi/ rgyud a ti bkod pa chen po las/

bla ma bsgom dang bstod pa'i bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu cig car 'grub par nges/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma bcos gang shar mi shigs gdod ma'i mgon/ /mtshan 'dzin 'jigs bral zhi chos ngang du grol/ /rig pa'i klong rdol rtsa rlung rgya mdud grol/ /ngo mtshar yon tan kun rdzogs rje la bstod/ hūm̐/ 'gro mgon ma hā gu ru rin po che/ /zhi 'dzum spyan gnyis nam mkhar gzigs pa ni/ /chos sku'i phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i brda/ /dbu skra kham 'bol rgyab tu gzhol ba ni/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtib pa'i brda/ /dpral mthongs 'bur zhing lhod por bzhugs pa ni/ /sku gsum rig 'dzin bla mar rdzogs pa'i brda/ /smug nag rdo rje'i gong lag brgyan pa ni/ mu stegs log lta rgol ba 'joms pa'i brda/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnam pas ni/ /sde brgyad lha srin bran du khol ba'i brda/ /phyag g.yon dril bu dku la brten pa ni/ /gsang sngags chos rnams cig car rdzogs pa'i brda/ /dmar po'i sham thabs sku smad bklubs pa ni/ /srid gsum lha ma'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i brda/ /snum pa'i gzi 'od chos gos gsol ba ni/ /ring lugs 'dus sde bsod nams rgyas pa'i brda/ /thugs kar rtsa gsum gling pa bzhugs pa ni/ /'dzam gling sa steng chos la 'god pa'i brda/ /de yi snying dbus gnubs ston brgyan pa ni/ /gsang sngags dge 'dun 'gyur ba med pa'i brda/ /yid bzhin nor bur srog yig brgyan pa ni/ /gang 'dod dngos grub shugs la brdol ba'i brda/ /brda don rgyan rdzogs bla ma rje la bstod/ /chos sku rang shar rdzogs chen pa la bstod/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yid bzhin nor bur bstod/ /bstod cing nam yang bla ma brten pa'i mthus/ /rgyu 'bras bslu med rnam dkar dge mtshan rgyas/ /bsod nams stobs smin mchog gsum bden rtags rdzogs/ /nus mthu rtsal shar snang srid chos skur grol/

/'gro ba'i skyabs mgon gdul bya nyid dang mnyam/ /phun tshogs bde chen dpal la 'god gyur cig / bsnyen 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma'i thugs kar yid bzhin nor bu las/ /phyag mtshan sa bon sngags phreng 'od zer 'khor/ /'od zer nor bu'i rgyun babs phyogs bcur 'phros/ /rgyal ba mchod cing sems can sgrib sbyangs nas/ /stobs dang nus pa tshur bsdus bdag la thim/ /bsod nams bden gnyis mchog thun thob gyur cig / bsnyen pa ni/ dang po sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dzap ni/ oṃ buddha dzñā na siddhi hūm̐/ gnam lcags rdo rje'i bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ lo ha badzra siddhi hūm̐/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje'i srog yig ni/ oṃ gu ru arba badzra sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ rigs bdag padma'i snying po ni/ oṃ ma hā gu ru padma kā ra siddhi pha la hūm̐/ rang sgrub gang mos kyi bsnyen pa la 'bad pas chog go /tshad ni the tshom med par 'di phyi thams cad bla ma nyid kyi shes bsam/ blo khyed shes kyi 'dun pa gtad la/ rab bye ba/ 'bring 'bum gsum/ tha na 'bum tsho gcig song bar bzlas pas/ rab kyis rnal 'byor la dngos/ 'bring gi rnal 'byor la nyams snang gi skabs/ tha ma'i rnal 'byor la rmi lam sogs zhal mjal lung dang*/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor spyi ltar gyis 'grub rtags ltar 'byung*/ dang po dkyil 'khor kun gyi gong du bla ma'i rtsa sgrub 'di song na/ bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug /yi dam gyis dngos grub ster/ mkha' 'gros grogs bgyi/ chos skyong gis bka' sdod sgrub/ rnam dkar dge ba'i bsam pa thams cad dge legs myur du 'grub/ de phyir 'di la kun gyis 'bad par 'tshal/ de nas bsnyen tshad song nas mchog gsum ngo bo rig 'dzin byin rlabs bskul ba ni/ bskal bzang phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' spro dang*/ spos bsreg skyil krung bcas gus pa'i sor bcu snying khar sbyar te/ 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ thugs rje rmad byung 'gro ba'i mgon po rje/

/sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dpal gyi dbang*/ /brgyud 'dzin 'dus pa'i gral ring gnyan po 'dir/ /skya rengs dang por dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus/ /tshe chos zas nor stobs dang snyan grags srid/ /mnga' thang bsod nams phun tshogs yar zla ltar/ /'bru gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gyur/ /tshangs bug nas zhugs snying dbus pad gdan 'god/ /lus kun khyab nas chos srid rang shugs rdol/ /'bad med ya mtshan mngon gyur e ma ho/ oṃ padma kā ra buddha lo ha arba badzra kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ chos nyid gang shar gdod ma'i dbyings klong nas/ /chos skyong 'gyu ba phra mo dam ldan gyis/ /chos kyi bya ra lhang lhang shar ba rigs/ /chos la shar grol klong rdol 'dod rgu yis/ /shes rab 'chad med char rgyun lhug par byung*/ /shes rig bu la sgrib gsum ye nas med/ /shes brtson rang shar ye grol padma'i thugs/ /shes pa shes phebs 'dab brgyad rnam par phye/ /de'i shlau ka thol byung nyams mtshar ro/ bla ma'i las tshogs bcu gsum gzhan du gsal/ /da ni bsod nams tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir skyabs mchog rgyal ba'i ngo bo bla ma la tshogs 'khor 'bul ba ni/ 'jig rten 'dir srid tshad spod kyi bye brag phun sum tshogs par bsham ste/ hūm̐/ rang rig bla ma'i thugs las yig 'bru 'phros/ /ma dag bsreg gtor bkrus nas bdud rtsir bkug /dag pa ye shes rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas/ /bcud mchog rab 'byams tshang chen rdul snyed gyur/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ mi mngon gdod ma'i chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /mchog gsum ngo bo drin can bla ma la/ /rgyal kun ris med rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas/ /ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rmad byung gnyis med 'dus sde'i gral ring nas/ /bla med theg chen zhwa dmar dge 'dun sde/ /byin rlabs nus mthu gdams pas rtags 'khyud de/

/ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /g.yas g.yon rab 'byams rgyal kun lha yi tshogs/ /dpag med til gyi gong bu phyes pa bzhin/ /'ja' gur dri zhim rol mo'i bye brag bcas/ /ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren? dam ldan drag rtsal mngon spyod dur khrod nas/ /nyams pa'i bdud dgra byad ma gum mdzad pa/ /bka' skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams/ /ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /rmad byung bla med tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi/ /mchod sprin lha mo nam mkha'i gar bsgyur zhing*/ /rab 'byams lha la 'bul lo dgyes gyur cig /oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi/ bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ lhun grub chos dbyings bde chen snod mchog tu/ /'gyu ba ba zang thal mnyam nyid bskang rdzas gtams/ /snang srid 'khor 'das ma tshang med pa 'dis/ /rang shar rig stong ngang du thugs dam bskang*/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ rje btsun bla ma'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /mos gus gdung ba drag po'i yid kyis bshags/ /sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis yongs smin te/ /'bras bu bla med theg chen sa thob shog /gu ru badzra sa tw

sogs brjod la/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐/ mdun du dug lnga'i lcags khang gru gsum dbus/ /ma rig gnyis 'dzin dgra bgegs byad ma khug /gsal la 'dzin med dbal gyis phur bu 'dis/ /reg cing stong pa chos sku'i ngang du gdab/ oṃ swa bhā wa phaṭ/ zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐/ nyag gcig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal phyes shig /'khrul gzugs bag chags blang dor a 'thas dgra/ /rig pa stong la gsal ba'i sha khrag rus/ /ldog med gzhon nu bum sku'i mgrin par bstim/ /dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ s sogs brjod la/ dga' ston tshogs la rol/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ gdod ma'i dpal chen he ru ka'i/ /bka' gnyan gnas pa'i ma mo 'bum/ /'gyu bas tshogs kyi lhag ma longs/ /rig pa gang shar phrin las mdzod/ ces gtor ma phul/ bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba chos sku'i rang mdangs 'gags med du/ /cho rol rig pa'i rtsal shar gu ru rje/ /rmad byung rgyan 'khor mnga' bdag lha tshogs kyis/ /gsang gsum mi zad dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes/ /gdul bya srid pa'i rdzu 'phrul gar 'gyed la/ khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ chad tho ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus dang*/ khyad par bla ma'i spyan sngar dam nod pa'i/ /dpal ldan chos skyong rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis/ /tha tshig bzhin du gang bcol phrin la sgrubs/ /i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ brtan ma ni/ hūm̐/ bod yul skyong ba'i ma btsun bcu gnyis tshogs/ /lhab lhub gos gyon dam tshig las rjes gcod/ /gtor ma bzhes la yang zab ring lugs 'di/ /phyogs bcu yongs la khyab pa'i phrin las mdzod/ rta bro ni/ hūm̐/ stong gsum mi shigs ma bcos sa 'og tu/ /gang shar 'gags med 'chi bdag hom khung nang*/ /nag phyogs gnyis 'dzin sgab 'dre dam sri khug /sangs rgyas kun tu bzang pos rgyas gdab bo/ satwaṃ bha ya nan/ dngos grub bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ thugs rje rmad byung? sogs 'don/

bkra shis ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku'i bkra shis dbyings kyi klong yangs su/ /longs sku'i bkra shis chu 'dzin 'gyu ba las/ /sprul sku'i bkra shis rig pa'i char rgyun 'bebs/ /'gro kun bkra shis dad gus zhing sa ru/ /thams cad bkra shis gdod ma'i 'bras bu smin/ /phyogs bcu'i bkra shis 'dod rgu spyod gyur cig / bsngo ba ni/ ho/ bsngo byed gsal stong gzhi yi rig pa yi/ /bsngo bya bral ba gang shar lam gyi bsngo/ smon lam ni/ ho/ 'gro kun mtha' yas ma lus sems can kun/ /rnam dkar bde chen thar pa'i gling zhugs te/ /srid mtsho 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bral gyur nas/ /skye dang tshe rabs bla ma 'bral med shog / ces bla ma sgrub pa'i cha rkyen 'di'ang dgos chad ci zhe na/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i sku brnyan bye ba phrag brgya bla ma la tshang zhing*/ bla ma'i sku'i ba spu nyag gcig mchod pa'i bsod nams kyang bgrang du med pa rgyud lung kun nas gsungs pa bzhin/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes rang gi sgrub thab rang gis bkod cing rtsa sgrub bla ma'i las tshogs kyi srol byung bas/ rig 'dzin chen pos mdzad pa la tshad gar yod de/ dper na seṅge dang khyi'i lo rgyus kho na las mi 'dug kyang*/ gus pa chen por mkho ba'i phyir bris pas 'gal cha ma mchis te/ ci zhe na brgyud pa kun gyi bla ma'i sgrub pa brgyud 'dzin gyis bsgrigs pa'i srol byung ba bzhin/ bdag 'dras kun gyi don du dmigs nas/ dam pa de'i zhabs rdul gtsug rgyan du bkod cing brgyud 'dzin ārya dhwa dzas rang lo nyer gnyis thog /gnas chen gze rgyal mthong grol yon tan ljongs kyi gnas zhol/ pho brang bdud 'dul sngags gling du bla ma'i sku drin gso phyir tshes bzang du sbyar ba'o// // 'a) gnubs lo'i brgyud 'dzin kun gyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor dgos 'dod lhug stsol yid bzhin nor mchog bzhugs so/ tho rangs ma rig gti mug las bslang ste/

dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma drin can chos kyi rje la skyabs su mchi'o/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang?gnas gyur cig / lan gsum/ rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis bka' las/ nges don ston pa'i bla ma ni: sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa yin: rang la sangs rgyas dngos las lhag: ces dang*/ yang de nyid las/ gsang sngags nges pa'i don 'dod na: bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom par bya: rgyud a ti bkod pa chen po las/ gang gi lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa las: bla ma'i sku la dmigs pa ma logs na: bsod nams brgya phrag stong gi char mi 'gro: rdzogs pa'i rim pa bskal ba'i bar du yang : gang gi 'du 'dzi spang nas bsgom pa las: bla ma rang sems dkyil du shar ba tsam: bsod nams stong phrag nyi shu'i char mi phod: ces gsungs pas spro ba gting nas bskyed de bsgom pa ni/ na mo gu ru/ bdag tha mal rnal 'byor spyi bo'i gtsug /gdan gang gi do zla mi nus pa'i/ /chags zhen pa kun bral padma dang*/ /mchog khyed 'phags thabs shes nyi zla'i steng*/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /mgon sangs rgyas mi gzugs skur bzhengs pa/ /dpal khyab bdag mi 'jigs rdo rjes sku/ /zhal dmar smug dbang gi 'dzum mdangs can/ /skra lcang lo smug 'bol khrol le ba/ /phyag g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /thugs yid bzhin nor bu dbang rgyal gi /bsam 'phel ba'i 'dod 'byung snum 'od kyis/

/mdangs lnga ldan g.yo zhing me zer kyud/ /mos dad pas gsol 'debs 'bod pa'i mthus/ /ci bsam tshad dngos grub myur bar ster/ /zhabs bde stong mi g.yo skyil mo krung*/ /sku za 'og ser po stod g.yog dang*/ /smad ther smug sham thabs mdzes pas brgyan/ /phyi ber chos gsang gos dmar po klubs/ /yid brtse ba chen po'i wal gyis gsal/ rje'i gtsug rgyan ral pa'i gdan steng na/ /gnas ma bcos chos dbyings klong chen dbus/ /bdud ma rig ru tra brdzis pa'i steng*/ /rje gdod ma'i mgon po rtsa gsum gling*/ /dpal rigs pa rdo rje he ru ka /don chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog smug /dug gnyis 'dzin bdud 'dul sngags phod mthing*/ /g.yas shes rab phur bu gdengs thabs phyar/ /g.yon rig stong sdigs mdzub sked par brten/ /dbu shar grol ral pa shigs se ba/ /dbyings khyab gdal bya rog prog zhu gsol/ /yid mos pa'i mdun mkhar wal gyis gsal/ /mgon khyed kyi dbu gtsug rigs kyi bdag /zhing rab 'byams rgyal kun spyi yi gzugs/ /tshogs zhing kun ngo bo padma 'byung*/ /zhal dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs mnga' ba/ /dbu pad zhwa rgod kyi dang rus mtshan/ /phyag rdo rje bhandha kha ṭwāṃ bsnams/ /zhabs rgya lham rgyal po rol pa'i stabs/ /sku ber phod chos gos ngur smrig spras/ /snyan cha dang mgul rgyan rin chen brgyan/ /'ja' 'od phung lam mer bzhugs par bsam/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum mgon sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /dpal kun bzang mi yi gar bsgyur mkhan/ /mgon mchog gsum ngo bo drin can rje/ /bdud nag phyogs rgol gzhom rdo rje'i mtshan/ /bu brgyud 'dzin bdag gi gnyen gcig pu/ khyed gdung ba drag pos 'bod lags kyi/ /thugs dbyer med brtse bas dgyes shing gshegs/ /bdag bu slob skyong bar mdzad du gsol/ /nyams dga' spro thos bsam sgom gsum spel/ /rkyen mi dge bying rmug 'thib gsum sol/

/don khyab gdal dgongs pa'i rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /gu ru badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a bai sha ya a āḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ e maḥ dpal mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ mi bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug gis brgyan/ /tshe 'di phyi kun tu 'bral med bzhugs/ /byin sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bdag lus ngag yid gsum smin grol mdzod/ /badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ brgyud pa a ti bkod pa chen po las/ bla ma sgom dang bstod pa bsam pa ni: sangs rgyas 'bum phrag cig car 'grub par nges: zhes dang*/ de yang rang la gsang sngags ston pa'i bla ma de/ sangs rgyas dngos su shes la gsol ba thob cig /gsungs pa bzhin/ dang ba 'dren cing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na mo/ e ma ho/ snying gting nas mos dang gus pa yi/ /dpal bla ma thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ ngag dung dung gdung ba'i sgra dbyangs kyi/ /dpal bla ma'i yon tan rtags par bsngags/ /lus 'dzin med gcer bu 'phar rdeb kyi/ /dpal bla ma'i sku la phyag 'bul lo/ khyed bka' drin mtshungs zla med pa'i rje/ /lha rgyal kun spyi gzugs yongs kyi gtso/ /skyabs yul gyi rab 'byams zhi dang drag /mgon khyed la ma 'dus su gzhan gang*/ /rje khyed kyi yon tan brjod mi lang*/ /don bslu med gang 'dod gdams ster mkhan/ /bdag rang re'i blo bum ma zhum na/ /rje khyed kyi gdams bcud zad pa med/ /bla ma thugs rje rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag dug lnga'i me 'ob bsil du sol/ /rang snang sems sgrom du 'chang nus na/ /mgon thugs rje dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i/ /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag ma rig pre tas 'ching ba sol/ /bu dad pa'i zhing sa ldan lags na/ /mgon thugs rjes char rgyun zad pa med/ /bla ma mkha' ltar kun khyab gdal phyag 'tshal/ /bdag byang chub myu gu smin par mdzod/ /nyams rtog pa'i 'bras bu phun tshogs shog /gu ru badzra a ti pū hoḥ

pra titstsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ khyed sku gsung thugs rnams mnyes pa'i phyir/ /bdag phyi 'byung g.yar khang gdos gzugs 'di/ /blo lus ngag yid kyi brgyan te 'bul/ /rtsa g.yas g.yon ro rkyang bhandha'i nang*/ sems snang stong bdud rtsi raktas bkang*/ /dbyings sku gsum rab 'byams ngang du 'bul/ /rtsa ā wa dhu ti'i gtor snod nang*/ /don ma bcos gang shar gtor ma 'di/ /blo khyab gdal lhug bzhag ngang du 'bul/ /phyi 'byung lngas bsdus pa'i snod mchog dbus/ /nang ye shes lnga'i bcud gtams te/ /sems khyab gdal chos nyid rol par 'bul/ /'khor grwa slob 'dus sde sbyin bdag bcas/ /rgyu longs spyod bsod nams rgyan spras te/ /don tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i ngang du 'bul/ oṃ gu ru badzra ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta sarba pū dzā hoḥ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ pha pad 'byung gnyis pa thugs rje'i bdag /mgon 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu/ /bu brgyud 'dzin re sa sprul pa'i sku/ /bdud gnyis 'dzin rgol bcom khyod la bstod/ /don mi shigs drwa ba'i klong yangs nas/ /mchog gsum dngos 'jigs bral gdod ma'i mgon/ /dpal sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku/ /rje drin can mtshan ldan khyed la bstod/ /mgon khyed la bstod cing gus pa'i mthus/ /rkyen 'di phyi'i gegs las thar bar mdzod/ /bdag ma rig 'khrul tshab mi dge'i las/ /yid gdung shugs 'gyod pa drag pos bshags/ oṃ gu ru badzra sa twa sa ma y sogs bla ma'i yig brgya ci nus bzlas/ dzap ni/ dpal sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rje/ /tshig bzlas pa sngags kyi thugs dam bskul/ /don gang bsam gegs med myur shugs kyi/ /byin ya mtshan mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ rgyud a ti bkod pa chen po las/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sa ya brjod pa bas: bla ma'i gsol 'debs tshig gsum brjod pas ni: nus pa 'bum phrag char yang mi phod do:

ces gsungs pa bzhin/ rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ bla ma mkhyen no/ las sngags ni/ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu mi 'jigs rdo rje khyed mkhyen no/ rtag par bla ma spyi bor bsam ste bzlas pa byas pas/ phyi rtags su rang gi ci bsam 'grub pa dang*/ lhag tu rnam dkar dge ba'i las gegs med du 'grub pa zhig 'byung*/ nang rtags su nyams rtog ting 'dzin dpag med 'phel bar gyur/ gsang ba'i rtags su nyams snang rmi lam sogs la zhal gzigs lung ston/ rab 'bring tha ma'i rtags rnams rang rnal 'byor gyi lta ba mtho dman ltar 'byung ngo*/ skabs su bslu med bla ma spyi bor bsam ste/ blo ling gis gtad nas 'dod don 'di ltar 'bod/ na mo/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa/ /bka' drin can gyi chos sku/ /byin rlabs can gyi longs sku/ nus pa can gyi sprul sku/ bslu med pad 'byung gnyis pa/ /ci 'dod dngos grub ster ba'i/ /thugs rjes bdag nyid chen po/ khyed la rtags par skyabs zhu/ /ci mdzad nyid kyi mkhyen no/ /bdag ni khyed rang rjes bzung*/ /'dzam gling sa steng khams kun/ /snying pos chos kyi khyab nas/ /'dus sde bsod nams phun tshogs/ /ci bsam dpal 'byor mnga' thang*/ /lhun grub thog med myur stsol/ /gangs can sgrub dgon bstan gsum/ kha ba'i ljongs rnams gang mdzod/ /sngags btsun dge 'dun sde rnams/ /'chad rtsod brtsam pa'i dpal yon/ /rgya bod paṇa grub ci bzhin/ /thos bsam sgom dang bag yod/ /'dul khrims tshul ldan mdzod cig /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing*/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod la/ /'gro rnams smin grol 'god mdzod/ /dug lnga mi dge can la/ /ye shes lnga yi byin phobs/ /lam log gol sa 'di nas/ /thugs rje'i brtse bas bzung mdzod/ chos log rgol ngan zhi nas/ /dam sri bdud 'dre'i kha phyogs/ /dam pa'i chos la bsgyur mdzod/ /dga' sdug dro grang la sogs/ /ci dang ci 'dra byung yang*/ /bla ma khyed nyid ma gtogs/

/skyabs gnas gzhan nas mi 'tshol/ /snying nas blo gtad 'bul lo/ /ci shar ro gcig rtog par/ /mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma khyed mkhyen no/ de nas dngos grub len pa ni/ bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bka' drin dran pas rtag tu gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs skye 'chi kha lo bsgyur ba'i dus/ /'bral med thugs rjes bu gcig ma bzhin du/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad kun/ /skad cig tsam yang 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /ma 'ongs dus su rnga yab dpal ri'i rtser/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig / sogs brjod/ dpal bla ma'i sku gsung thugs nyid las/ /'od dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros byas te/ bdag rnal 'byor gnas gsum dag la thim/ /don ci dran ma bcos lhug par stsol/ oṃ gu ru badzra kā ya wākka tsitta ā bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas rang bla ma'i nus pa dang dbyer med bsam ste/ gang shar thog brdzis spyod cing 'di ltar nus ldan du smon lam bya ba ni/ mgon mchog gsum rang rig bla ma yi/ /thugs g.yo med klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /tshig grags stong bden mthus smon lam bskul/ /dpal phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rin po che/ /mgon khyod kyi bstan pa dar rgyas shog /dpal skyes chen zhabs pad brtan gyur nas/ /'gro rigs drug bden gnyis zung 'brel nas/ /mchog bde skyid phun gsum tshogs gyur cig /bdud snyigs ma nag phyogs lha 'dre rnams/ /sdang sems kyi gnod 'tshe zhi nas kyang*/ /las rnam dkar dge bar spyod gyur cig /yul gangs can 'dzam gling spyi bye kun/ /gzhi bslab pa tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang*/ /grogs phar phyin drug gi go cha 'dzin/ /phyi so thar don dam gsang ba sngags/ /bar byang sems dang ldan dge 'dun sde/ /stong bye ma'i rdul grangs 'phel bar shog /sgrub gnas yul dgon sde phun sum tshogs/ /tshe 'di phyi gnyis ldan bsod nams kyis/
/dpal mnga' thang bde skyid 'byor ba rgyas/ /chos theg pa chen po'i sgor zhugs nas/ /mthar gzhon nu bum sku'i sa thob shog /

ces dus rtag par bla ma'i dam tshig tshul bzhin du gnas par bya/ bla ma'i dam tshig legs nyes klong chen rab 'byams mdzod la dris/ / dge ba 'di yi myur du? sogs brjod/ nub mo nyal skabs snying dbus su bla ma sngar ltar sgoms ste/ ma yeng par sems bzung ste nyal bar bya'o/ /tho rangs bla ma spyi bor bsgom pa gong bzhin no/ /zhes gong gis 'grub rtags sngar bzhin bshad pa de nyid las/ phyi nang gsang gsum 'grub rtags ma byung na/ rang gi dam tshig phra zhib legs par ma byung bas len pas/ bshags pa sogs la nan tan dgos/ khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyin mtshan thun gnyis phye la nan tan bya'o/ de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di rang gi snang tshul stong pa'i rtsal las shar ba'i/ zhal phyag cha lugs sogs 'thad min cha ma 'tshal te/ 'chal bar gyur na bzod par gsol lo/ zhes skye bo tha mal las dman pa'i ārya ming gis yon tan gnas ljongs su ci dran bris pa'o// // (ya)༄༅/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i sku phreng lnga pa'i bla sgrub thugs rje'i char rgyun bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru/ rigs 'dus bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs bka' gter mdo sngags ltar nyams su blang ba la/ nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyis thugs bskyed de/ / na mo/ ka dag dbyings nas shar ba'i bla ma la/ /lhun grub rang ngo shes par skyabs su mchi/ khregs chod zab mo'i lam gyi gzhi bzung ste/ /'gro rnams thod rgal 'bras bu'i sar 'god bgyi/ /snod bcud rnam dag rdo rje'i maṇḍa lar/ /rtsa lnga rnam dag seṅge'i khri steng du/ /rlung lnga rnam dag padma nyi zla'i steng*/ /thig le rang byung ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ /chos dbyings gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*/ /bka' drin sum ldan bzod pa rab brtan ni/ /rnam pa gu ru padma 'byung gnas tshul/ /pad zhu ber phod chos gos sku la gsol/ rdo rje thod pa tshe bum kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog

/'khor 'das snang srid khyab pa'i sku ru gsal/ /dam tshig ye shes dbyer med bdag nyid gyur/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dza siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod 'os phyi nang snod bcud kun/ /blo yis sprul lam lhun gyis grub/ /ting 'dzin mnyam nyid chen po ru/ /dkon mchog spyi 'dus rgyal bar 'bul/ arghaṃ pā dyaṃ? pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du gcig /chos nyid don la cha lugs mi mnga' yang*/ /thabs mkhas gang 'dul so sor skur ston pa/ /thugs rjes sprul bsgyur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / mthar/ thugs kar zla steng gser gyi rdo rje yi/ /lte bar hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /'od 'phros sgrib sbyangs snod bcud lha sngags kyi/ /ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'byams klas gyur/ / ces dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: zhes bzla/ bar mtshams su/ dus gsum sangs rgyas gu ru rin po che: dngos grub kun bdag bde ba chen po'i zhabs: bar chad kun sel bdud 'dul drag po rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes gang 'grub gsol ba 'debs/ mthar/ bla ma'i gnas bzhi'i 'od zer gyis/ /dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs/ /bla ma rang thim dbyer med 'dres/ /dge rtsa byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sku gsum bla ma'i sa thob shog / ces tshogs mchod bsdus pa spro na/

dam tshig gi rdzas bsags la/ hrīḥ bde chen dbyings kyi ka pā lar/ /rang byung ye shes tshogs gtor bsham/ /phyi snod dag pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /nang bcud sems can tshogs su bsham/ /brdal khyab pags pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /phung khams skye mched tshogs su bsham/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams/ /tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs mchod 'od phung 'bar ba 'di/ /mchod 'os skyes mchog rnams la 'bul/ /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad bshags/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang ru tra 'di/ /zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi/ gu ru dhe ba ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ tshogs la rol/ lhag gtor ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lhag la dbang ba'i dregs pa'i tshogs/ /sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ /bsgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog pa dang*/ /phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod/ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi/ zhes pa 'di gwa grwa bla ma nyi ma 'od zer gyis rten bcas gsungs bskul ltar/ blo rab pas sug bris su bgyis pas dge legs 'phel// // (ra)༄༅/ bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs char sprin bzhugs so/ e ma hoḥ chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems/ /sprul sku pad 'byung lha lcam mtsho rgyal ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rtsa gsum gling pa dang*/ /las can skyes bu brgyud 'dzin bu slob la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /rtsa gsum thugs sgrub bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter bdag la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /de ltar gsol btab byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /shar grol dus mnyam tshe 'dir rig 'dzin thob/ /padma'i bka' sgrub zab gter bstan pa spel/ /mkha' khyab 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog / ces pa 'di'ang rtsa gling sprul phreng lnga pas thugs sgrub kyi gsol 'debs chog bsgrigs cha shas tsam bris pa'o//

// (la)༄༅/ bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las: gsang sgrub las byang snying gi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang bla ma sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: bkra shis byin chags rgyal bas me tog 'thor: smon lam mchog ldan dben ri yid 'ong der: mkho ba'i yo byad sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bsags: sa slang stegs bu bcags te dbus mtho ba: gser gyi maṇḍal dong tse'i dbyibs dag la: thig gdab tshon spel bkod legs mdzes par bya: de nas gzhung spyi'i mchod pa bsgrigs chags ni: bum pa rnam rgyal sman sgrub bdud rtsis gtams: kha rgyan mgul chings lha tshogs tshang bar bya: bhandha mtshan ldan sman raka phud kyis bkang : rtsa gsum gtor ma rgyan gang legs par bsham: gzhan yang spyan gzigs tshogs gtor tshang bar dgod: de nas dkyil 'khor gzhung du 'jug pa la: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: āḥ ka dag rang byung ye nas lhun gyis grub: rang gsal ma 'gags rang mdangs rol pa'i klong : snang srid zil gnon rtsa gsum lha tshogs la: 'bral med snying dbus dad pas skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed ni: hoḥ thog med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can kun: rang ngo ma shes 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: bde ba'i sa lam ma bgrod rigs drug rnams: yang dag sangs rgyas sar sgrol sems bskyed do: dkar phyogs gzhi bdag la gser skyems 'bul zhing : gnyis 'dzin gyi bgegs la bka' bsgo bya ba ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: nyon cig nga bdag bgegs tshogs rigs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir khug: a 'thas nyon mongs ru tra'i tshogs: phyogs med chos sku'i klong du dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mtshan 'dzin bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: āḥ rang snang ka dag rgya yan du: mu mtha' bral ba'i gur khang phub: bsrungs med bsrung ba chen po yis: kun rdzogs don dam srung 'khor gyur:

a a āḥ rakṣa bhrūm̐: brda sgo dbye ba ni: āḥ snang srid gdod nas zhing khams rdzogs: ye dag ris med dkyil 'khor la: gtad med lta ba'i lha zhal mjal: rang rig rang gsal brda phyag 'tshal: oṃ badzra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po padma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: sgra dang rol mo mang po 'u ru ru: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: mkha' 'gro sde lngas gar byed shigs se shig: ging chen dpa' bos bro brdung khrabs se khrab: ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar thibs se thib: chos skyong sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: g.yas na pho rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab: dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldan thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda skad di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bo'i bshug glu kyu ru ru: hūm̐ gi snang glu mang po di ri ri: phaṭ kyi brda skad drag po sangs se sang : bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: byin chen phob cig sgrub la dbang mchog bskur: lus ngag yid gsum ye shes rtsal chen rdzogs: rten mchog rnams la byin chen myur du phob: byin chen 'bral med khyed kyi rjes 'jug stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa ma ya a we sha ya a āḥ mchod pa byin rlob ni: āḥ snang srid rnam dag buddha'i zhing khams su: phyi snod nang bcud kun bzang mchod sprin dbus: rtsa gsum dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du: sman raka gtor gsum phyi nang gsang mchod spros: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pū dza āḥhūm̐:

oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs shabda āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: āḥ ka dag stong chen ting 'dzin skye med la: lhun 'grub zang thal ting 'dzin 'gags pa med: bde stong mnyam nyid ting 'dzin yi ge'i sprin: chos dbyings kun khyab rang bzhin dkyil 'khor shar/ ā dharma dhā tu āḥ dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa ni: āḥ rig kun chos nyid ka dag rdzogs pa che: ma 'gags rang gsal de bzhin nyid kyi ngang : e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ suṃ keṃ bhrūm̐ yig las: 'byung ba bdun rtsigs snod bcud zang thal klong : skad cig mkha' la sna tshogs rdo rje yi: lte bar ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi: rtsigs pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba mdzes: shar bu mda' yab pu shu rgyan dang ldan: bcu drug ka gdung 'phen dar cod pan dang : rin chen sna lnga mdzes pa'i drwa ba ris: 'ja' 'od gur khang lu gu rgyud du gsal: de dbus padma nyi zla mdzes pa'i steng : gser gyi rdo rje hūm̐ yig dmar pos mtshan: 'od zhu dran rdzogs gu ru padma ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bde chen rgyal po'i tshul: pad zhwa za ber chos gos phod ka gsol: rin chen snyan rgyan dar dmar sku reg mdzes: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum kha ṭwāṃ bsnams: rgya lham gsol zhing zhabs gnyis rol stabs tshul: bag dro lhun chags gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: g.yas su pad zlar tshe dpal bskyed pa'i yum: lha lcam dmar mo mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: dkar gsal nyams can rin chen rus pas brgyan: bgres rgud mi mnga' zhi 'dzum gsal bar bsgom: g.yon du pad nyir bde chen bskyed pa'i yum: mtsho rgyal dkar mo bhandha bdud rtsi bsnams: bde ba'i nyams can dar dang rus pas brgyan: dkar la mdzes 'dzum bcu drug gzhon nu'i tshul: dga' bzhi'i bde stong 'bar 'dzag dwangs ma 'dren: rlung sems gcig dril 'chi med 'ja' lus tshul: hrīḥ de nas gnas gsum byin rlabs 'khrigs pa'i klong :

steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'ja' 'od gur khang nas: o rgyan yab yum rig 'dzin rgya mtsho la: dpa' bo ḍākki dam can chos skyong sogs: rtsa khams gnas yul dag pa'i zhing khams nas: mngon sum chu zla gcig shar kun ldang bzhin: rang bzhin gnas nas skad cig spyan 'dren no: spyan drangs pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a we sha ya āḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: āḥ gdod nas dag pa'i gzhal yas su: rang rig padma kā ra rje: dbyer med ro gcig ma 'dres med: thugs yid gnyis med bzhugs su gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa ma ya satwaṃ: lta bas mjal phyag 'tshal ba ni: āḥ khyab bdag bla ma chos kyi sku: 'gyur ba med pa longs spyod rdzogs: rig pa rang zhal sprul pa'i sku: 'khrul pa 'dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya āḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi snod stong gsum yangs pa ru: mchod rdzas gzugs sgra dri ro reg: nang bcud rtsa khams lha mo'i tshogs: sman dang rakta gtor mchod spung : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bde stong dang : ga na tsakra'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ puṣpe dhū pe sogs rū pa shabda sogs āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pū dza khā hi: rnam dag dran cing bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral ka dag ngo bo nyid:

zang thal 'gags med thugs rje so sor ston: 'gro ba'i don phyir ye shes sgyu ma'i gar: o rgyan gu ru pad 'byung rje la bstod: hūm̐: sku mdog dkar 'tsher zhi 'dzum chags pa ni: ye shes sku lnga 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dbu la gser gyi snyan zhu gsol ba ni: bde chen rgyal po 'gro ba'i don mdzad brda: de la rin chen rdo rje btsugs pa ni: kun gzhi'i gnas lugs 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: rtse mor sgro phod dang ru btsugs pa ni: sa lam theg chen dus gcig bgrod pa'i brda: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba ni: ye shes lnga ldan rol rtsal ston pa'i brda: nyi zla nor bu'i rgyan mdangs spras pa ni: srid zhi'i ma rig mun pa sel ba'i brda: sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram ldan pa ni: dgongs brda rgya mtsho'i slob dpon yin pa'i brda: khyung gshog rin chen drwa bas spras pa ni: brgyud 'dzin bu la dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i brda: ratna'i snyan rgyan gdu bu 'khrol ba ni: 'khor los bsgyur rgyal kun gyi dad dpon brda: mthing ga chu ris phod ka bklubs pa ni: zab gsang lta ba mi shigs ston pa'i brda: gong lag mu tig chun pos spras pa ni: rtsa rlung bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dar dmar rgya ma'i sku reg bcings pa ni: ma sring mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'du ba'i brda: chos gos gser gyi ha ri gsol ba ni: sde snod lung rigs gsang mdzod 'dzin pa'i brda: smug nag g.yung drung ber chen gsol ba ni: snang srid dbang sdud gtso bo yin pa'i brda: zhe sdang stag gis gong lag brgyan pa ni: skal ngan bdud rigs rgol ba 'joms pa'i brda: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa ni: ma rungs zil gnon gdug pa 'dul ba'i brda: g.yon pas bhandha tshe bum bsnams pa ni: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'ja' lus ston pa'i brda: kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum mchan du 'chang ba ni: dug gsum la sogs 'khrul rtog gcod pa'i brda:

gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil ba ni: sgrub la mchog thun char ltar 'bebs pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis rol stabs rgya lham gsol ba ni: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem pa'i brda: sku la 'od phung gzi brjid 'khyil ba ni: phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo'i brda: spyan rtsa 'khyil ba mkha' dbyings gzigs pa ni: nam yang thugs rje 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs bla ma rje la bstod: 'gro ba'i mgon mchog ma hā gu rur bstod: snang mtha'i dbang phyug mtsho skyes rdo rjer bstod: rgyal sras lhun grub pad 'byung sku la bstod: gtan gyi skyabs mchog rgya gar pa la bstod: mdo sngags gtsug rgyan nyi 'od gsal la bstod: bka' drin 'khor med pha la bstod pa'i mthus: bu la thugs rje'i byin chen char ltar phob: mtshungs med nyid ltar deng 'dir bdag gyur cig: hūm̐: zag med dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i dbang mo che: dbyings phyug manda ra ba mtsho rgyal lcam: mda' dar tshe bum srid zhi'i tshe bcud sdus: dwangs ma'i bdud rtsi bde chen mchod sprin spro: zung 'jug ye shes 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bsgyur: thugs 'dzin yum mchog gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sngon tshe las dbang pad dkar tha tshig bsrungs: da lta rig 'dzin bdag gi bka' nyan sgrub: bstan dgra dam nyams ma lus sgrol mdzad pa: dam can chos skyong tshogs la bstod cing bshags: āḥ gzugs snang thams cad ye shes rol pa'i klong : snang ba thams cad sprul sku'i zhing du shar: grags pa thams cad 'dzab dbyangs di ri ri: dran rtog thams cad chos sku blo las 'das: smra bsam brjod bral ngang du dzap 'di bzla/

rtsa bsnyen ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: sgrub pa la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ siddhi pha la hūm̐: las sbyor: hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsitta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: āḥ srid gsum rnam rgyal chos dbyings bhandha ru: khams gsum sems can ma lus tshogs gtor bshams: ting 'dzin snang bzhi chen por byin gyis rlobs: 'khor 'das khyab brdal rang gsal mchod sprin spro: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad 'byung yab yum ḍākki'i tshogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gter bdag rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'khrul pa rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs: gnas khang byin chen 'bebs par byin gyis rlobs: cir snang ye shes rol par byin gyis rlobs: gu yangs rgyal sa zin par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ tshogs mchod ni: āḥ gdod nas kun khyab blo 'das rdzogs pa che: ma lus sangs rgyas byang sems mchod pa'i gnas: o rgyan yab yum rtsa brgyud bla ma dang : ma sring ḍākki dam can mnyes gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga na tsakra pū dza la khā hi: thugs dam dbyings su skong ba ni: āḥ snang srid tshogs khang padma 'od kyi zhing : 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor rig 'dzin pho mo'i tshogs: tshogs rdzas yo byad 'dod yon sprin phung 'khrigs: bla ma rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : rtsa khams dwangs ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : las sgrub dpa' bo ḍākki'i thugs dam bskang : mngon spyod dam can yongs kyi thugs dam bskang : zag med dgongs klong chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul skye med klong du bskang : nyon mongs rtog sgrib chos nyid dbyings su dag:

sa ya 'bum sde sku gsung thugs su bskang : brgyad khri bzhi stong chos zad blo las 'das: snang stong zung 'jug khyab brdal chen por bskang : klong du bshags pa ni: āḥ gsang sgrub bla ma'i dkyil 'khor dang : mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs rnams: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gi: nyams chag bshags so byang gyur cig: oṃ gu ru sa twa sa ma ya sogs sa twa āḥ gzung 'dzin bsgral ba ni: āḥ snang srid dpal chen bden stobs kyis: tha mal zhen pa myur du khug: rig pa ye shes rdo rje yis: nga bdag gzung 'dzin dbyings su bsgral: 'pho med 'pho ba'i klong du thim: skye med chos dbyings zhal du bstab: gnyis 'dzin re dogs rdul du rlog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha truṃ mā ra ya khā hi: 'dod yon rgyan du rol cing lhag sdud ni: oṃ a ka ro sogs kyis byin brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lhag sdud ma sring dbang phyug tshogs: bstan srung phra men ke'u rī: 'dod yon lhag ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi tha tshig ci bzhin du: zab gter bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs dam bskul: hūm̐: rnam dag ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rig 'dzin kun gyi 'dus gzugs thod phreng rtsal: rtsa gsum gsang sgrub dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dam sri rgyal 'gong srog rtsa snying nas drongs: bsreg bcom gtor brlag ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa ma ya i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi: tha tshig bsgrag pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe kun bzang pad 'byung tha tshig dang : bar du gnam lcags rdo rjes bka' bsgos shing : tha ma rnal 'byor bdag gi rogs dan gyis: dam chos sgrub la bar chad med par mdzod: brtan ma skyong pa ni: hūm̐: bod khams bstan pa skyong ba yi: brtan ma bcu gnyis ya ma'i tshogs:

bdag gi grogs mdzod bstan pa skyongs: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: rta bro ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid drag po hūm̐ du gsal: thar med ru tra dam sri bgegs: stong pa hūm̐ gi 'og tu mnan: hūm̐ gis bro rar rgyas gdab bo: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lam̐ satwaṃ bha ya nan: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni: āḥ rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus lha tshogs rnams: ye nas ma bcos byang chub sems: bdud rtsi snying po mkha' la thim: mkha' nas āḥyig ljags la zhugs: mi shigs rdo rje'i dngos grub thob: a a āḥ kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi pha la hoḥ bkra shis brjod pa ni: āḥ dbyings kyi bkra shis khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon: 'ja' lus zang thal 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: snang stong bkra shis longs sku rdo rje sems: thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: dran rig bkra shis sprul sku padma 'byung : a ti thig le nyag gcig bkra shis shog: dmigs med lta bas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: āḥ ka dag ngo bo mi dmigs ye nas dag: kun gsal cho 'phrul rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: lhan skyes ye shes gnyug ma'i sbubs su bsdu: gshegs med gshegs yul gshegs bya gdod nas āḥ a a āḥ bsngo smon ni: āḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i gtsos: bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa: ma gyur 'gro rnams chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs: dmigs med spros bral bsngo smon mtha' rgyas shog sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams bla ma sprul sku'i zhing du rtogs pa'i rang mdangs su: o rgyan yab yum dang gnyis su med par thugs yid dbyer med du bsres shing nyin mtshan chig dril khor yug mu mtha' bral ba'i ngang nas: lha sngags rol pa chen por 'byams klas su spyod lam rnam bzhi'i ngang du ma bral bar: o rgyan yab yum zhal mngon sum mjal te tshe 'phos nas 'ja' lus 'grub cing ma rgan 'gro drug mthong thos dran rig thams cad rig 'dzin gyi sa lam bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig:

kha thaṃ: gu hya: brda thim: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di yang rang rig rang gsal 'gags med kyi klong nas dbyings kyi ḍākki'i bka' yis bskul ba ltar rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i skye phreng lnga pa nges don chos dbyings rang grol zhes pa'am/ o rgyan las rab gter ban gling pas sa 'brug lo mchog tu zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin dbyings rig sgrom bu las phab pa'i yi ge pa ni rtsa gling skye phreng gi rus brgyud 'dzin pa ratna karmas bris pa dge legs 'phel// // (sha)༄༅/ bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las/ gsang sgrub las byang snying gi thig le'i bdud rtsi lag mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ka pā la yi dam rdzas snod nang du/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /sor bcud lha mo 'dod yon sprin phung 'khrigs/ /bla ma rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes mchod 'bul/ hūm̐/ chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems/ /sprul sku dga' rab shrī sing 'jam dpal la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ padma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin brgyad rnams dang*/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rje 'bangs grogs lnga la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ ye shes mtsho rgyal manda ra ba dang*/ /zab gsang mnga' brnyes ḍākki'i rigs rnams la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ rtsa gsum gling pa kun bzang 'chi med nor/ /'gro 'dul phrin las padma nges don la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ nges don chos dbyings chos bdag las can dang*/

/yang sprul sku mchog thugs kyi rigs rnams la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ bder 'dus thugs sgrub bla ma yi dam dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' gro chos skyong tshogs rnams la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ dam can rgya mtsho dpal mgon srog bdud dang*/ /gdong can rigs bzhi bka' dang gter srung la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha tshogs thugs rgyud bskul/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /rang gi gnas gsum thim pas mchog dbang thob/ /sgrib gnyis yongs dag sku bzhi mngon gyur shog /kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ sarba siddhi hrī/ spu bo gnam lcags lnga pas so// // (sa)༄༅/ bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las: bskang ba bsdus pa dri med shel phreng bzhugs so: rab 'byams rgyal kun bder 'dus lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: gang gi thog med thugs rje rmad po che: kun 'byung chos kyi 'dod 'jo 'khor los bsgyur: yid bzhin bsam pa'i re ba skong mdzad pa: sgrib gnyis yongs dag bskang ba 'dir spro'o: dag pa gsum gyi stong gsum snod nang du: gsal ba gsum gyi tshogs gtor ri ltar spungs: cha ba gsum gyi lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: nyon mongs gsum gyi bag chags stobs 'joms shog: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gis sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i klong yangs nas: ma rtogs sems can 'khrul pa'i las sgrib kyi: bskang rdzas mi gtsang 'bag btsog shes sgrib rnams: byang zhing dag nas stong khams gang bar gyur: oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa su kham̐ sa ma ya shrī ye dharma dhā tu ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba lingta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi:

dgyes pa'i gdangs btang lta ba'i dbyings su bskang : ḍā dril rol mo spos dang gling bu 'bud: thugs dam rgyud bskul gdung ba'i nga ro yis: byin rlabs sprin phung 'dod yon zad med gyur: hūm̐: dbyings rig zang thal pho brang nas: gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang : rigs kyi bdag po'i thugs dam bskang : ri bo ta la'i pho brang nas: 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: 'gro ba'i mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : dpal ri padma'i pho brang nas: mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: snang srid zil gnon thugs dam bskang : bde stong gsang ba'i pho brang nas: tshe la mnga' brnyes manda ra: ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : gang 'dul thabs kyi pho brang nas: sprul pa rnam brgyad skur ston pa: rig 'dzin brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : bsam yas mchims phu'i pho brang nas: bod yul mun pa gsal mdzad pa'i: rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i thugs dam bskang : snang stong chos dbyings pho brang nas: zab gsang brda yi rgyud grol ba: gnam lcags rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : bdud 'dul chos gling pho brang nas: thugs sprul chos bdag las can dang : sprul pa'i sku mchog thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: skye 'chi gnyis spangs rnam par dag: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud thugs dam bskang : ting 'dzin mchog brnyes rnam dag nas: rig 'dzin brda brgyud thugs dam bskang : rgyud lung man ngag rnam dag nas: gang zag snyan brgyud thugs dam bskang : bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: bka' brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : drin can rtsa brgyud rnam dag nas: bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sgyu lus dag pa'i gzhal yas nas: dam pa rigs brgya'i thugs dam bskang : rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud: chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : gsal 'tsher mdzes sdug 'od zer 'bar: zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : gar dgu chas bcu rus pas brgyan: khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang :

dngos grub thams cad stsol mdzad pa: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bar chad thams cad sel mdzad pa: mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : gdug pa ma lus kun 'dul phyir: chos skyong dam can thugs dam bskang : bka' yi bya ra srung mdzad pa'i: gter srung yongs kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni: 'dod yon lnga dang lha mo brgyad: mchod rdzas phyi yi thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi māṃ sa rakta dang : rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma sogs: nang gi mchod pa'i thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i bde stong bla na med: dga' bzhi 'byung ldog yas mas brtan: bde ba chen pos thugs dam bskang : gsal gsum ldan pa'i bskyed rdzogs ngang : dam sri ru tra ma rungs bsgral: sbyor sgrol rol pas thugs dam bskang : stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na: ji snyed lus dang longs spyod kyis: rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : snang ba sna tshogs cho 'phrul bsgyur: thams cad chos sku'i klong yangs nas: dmigs med spros bral thugs dam bskang : thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: bdud rtsi tshe yi a mṛ ta: dam rdzas rmad byung ba lingta: rgyu drug kun bsgral rakta dang : dri chen bdug spos mar me'i mdangs: arghaṃ zhabs bsil mchod yon chab: phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid: ḍā ru rnga dang rol mo'i rigs: rten rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas: thogs med yongs su dngos 'byor sprul: snang srid zil gnon thugs dam bskang : lha lcam mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : sprul pa brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : ma sring ḍākki'i thugs dam bskang : yi dam rta mgrin thugs dam bskang : yum mchog phag mo'i thugs dam bskang : pho rgyud mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : mo rgyud sngags srung thugs dam bskang : dam can yongs kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bskang du med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang : mchod du med de skye med dbyings su mchod:

sbyor du med de snang stong gnyis med sbyor: sgrol du med de skye 'gag med par sgrol: bshags su med de chos dbyings klong du bshags: khams gsum yongs dag chos sku'i klong du bskang : de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: snang srid 'khor 'das chos sku'i klong yangs nas: ma rig dbang gis 'khor ba bdag tu bzung : ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa mthol lo bshags: gdod nas rang rig ye sangs rgyas pa la: 'khrul ma myong ba'i mgon po kun tu bzang : rang rig ma rtogs bag chags 'thas pa yis: ma rig sgrib g.yogs rnam gsum mthol lo bshags: rang lus dkyil 'khor rang byung lhun grub kyang : ma rtog dbang gis bdag gzhan ris su phyes: rtog med rang gsal dus gsum spros bral yang : yin lugs lta ba ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i gtso: yi dam lha dang rdo rje spun rnams la: brnyas dang ma dad log par lta ba sogs: rtsa ba yan lag phra mo'i nyes ltung rigs: sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: dam can chos skyong yongs kyi spyan lam du: mngon spyod rtsal chung tshogs gtor dus su chag: ting 'dzin ma gsal lhag chad mthol lo bshags: gsang sngags khrom gtad dam tshig mi ldan la: sngags dang phyag rgya dus min bstan pa dang : bka' gsang bar dang gsang ba bzhi la sogs: sbom po phra mo la sogs nyes byas rnams: ma lus byang zhing myur du sangs rgyas shog: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya

sogs sa twa āḥ dam tshig nyams chag bshags pa'i rgyal po mchog: bla ma rtsa gsum mdun mkhar dmigs byas nas: lus sems ltos bcas gnong 'gyod drag po'i ngang : dad mos gdung shugs smre sngags 'gyod bshags phul: phyin chad dam bca' brtan por bzung bar bya: dus gsum sdig sgrib ma lus byang dag nas: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas thob pa'i 'bras bu'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di'ang rtsa gsum gter gling skye 'phreng lnga pa yin tshul mi smyon dkor dred o rgyan las rab gter ban gling pa'am/ nges don chos dbyings rang grol gyis snang stong dbyings rig brda las phab pas yi ge 'du bgyi ser gzugs sog rtsal 'dzin pa ratna'i ming pas so/ /dge'o// // (ha)༄༅/ bla ma bder 'dus thugs kyi nor bu las: gsang sgrub tshe yi 'khor lo yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so: bla ma bder 'dus tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i rin chen klong yangs su: mi zad rgya mtsho gter gyi sgo mo las: pad 'byung yab yum rje 'bangs grogs lnga yi: zhal gdams don tshan ma 'ongs dus 'di ru: tshe thung nad mang dug lnga rags pa'i dus: tshe yi bsgrub pa yang gsang nor bu bzhag: mkha' dbyings sgrom la sbas pa'i gter kha 'di'i: bka' yi rgya 'di dbyings phyug dzā ṭis srungs: ma 'ongs sngags 'chang las rab ming la spel: sa ma ya: bum pa mtshan ldan bum rdzas nyer lnga dang : tshe ril tshe chang tshe 'brang tshe mda' dang : tshe rdzas la sogs mthun pa'i cha rkyen bsags: snang srid snod bcud dwangs ma'i dwangs ma rnams: tshe yi bcud rnams 'ub bsdus bdag mdun la: sib sib thim nas char ltar dbab par bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku: o rgyan yab yum tshe dpag med: mkha' 'gro sde lnga tshe yi lha: mgyogs ma tshe yi sgo ma bzhis: drongs shig tshe bsod dpal 'byor rnams: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab pa ni:

hūm̐ hrīḥ stong pa chen po e yi gur khang las: de dbus padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: hrī yig yongs gyur o rgyan tshe dpag med: pad rag mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu mkha' la phyar: g.yon pas bhandha tshe bum yum la 'khyud: longs sku'i cha lugs dar dang ratnas brgyan: lha lcam dkar mos dar dang rus rgyan bklubs: phyag g.yas mda' dar yab kyi snyan la phyar: g.yon pas tshe yi gwa'u yab la 'khyud: skye 'chi bgres rgud mi mnga' gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐ hrīḥ phyogs bzhi tshe yi lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: badzra ratna padma karma dang : dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen rus pas brgyan: phyag g.yas tshe 'gugs rdo rje 'khor lo dang : padma rgya gram g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin: gar stabs ling nger snang stong chu zla ltar: 'dzin med zang thal gsal stong ngang nyid las: ye shes spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ dam ye gnyis med ro gcig ngang du bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: bde stong yab yum zung 'jug sbyor sgrol mchod: dran rtog thams cad mchod 'os rol pas mchod: mchod bya blo 'das mchod yul ka nas dag: dmigs med lhun grub mchod pa'i phyag rgya che: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos skye med ka dag ngang nyid las: ma 'gags rang rtsal ye nas lhun gyis grub: ma rig 'khrul pa'i dgra bo 'joms mdzad pa: ma lus tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag mdun tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: hrīḥmathar sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis: khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum gyi: tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang thang 'dod rgu sogs: yid la gang bsam thogs med 'grub par bsam : rtsa sngags ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐: las sbyor ni: oṃ gu ru ā yurdzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa sā ma ya tshe bhrūm̐ siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ ma yengs rtse gcig ldan pa'i ngang : hrīḥbhrūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ

zhes bsnyen pa chu bo 'bab ltar bzla: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: dug lnga rags pas tshe tshad thung : na long med par srog la rgol: de tshe ma yengs rtse gcig tu: tshe yi rgya mdud dam du bcing : sa ya grangs thems tshe 'gugs bya: tshe gegs sel phyir padma'i lung : mi bslu tha tshig sa ma ya: de nas tshe'i 'gugs pa ni: mda' dar g.yab cing dmigs pa gtad: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med: nyan thos dgra bcom dpag med bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sel: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ ri bo tā la'i pho brang nas: spyan gzigs yab yum tshe dpag med: 'khor du byang chub sems dpas bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: o rgyan yab yum tshe dpag med: 'khor du rig 'dzin grub pas bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ mi 'gyur gsang ba'i pho brang nas: sangs rgyas ye shes tshe dpag med: 'khor du rje 'bangs nyer lngas bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ gar bzhugs chos dbyings pho brang nas: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa la: 'khor du gter 'byin brgya rtsas bskor:

skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang dag pa'i gzhal yas nas: rtsa ba'i bla ma tshe dpag med: 'khor du rtsa brgyud bla mas bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ dug lnga rnam dag pho brang nas: dpa' bo rta mgrin rgyal po la: 'khor du yi dam lha tshogs bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes lnga yi 'od klong nas: dpa' mo rdo rje phag mo la: 'khor du mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ me rlung 'tshub ma'i klong dkyil nas: legs ldan ma hā kā la la: pho rgyud srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi la: lha mo mo rgyud tshogs kyis bskor: skal ldan rnams la byin chen phob: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad sol: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa na: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: tshe rten 'di la rab tu gnas:

stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: badzra ḍākki sku mdog dkar: phyag na tshe yi lcags kyu bsnams: tshe bsod dpal grags gzi byin rnams: nyi zla bzhin du shar bzhin byon: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: ratna ḍākki sku mdog ser: sa le sbram gyi zhags pa 'dzin: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod: lho sprin bzhin du 'khrigs shing byon: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: karma ḍākki sku mdog ljang : phyag na margad dril bu 'dzin: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod: stims shig badzra āḥyu hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ bla tshe nyams par bla tshe khug: srog tshe nyams par srog tshe khug: dbugs tshe nyams par dbugs tshe khug: 'gyur med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru hūm̐: yang yang brjod cing tshe rta bsdoms: hūm̐ hrīḥ mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bu la: mi shigs rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: smin grol mtha' rgyas khyab par shog: sku la rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud: rdo rje tshe yis rgyas gdab bo: gsung la mi 'gags rdo rje yis: tshangs dbyangs 'gags med rgyas btab bo: thugs la 'khrul med rdo rje'i sems: mi g.yo ting 'dzin rgyas gdab bo: tshe 'di mi shigs brtan par mdzod: 'dzin med sra brtan rgyas gdab bo: gu yangs rig pas rgyas gdab bo: 'khor 'das khyab brdal rgyas gdab bo: chos dbyings kun khyab rgyas gdab bo: gzhi med rtsa bral rgyas gdab bo: ye shar ye grol rgyas gdab bo: rgya 'di mi shigs rdo rjes gdab: hrīḥ dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa ye shes bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rgya: drug pa bcom ldan thub drug rgya:

bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun rgya: phyag rgya bdun gyis rgyas gdab bo: oṃ bhrūm̐ badzra rakṣa hūm̐: āḥbhrūm̐ badzra rakṣa hūm̐: hūm̐ bhrūm̐ badzra rakṣa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: rgyas gdab cing dbang bzhi blang ba ni: hūm̐ āḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku: o rgyan yab yum tshe dpag med: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing las: 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis: rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: byin rlabs sgo gsum thim nas kyang : tshe dbang rig 'dzin sku thob cig: oṃ gu ru ā yu dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbang bzhi blangs shing lha sngags ting 'dzin gyi rol pa chen po'i ngang skyong la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: spel rgya: zhes pa 'di'ang rigs kun khyab bdag gi mkha' dbyings sgrom bu'i brda las byung ba/ o rgyan las rab gter bzhed gling pas gtan la phab pa'o/ yi ge pa ni ser gzugs 'dzin pa ratna karmas bris pa'o// // (a)༄༅/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bsang ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin o rgyan padma 'byung gnas dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo lha lcam manda ra/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal gnubs ban lo tsa ba/ /rtsa gsum gling dang rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdor/ /ārya dhwa dza 'phags pa dge legs sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma tshogs bcas thams cad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i bsang mchod 'di 'bul lo/ /bdag sogs byang chub thob pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // (ki)༄༅/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i bsang ni/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs thugs kyi sku sprul pa/ /sems can kun la mgon skyabs mdzad/ /'og min gnas na bzhugs pa la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi skur bstan pa/ /'dren mdzad 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /dregs pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/

/ma hā kā lar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /brgyan pa'i bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces rlangs smyon gyis sbyar ba'o/ (khu)༄༅/ dpal ldan lha mo'i bsang mchod bzhugs so// // bhyoḥ lha gnas gsum dang dur khrod brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mu le mthing mtsho dgu brtsegs thod mkhar sogs/ /'og min gnas dang gar bzhugs pho brang nas/ /ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma/ /spyan 'dren 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /lnga ldan 'bar ba'i dbus su gnyis med bzhugs/ /phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod/ /sdom gsum rgyal ba'i bka' lung nyams pa bshags/ bhyoḥ dud pa'i sol ma dpon g.yog 'khor bcas la/ /mnyes rdzas spyan gzigs phyi nang bkod legs bkram/ /dbyangs snyan rol mo'i sgra sgrogs 'brug ltar ldir/ /zhu chen zhu chung rtsi bcud 'bras bu dang*/ /sha khrag dbang po rnam lnga sman spos sogs/ /rgyu dang ye shes me dpung dbus su bsregs/ /dri gsur dud pa'i sprin phung mkha' la 'khyil/ /gsol lo mchod do brngan no phrin las sgrubs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug pad 'byung bka' bzhag ltar/ /bde gsal mi rtog nyams kyi grogs mdzod la/ /rtag chad mu bzhi bdud bzhi'i bar chad sol/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum dga' bzhi'i grogs mdzod la/ /chags zhan bo zag thig le'i gegs rig sol/ /bde stong dga' bzhis rig stong ngo sprod la/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa ma rtogs bar/ /dbyings kyi yum chen lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /gsang sngags theg chen bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ ces ri pa bla ma phrin las rab rgyas kyis dpal ldan lha mo'i gsol kha nyung ngu zhig dgos zhes gsungs pa la brten nas snyoms las pa rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // (ge)༄༅/ drang srong gza' yi bsang bsdus bzhugs so/ hūm̐/ 'og min chos dbyings mkha' spyod nas/ /chos sku kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*/

/bka' gsang bstan pa skyong mdzad pa/ /stong khams mkha' klong rgyu ba sogs/ khyab 'jug sgra gcan mtshan gsol ba/ /'jigs gzugs duḥkha rtsa zhal dgu/ /bya rog khyab 'jug bstan pa srung*/ /phyag bzhi rim bzhin g.yas g.yon du/ /ral gri chu srin rgyal mtshan g.yas/ /mda' gzhu sbrul zhags g.yon pa sogs/ /sku lus spyan stong sbrul mjug 'khyil/ /yum chen khrag mig nyi zla 'dzin/ /me rlung 'tshub ma'i sbubs su gsal/ /mchod rdzas 'bru sman dar zab dang*/ /sha khrag bha ling gser skyems sogs/ /bdud rtsi can gyi bsang shing 'bul/ /pha ni srin la ma ni klu/ /klu srin pho bo rā hu la/ /rdzu 'phrul khyab 'jug chen po bsangs/ /me gza' nyi ma mig dmar bsangs/ /chu gza' zla ba lhag pa bsang*/ /rlung gza' phur bu sgra gcan bsangs/ /sa gza' spen pa pa sangs bsangs/ khams lngar dbang bsgyur gza' bdud bsangs/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag mchod gtor 'bul/ /drang srong chen po'i tshogs la bstod/ /gdong mo bzhi dang rgyu skar nyer brgyad bsangs/ /sa bdag rgyal blon hal khyi dus 'dzin bsangs/ /lo zla zhag dus rnal 'byor ma brgyad bsangs/ /bsang mchod 'di bzhes mnyes shing tshim par mdzod/ /rme yug grib sol 'khon sems 'dre ngan sol/ /gzhi byes lam gsum bcol ba'i las 'di sgrubs/ /gang bsam thogs med 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig /

ces pa 'di'ang grwa slob rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor/ hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gyi yang srid gsang sngags ming gis gzim chung bar khang du gza' rgod nyi ma rgyu ba'i dus su bsgrubs pa'o/ bkra shis shog/ // (ngo)༄༅/ gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gter srung las kyi ma mo'i bsang mchod yid bzhin gter 'byung bzhugs so// hrīḥ rgyal yum kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong nas/ /ma 'gags rig rtsal mkha' 'gro sde lnga shar/ /sna tshogs gang 'dul bstan srung ma mo'i tshul/ /ye shes 'jig rten yongs la dbang bsgyur ma/ /dbyings phyug dpal ldan rdo rje rigs kyi yum/ /'dod khams dbang mo chos kyi sgrol mar grags/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod las la grub/ /ma nges sprul sgyur cha lugs bsam mi khyab/ /rtag tu gsang sngags sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad ma/ /sngon tshe pad 'byung yab yum bka' bsgos bzhin/ /bsang mchod slad du spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /pad nyi bam gdan ratna'i dal 'bol khrir/ /brtse gdung dgyes pa'i tshul gyis brtan par bzhugs/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i srung mar mnga' gsol phyir/ /dam tshig gnyan pos gus phyag dwang bas bstod/ /phyi nang gsang mchod spyan gzigs mthun rdzas dang*/ /rin chen gser skyems 'bru sman dar zab dang*/ /bsang gsur 'dod yon longs spyod mchod pa'i sprin/ /nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang khyon 'gengs pa/ /mi zad bdud rtsi'i char chen rgyun 'bebs 'di/ /dbyings phyug lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol dbu 'phang bstod/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs sngags 'chang dam ldan grogs/ /ma gcig dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma bsangs/ /zhi ba'i las mdzad 'jigs brgyad sgrol mdzad ma/ /dbang sdud zhal bzang rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsangs/ /rgyas pa'i las mdzad longs spyod phywa g.yang bdag /yid bzhin dpal gter mi g.yo blo bzang bsangs/ /dbang gi las mdzad snang srid tshe bsod sdud/
