/'chi med bcud 'dzin gtad dkar 'gro bzang bsangs/ /bdud bzhi'i bar chad sgrol mdzad gtum pa mo/ /drag mdzad lha mo cod pan mgrin bzang bsangs/ /snang srid kun la dbang bsgyur mthu mo che/ /'dod khams gtso mo sngags srung rgyal mo bsangs/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdud dgra cham 'bebs ma/ /drag byed ma mo dam tshig rgyal mo bsangs/ /dgos 'dod gter 'byung nor gyi bdag mo che/ /dbang rgyal lha mo gtsug na nor bu bsangs/ khams gsum srid pa'i phywa g.yang sdud mdzad ma/ /las mkhan srog gcod shan pa ma gsum bsangs/ /zab gsang a ti'i bstan pa skyong mdzad ma/ /ma sring gnas nyul dbang mo nyer brgyad bsangs/ /lo phyugs dus 'dzin 'jig rten dbang bsgyur ma/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis sman phran 'bum phrag bsangs/ /stong khams srid pa yongs la dbang bsgyur ma/ /snang srid ma mo sde tshogs ma lus bsangs/ khyed rnams bsang zhing mchod pa'i yon tan gyis/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par zab gsang snying*/ /rdo rje theg chen bstan pa rin chen mchog /phyogs dus gnas skabs dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /grub dbang padma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i sde/ /gnubs lo'i gar rol hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gyi/ /zab chos snying thig yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /srid rtser spel zhing chab srid brtan par mdzod/ /de 'dzin 'dus sde kun gyi mchod 'os pa/ /'gran bral dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi/ /sku tshe zhabs pad rdo rje'i khrir gnas mdzod/ /bshad sgrub 'dzin 'chang zab chos spel ba'i las/ /thos bsam sgom sgrub zab mo ting 'dzin la/ /gegs med rang dbang thob nas mthar phyin mdzod/ /rgyal khams spyi dang gangs ljongs sbas pa'i tshal/ /nad mug mtshon 'khrug dal yams mi 'byung zhing*/ /'di phyi dge ba'i las rnams lhun grub mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag dpon slob 'dus pa dang*/ /'brel thogs dad ldan sbyin bdag mi nor kun/ /nad gdon bar chad 'jigs brgyad zhi bar mdzod/

/tshe bsod 'byor stobs snyan grags mnga' thang nor/ /rlung rta longs spyod bde gshegs rgyas par mdzod/ khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum gyi/ /snang ba sgyur zhing 'dod rgu 'du bar mdzod/ /dgra gdon log sbyor byad rbod 'gal rkyen kun/ /rdul du brlag cing ming yang med par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag la sdang ba yi/ /do brdo phod btsugs 'gran btsal ya bo bzung*/ /log lta gshe skur bsam sbyor ngan sems 'chang*/ /ngo log rgyab ston mtho gnon dma' 'bebs sems/ /ka cha 'phrog bcom ri lung rgya bkrol zhing*/ /dben ri gnyan por log sbyor dkor nor 'tshe/ /dam nyams yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /dpal ldan dbang phyug lha mo khyod la gtad/ /drag mo 'dod khams bdag mo'i dus la bab/ /ma mo'i zhal nas nad kyi char pa phob/ /dmar nad dal yams mi rung sna tshogs thongs/ /don snying khong khrag kha nas skyug tu chug /bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs rten dang khrol/ /ma g.yel ma mo mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung*/ /bka' yi chad pa drag po rtsal ma zhan/ /mngon spyod phrin las gnyan po las ma 'gyang*/ /mchod bstod rtse gcig sgrub pa'i don ma chung*/ /rbad bskul tha tshig dmod pa'i las ma g.yel/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma 'di nyid rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab chos kyi grogs mo gcig pu yin 'dug pas/ bsangs mchod 'os bab che bas de ltar bri dgos zhes grub dbang mchog gyur drin can arya dhwa dzas dwang du blang skabs srung ma nyid dgyes tshul thugs rgyud bskul ba'i nyams kyang shar bar bstun/ sngags ming tshul 'dzin bdag gis stag gdong khang khyim du gang dran shar mar 'chol gtam du bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // (ci)༄༅/ ge sar naur bu dgra 'dul gyi bsang mchod/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hoḥ dpal ldan rdo rje gsang bdag 'gro ba'i mgon/

/gangs can ljongs kyi skyabs gnas dgra lha che/ /bdud dpung 'dul phyir srid gsum kha lo bsgyur/ /'dzam gling mi yi nyi ma seng chen rje/ /grub chen dpa' thul sum cu'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /mo sman mkha' 'gro sum cu grogs la byon/ /dgra lha wer ma stong dang rtsa gnyis dang*/ /ma sang bye ba sa ya 'bum sde bcas/ /ki bswo bhyo sgra go mtshon sna dgu gsol/ /stong gsum yud bskor rkyang bu rlung gshog chibs/ /mchod pa'i skyems gsol rnal 'byor lus la 'khyugs/ /bsang mchod gtor ma gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag gar 'gro gar 'dug kyang*/ /rgyal khams yongs dang khyad par sbas yul sogs/ /lam dgra bar chad dgra rkun jag chom sgrol/ /lus la rtsal dgu sems la dpa' gdeng mdzod/ /mtshon la rno ngar me 'bud mde'u sne drongs/ /dgra bo rang mtshon rang gshed rang la phob/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ sku phreng lnga pa nges don chos dbyings rang grol gyis mdzad pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // (chu)༄༅/ grib bsang bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /hūm̐ hrīḥ grib byung dang po gang nas byung*/ /grib byung lha min yul nas byung*/ /lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe/ /nyon mongs grib kyi mun pa des/ /lha chen kun la grib phog nas/ /dpal chen phyag na rdo rje yis/ /grib sel bsang gi las kyang mdzad/ hūm̐/ shing sna rin chen 'od 'bar brtsigs/ /nyon mongs grib kun byang gyur cig /dud pa nam mkha'i sprin dpung 'khrigs/ /steng grib chas pa byang gyur cig /bsang rdzas sna tshogs mchod pa yis/ /lha 'dre'i grib kun byang gyur cig /me stag phyogs bcur 'phro ba yis/ /gdon bgegs grib rnams byang gyur cig /me lce sna lnga 'bar ba yis/ /ma rig grib rnams byang gyur cig /thal ba sa la 'khyil ba yis/ /sa grib ma lus byang gyur cig /rin chen sna lnga'i mchod pa 'dis/

/ma rig dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sman sna ma lus mchod pa yis/ /bar chad snga phyi byang gyur cig /gtor ma sha khrag mchod pa 'dis/ /nyams chag grib kun byang gyur cig /bkra shis bde legs 'phel gyur cig / ces bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ bkra shis par shog/ // (je)༄༅/ mu khri'i bsang ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gsal ba'i mdun/ /bka' skyong gter gyi rgya 'dzin gnyer gyi bdag /sngags kyi dam gnas phrin las skyong mdzad pa'i/ /yul chen gzhi bdag a mye mu khri zhes/ /sku mdog dmar smug khro 'dzum rgyas pa'i nyams/ /dbu la sngags zhwa rdo rjes mtshan pa gsol/ /sku la dar nag phod ka rab mdzes gyon/ /phyag g.yas shel phreng drag sngags sna tshogs bgrang*/ /g.yon pas dar dkar rgyal mtshan dbyings su phyar/ /rtsal chen gdong lnga chas mdzes chibs nas su/ /rig 'dzin gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /zab chos phun tshogs rgyal mtshan ltar phyar zhing*/ /mi nub rab tu brtan pa'i tshul du gsal/ /de yi g.yas su pad rgyal mi rta dkar/ /dar dkar gsol zhing zhi tshul rab mdzes gsal/ /g.yon du kham rgyal mi dmar btsan gyi tshul/ /dar dmar gos gsol btsan rta dmar zhur chibs/ /gtso bo'i gnas gsum 'od kyis bskul ba'i shugs/ /skad cig mchod sgrub gnas 'dir dzaḥhūm̐ hoḥ hūm̐/ dag pa'i snang ngor rab 'byams yid sprul dang*/ /dngos 'byor bsang gtor ye shes bdud rtsi bskyil/ /dgyes par bzhes la rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /zab chos dar rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing tshugs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi gang 'dod phrin las sgrubs/ / zhes mu khri'i bsang mchod nyung bsdus 'di nyams snang ltar rtsa gsum gling pas ri mor bris pa'o// // (nyo)༄༅/ spu rgyal gyi bsang mchod bde chen rol pa'i dga' ston bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pra bha ḍākki ye/ rigs 'dus rdo rje gsum gyi byed po las/ /phrin las 'od zer srid zhi'i dpal du shar/

/de yang spu chen dpa' bo'i sgrub gnas chen po de dag gi gsol mchod brtsam pa la/ phye mar phud rgod sogs dgyes pa'i phyi nang gi mchod pa legs par bkram nas/ hūm̐/ yid 'ong gling gi mchog gyur gangs can bod/ /'dzam gling rgyan gcig bkod pa'i maṇḍal ltar/ /gling gi cha la lha ri gangs kyi zhol/ /gnyan po dge bsnyen chen pos skyong ba'i yul/ /spu rgyal mthon rtse dmu rje dgra lha'i sras/ /mgul byang klu yi tsha bo srid pa'i lha/ /dkar smug zhi 'dzum rag pa rting dkar chibs/ /dar thod ber dang ral gri mdung dar 'dzin/ /'khor du klu yi skyes bu stag chas gsum/ /rang 'dra 'khor dang nyid sprul bcas pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /phyi nang spyan gzigs dkor cha mthun rdzas tshogs/ /dgra lha gnyan po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bstan pa'i bya ra dbyings la skyongs/ /chos mthun bsgrubs la bu bzhin 'grogs pa dang*/ /dmag jag 'khrug rtsod dgra yi rgol ba sogs/ /mi mthun blo bur 'gyu ba'i bdud srin byur/ /mthu ldan srung ma khyod kyis sgrol bar mdzod/ khyad par ched du dmod nas bskul ba ni/ /lha yi bstan pa skyong ba'i rig 'dzin grogs/ /phrin las mnga' ba khyod la bcol ba ni/ /gdung rabs mang bsdoms rlangs chen dpal seng gi /rigs dang cho 'brang skye rgyud rjes 'jug la/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mthun rkyen mel tshe sgron/ /ci bcol las sgrubs gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs/ /rje btsun rtsa gsum gling pa'i spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa skyong ba'i gnyer bsgos zhal bzhes ltar/ /mthun rdzas 'dod yon yid mtshar 'di bzhes la/ /bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs stsal du gsol/ / ces spu rgyal mthon rtse'i bsang mchod bsdus pa 'di nyid rlangs chen pa'i gdung 'dzin phun tshogs mtshan can gyis bskul bar brten rtsa gsum gling pas gter gyi kha byang dang bstun te nyams snang bzhin bris so//

// gze rgyal nor bdag brgyud 'debs thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhugs so/ e ma ho/ yon tan bkod pa lhun grub tsā ri tra/ /gnas mchog dag pa shel ri'i gzhal yas nas/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum nor lha gter bdag la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan 'gro kun rnams/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal 'jigs las kun grol nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med stsol ba dang*/ /mthar thugs gu ru'i go 'phang la 'god shog / rtogs ldan dkon rnam nas bskul ngor ma ldog tsam du yongs grags gze rgyal nor bdag cha rkyen brgyud 'debs sa bcad tsam ban rgan ā yu ming gis sbyar ba'o// // (ti)༈ gze rgyal nor bdag gi rgyal po las/ mngon rtogs bsam phel nor bu bzhugs so// // dngos grub 'byung ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang smon skyes rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi g.yang sgrub 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ thog mar g.yang gi gzhi stegs bu spyi ltar bgyis pa'i steng du/ dbang gi zangs snod dmar po 'bru yis bkang ba'i khar/ gtor ma rtsa gsum pad 'dab bzhi yis spras pa khyung 'brug seng gsum dang*/ nyi zla nor bu sogs kyis brgyan pa bsham/ mtha' bskor du bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun nor bu'i rigs/ chu gnas sna tshogs g.yung dwags sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ gzhan yang phye mar mar thud/ 'bru sna sman sna rin chen rigs mar gyi g.yag dkar lug dkar rta dkar gzhan yang go khrab mtshon cha'i spyan gzigs zhwa gos g.yang phor ma khus bkang ba/ gser dngul ja dar sogs srid tshad kyi yo byad phun sum tshogs pa bshams te/ gza' skar bzang po la bag phebs pa'i sar 'dug ste rtsa gsum gyi sgrub pa gang rigs sngon du song nas/ mdun bskyed la 'jug pa 'di skad do/ mchil 'debs snyan pos/ hrīḥ rang snang rnam dag padma 'byung gnas gsal/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag mdun gyi nam mkha' ru/ /sprin dkar rab mdzes 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i dbus/

/g.yu 'brug sngon po 'khyil ba'i gdan gyi steng*/ /smon skyes rdo rje rgyal po nor gyi lha/ /sku mdog dkar po zhi 'dzum bzhad pa'i zhal/ /dar dkar ber chen lhab lhub sprin ltar gtibs/ /dbu la dar dmar la thod nor bu'i tog /phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i dbyings la phyar/ /phyag g.yon nor gzhong rin chen ri ltar spungs/ /mchan khung g.yon du dar mdung dkar po bcug /rin chen rgyan ldan dar gyi cod pan 'phyang*/ /swag lham gsol zhing rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs/ /phyogs bzhi rigs bzhi'i ḍākki mched bzhi ni/ /dkar ser dmar ljang mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin/ /sprin dkar dbus su bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /rang mdog ber gsol brda skad lhang lhang sgrog /gtso bo'i smin mtshams rnam snang tshon gang gsal/ /mtshan bzang dpe byad rgyan rdzogs phyag gnyis kyis/ /mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'khor los mtshan pa bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung pad zlar lhang nger gsal/ /bdag nyid gu ru'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas/ /phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams nas/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /bsgoms 'dra'i rnam par bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin/ /spyan drangs mdun gyi lha dang dbyer med gyur/ hrīḥ rin chen dag pa shel gyi gzhal yas nas/ /gnod sbyin nor lha'i rgyal po rdo rje rgyal/ /gnas 'dir spyan drangs 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nyams chag bshags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang yangs pa'i mkha'/ /rab gang yongs 'gengs mi zad bdud rtsi'i gter/ /gzhan yang bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun/ /'khor 'das snod bcud ci srid mchod pa kun/ /bdag blos mngon bsdus mos pas rab bskul te/ /smon skyes rdo rje rgyal po nor gyi lha/ /'khor dang bcas la mchod cing mnga' gsol lo/ /dgyes par bzhes la sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/

/tshe dbang mchog thun nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra rā dza purṇe ratna dha na mi dhi hrī swā hā/ arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pañtsa rakta bha lingta ma hā pū dza hoḥ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos nyid ye shes lha/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gnod sbyin rdo rje rgyal/ /dngos grub nor gyi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /bdag la tshe dbang nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra rā dza purṇe ratna dha na mi dhi hrīḥswā hā/

zhes gang mang bzlas pas dngos grub nges par 'thob/ spu thog 'o sgug tu dbang chen gyi skabs nyams snang zhig tu gze rgyal nor lha'i tshul du zhal gzigs ltar/ bla tshang dge bshes dam chos phun tshogs kyis bskur ngor/ kho bo yongs grags rdo rjes sgo chen gnas kyi nye zhol du bris/ hrīḥ dus gsum bder gshegs rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi/ /phrin las thugs rje'i rol rtsal dbang gi lha/ /rdo rje rgyal po ye shes 'od lnga'i bdag /stong gsum khams 'dir 'gro ba'i yid dbang dang*/ /'byung lnga'i stobs bcu lha klu mi yi g.yang*/ /'khor 'das kun gyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor kun/ /'od lnga'i lcags kyus rang dbang med par bsdus/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje rgyal po nor bdag dbang gi rgyal/ /thugs rje'i shugs phyung 'dod don myur du stsol/ sarba ratna pā shaṃ ku ru bhrūm̐/ zhes dred rong sbas yul khang khyim du rig 'dzin hūm̐ sgra zil gnon rtsal gyis bris// // (thu)༈ gze rgyal nor sgrub bsam 'phel nor bu'i g.yang 'gugs zla ba'i 'od zhags bzhugs so/ na mo hrīḥ sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /hya ghṛ wa rta mchog dbang gi rgyal/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rigs mchog gsang ba'i bdag /gar gyi dbang phyug nor mchog kun gyi rje/ /phywa rje ling dkar khyod bstod sgrub mchog la/ /'dod rgu bsod nams mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ gang des g.yang 'gugs zla ba'i 'od zhags bstan/ /gang zhig sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dam ldan gyis/ /spos rol gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do/ hrīḥ spyan ras gzigs dbang padma he ru kaḥ phrin las thugs rje'i mnga' bdag nor gyi lha/ /srid pa'i phywa rje ling dkar dbyings nas bzhengs/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul pa'i tshogs/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu khyab par bskul/ /stong gsum gling bzhi srid pa'i phywa g.yang dang*/

/lha klu mi yi 'dod rgu longs spyod gter/ /rdo rje zhags pa lcags kyu'i pho nya yis/ /myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dir bsdus la/ /sgrub pa'i gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob/ /g.yang rdzas mchod gtor 'di la bcud bsdus la/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub thogs med stsol/ hūm̐/ chos nyid rang mdangs cha lugs ma nges kyang*/ /gang 'dul nor lha'i tshul ston rdo rje rgyal/ /sku mdog dkar po'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das khyab/ /'khor 'das srid pa'i phywa g.yang dbang du sdud/ /phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan mkha' la phyar ba yis/ /chos srid bstan pa'i mnga' thang srid rtser spel/ /g.yon pas nor gzhong thugs kar brten pa yis/ /dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor g.yang sgrub la stsol/ /mchan g.yon ru mtshon dkar po bsgrengs pa yis/ /rnal 'byor snyan grags ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo/ /dbu la dar thod nor bus brgyan pa yis/ /dkon mchog gtsug bkur dbu 'phang dgung du bstod/ /sku la rin chen brgyan dar spras pa yis/ /longs spyod 'dod rgu'i dngos grub char ltar 'bebs/ /g.yu 'brug sngon po'i gdan la 'gyings pa yis/ /chos nyid grags pas stong gsum khengs shing khyab/ /ḍākki sde bzhi'i 'khor gyis bskor ba yis/ /phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don lhun gyis 'grub/ /smin mtshams rigs kyi bdag po rnam snang dkar/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i dbyings nas sgrol 'don mdzad/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug gang 'dul 'gro ba'i mgon/ /gnod sbyin chen po smon skyes rdo rje rgyal/ /dus gsum bder gshegs rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rgya mtsho'i sgo/ /dbang sgyur nor lha'i rgyal po dzambha la/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i thugs dam dus la bab/ khams gsum srid pa yongs la 'gugs zhags thob/ /sgo gsum dbang po kun chings rang dbang sdus/ /tshe bsod stobs dpal dngos grub bdag la stsol/

hūm̐ hrīḥ srid pa'i phywa rje g.yang gi bdag po ste/ /dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje gzi 'od rgyal/ /sku yi sprul pa dkar pos 'brug la chibs/ /dkar po lha yi phywa g.yang bdag la sdus/ /gsung gi sprul pa dmar pos rgya stag chibs/ /dmar po btsan gyi phywa g.yang bdag la sdus/ /thugs kyi sprul pa sngon pos nya chen chibs/ /sngon po klu yi phywa g.yang bdag la sdus/ /yon tan sprul pa ser pos rta mchog chibs/ /ser po gnyan gyi phywa g.yang bdag la sdus/ /phrin las sprul pa ljang gsal seṅge chibs/ /gnod sbyin nor lha'i phywa g.yang bdag la sdus/ hūm̐/ lha klu gnyan mgon yum blon sprul pa'i tshogs/ /thugs rje'i dbyings nas dbang gi skur bzhengs la/ /stong gsum srid pa'i phywa g.yang longs spyod gter/ /dbang du bsdus la rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab pa'i g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /nyi zla bzhin du dro gsal mdangs 'od g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /skar tshogs bzhin du bkrag gsal 'khor mang g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /lho sprin bzhin du 'khrigs shing gtibs pa'i g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /sbrang char bzhin du 'dril zhing 'bab pa'i g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /bu yug bzhin tu 'tshubs shing bskor ba'i g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /skyi bser bzhin du stong gsum g.yo ba'i g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /chu bo bzhin tu rgyun chad med pa'i g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /rgya mtsho bzhin tu 'khyil zhing mer ba'i g.yang*/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ /ri bo bzhin tu brjid cing brtan chags g.yang*/

/sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir khug la rten 'dir stims/ hrīḥ rdo rje mkha' 'gros zhi ba'i tshe g.yang khug /rin chen mkha' 'gros rgyas pa'i tshe g.yang khug /padma mkha' 'gros dbang gi tshe g.yang khug /las kyi mkha' 'gros mngon spyod g.yang khug cig /rang 'dra sprul pa'i ḍākki 'bum 'bum gyis/ /stong gsum srid pa gsum gyi phywa g.yang dang*/ /'khor 'das snang srid kun gyi tshe bsod dpal/ /'byung bzhi bcud dang rkang bzhi phyugs kyi g.yang*/ /gser dngul zangs lcags ja dar dbyig gi tshogs/ /zas nor 'bru rigs longs spyod dkor cha'i rigs/ /ma lus rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yang la khug /phyi nang snod bcud 'dod rgu'i gter la spyod/ /mi yi tshe spel nor gyi g.yang sgo phyes/ /bu nor bde skyid dpal 'byor mnga' thang stobs/ /gzi brjid bkrags mdangs bcud g.yang thams cad kun/ /thugs rje'i rtsal gyis dbang bsdus bdag cag la/ /mi zad rin chen gter gyi phung po ltar/ /bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ ces 'dod don gyi phrin las bcol zhing g.yang 'gugs so/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ ྀatsha: zhes gze rgyal nor sgrub bsam 'phel nor bu'i g.yang 'gugs zla ba'i 'od zhags zhes pa 'di ni gnas mchog gze rgyal gyi gnas bdag tu dbang thob phur pa'i chos bdag tu lung gis bsngags pa ni/ 7 bla ma dam pa 'phags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs kyi bka' yis bskul ba la brten nas ke gzhung rta rgyal zhes dbang chen hya ghṛ wa'i thugs gnas tsitta mchong gur smug po'i nye zhol rta lung rta mdzod g.yang gi rwa ba der 7kho bo yongs grags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra zil gnon rtsal gyis lcags bya zla12tshes3la dge bar bris// // (de) thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hrī/ ka dag chos sku'i rang mdangs rdo rje rgyal/ /ye shes rang rtsal sku lnga'i rang 'od kyis/ /gnas 'dir byin phob sgrub mchog rnal 'byor gyi/ /lus ngag yid la smin grol dbang bzhi bskur/

/phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub rdzas 'khor nor la/ /bgegs dang log 'dren 'tshe ba kun zhi zhing*/ /'dod rgu dngos grub mchog thun gegs med stsol/ /'chi med tshe dang rgas med dwangs ma'i bcud/ /'dzad med bsod nams nor g.yang yid bzhin gter/ /bdag la thugs rjes byin mthus myur 'grub mdzod/ gze rgyal nor lha'i tshul du bskul ba 'di nyid bla ma dam chos phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor 7kho bo yongs grags rdo rjes gnas kyi nye zhol du sbyar ba'o// // (no) gze rgyal nor sgrub kyi tshogs bskang 'dod rgu lhun po bzhugs so// // dngos grub 'byung ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ gang zhig sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /smon skyes rdo rje rgyal po yi/ /tshogs mchod 'dod rgu'i lhun po bstan/ /tshogs gtor 'byor tshogs bza' btung bsham/ /bsang sbyangs byin rlabs 'di ltar bya/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ tshogs rdzas ma dag dri ma'i tshogs/ /dmigs med stong pa'i rang bzhin gyur/ /tshogs gtor 'dod yon bza' btung lnga/ /zad med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi bran la/ de nas spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing*/ /ye shes lnga ldan 'od lnga'i zhing khams nas/ /rdo rje rgyal po gnod sbyin nor gyi lha/ /rigs bdag rnam snang rigs bzhi ḍākki tshogs/ /gnas 'dir tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs khang rin chen brtsegs pa'i khang dbus su/ /mi g.yo dgyes bzhugs bdag la dngos grub stsol/ hrīḥ bsod nams nor gyi 'byung gnas rdo rje rgyal/ /smon lam thugs rje'i gzi brjid stsol mdzad pa'i/ /yab yum gtso 'khor sprul pa yang sprul la/ /'dod yon zad med tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /dgyes par bzhes la mchog gnyis yid bzhin gter/ /rnal 'byor bdag la 'bad med myur 'grub stsol/

om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā rā dza ha ri ni sa ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi/ zhes tshogs phud phul/ de nas bskang ba ni/ phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid bdun/ /'jig rten srid pa'i khams 'dir srid rtog rigs/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du byin brlabs nas/ /'dod rgu longs spyod stong gsum khams khengs pa'i/ /mchod rdzas rten rdzas sgrub pa'i yo byad kyis/ /rigs bdag rnam par snang mdzad thugs dam bskang*/ /gnod sbyin rdo rje rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /gsang ba rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rang rang sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag bzod par bzhes/ hoḥ gnod sbyin nor bdag yab yum sras 'khor sprul/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag la dgongs/ khyed kyi sku gsung thugs yon phrin las la/ /ma rig dbang gis 'gal zhing nyams pa yi/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ /bskyed rdzogs ma gsal mchod gtor rdzas ma tshang*/ /phrin las gzhung nyams bzlas brjod grangs ma tshang*/ /dkon mchog mchod rdzas 'bags btsog ser snas bcings/ /sbyin pa'i shugs dman ma byin thabs blangs sogs/ /nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus mthol lo bshags/ /bzod par gsol la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ ces yig brgya bzla/ de nas lhag ma gtong ba ni/ hoḥ gnod sbyin chen po'i bka' sdod bran gyi tshogs/ /phud la mi dbang lhag sdud bran gyi sde/ /dam rdzas lhag gtor bka' yi pha 'bab longs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe slob dpon padma yi/ /bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can/ /ma yo gwa zhur zhes grags pa'i/ /smon skyes rdo rje mched gsum po/ /yum sras slob 'bangs mngags pa'i tshogs/ /pho nya lha klu gnyan dmag sde/ /sprul pa yang sprul du ma bcas/

/gdung bas mchod phyir spyan 'dren no/ /brtse bas 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes/ /sangs rgyas bka' yi bstan pa srungs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe bsod spel/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ /mthun pa'i bsam don chos bzhin sgrubs/ /ma g.yel rtag tu mel tshe mdzod/ /dgra bgegs dam sri tshar chod cig /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces gtor ma phul/ kho bo yongs grags rdo rjes ke gzhung rta mda'i srib thang du rang don kho nar sbyar ba'o/ de nas chad mdo ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe sku gsum bka' brgyud bla ma yi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs bstan srung zhal bzhes pa'i/ /ye shes 'jig rten sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /chad mdo bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bstan pa'i rgyud srung rnal 'byor phrin las sgrubs/ /ma yel ma 'da' dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ zhes phul lo/ hūm̐/ myur mgyogs stobs ldan gnod sbyin rdo rje rgyal/ /dregs pa sde brgyad bka' yi 'khor dang bcas/ /dbyings nas skur bzhengs dgra bgegs bdud dpung thul/ /dam sri 'byung po ltog 'gong god 'dre zlog /nad yams dgra gyod dbul sri tshar chod la/ /drag po bka' yi phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces zor 'phang*/ brtan ma ni/ bhyo/ bod khams skyong mdzad brtan ma bcu gnyis ni/ /bran dang g.yog 'khor bka' yi gtor ma bzhes/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs rnal 'byor phrin las spel/ /bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs tshar chod cig / ces phul/ rta bro ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs dbyings nas chos nyid bro/ /bdud dgra 'dul phyir rang rtsal rig pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri nam yang mi ldang ba'i/ /thabs shes gnyis med rol pa'i bro brdungs so/ om̐ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan/ zhes mnan no/ de nas dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /phrin las lnga yi sgo phyes 'dod rgu'i gter/

/rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ om̐ badzra ma hā rā dza ha ri ni sa sarba ratna siddhi hoḥ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos nyid ye shes lha/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gnod sbyin rdo rje rgyal/ /dngos grub nor gyi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /bdag la tshe dbang nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ de nas bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes dbyings kyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig dbang gis lus ngag yid/ /log par rtog spyod ye shes lha tshogs kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa mthol lo bshags/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal bzla/ de nas bkra shis ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku'i bkra shis lta ba mkha' ltar dag /longs sku'i bkra shis sgom pa 'ja' ltar shar/ /sprul sku'i bkra shis spyod yul mtha' las 'das/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces bkra shis gang rigs brjod/ de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni/ hoḥ bdag gi tshe rabs kun tu bsags pa yi/ /dge ba rgya cher 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /'gro kun rdo rje 'chang dbang skur thob nas/ /'pho med chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig / de nas bsdu rim ni/ hoḥ phyi snod 'khor 'das mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*/ /nang bcud dran rig chos nyid klong du bsdu/ /ka dag brjod med ye shes dbyings su yal/

zhes de yi ngang du bzhag /de nas rjes dran ni/ hoḥ rang snang stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /skad cig lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin/ /mi dmigs ngang du lham mer gsal/ hūm̐ hrī āḥ zhes rtag chad mtha' bsal lha yi rol par bsam/ zhes lho 'brong dpon sde mnga' thang rgyas pa'i lung byang ltar byang spu thog khar jo bo gze rgyal tshe bum gling nas gdan drangs pa'i phur pa bdud 'dul gsang ba snying thig gi dbang chen skabs/ gze rgyal nor lha'i tshul du skur bzhengs nas zhal gzigs pa ltar thor byung bkod pa'i las byang chung ba la brten pa'i tshogs bskang zhig dgos zhes/ chos dbyings padma rang grol gyi bzhed don ltar/ spu stod be'u tshang nor mdzod kyi lung par sa chos dar tshang gi zhi khro'i rol mtshams gcig la snyug ma thang la ma bzhag par 'phral mgyogs zla 9tshes 13la kho bo yongs grags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra zil gnon rtsal gyis bris pa'o// // (pi)༄༅/ pra yi lha mo'i shwa mo kun gsal sgron me nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs so// ḍākki pra rgyal sku la 'dud/ ces pa 'di yang pra lha gsal nas/ gser skyems btang la/ stong pa'i las rang nyid skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal byed pra yi lha mo spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung gsal ba'i dbyings klong nas: dur khrod tshogs khang ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas: ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: zab gsang ye shes dgyes pas gnas 'dir bzhugs: dam rdzas mchod gtor gser skyems gnyan po bzhes: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: ma yengs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: gsal byed sngags/ oṃ ka ra ka ra da nga ra da nga ra thib thib tha ye swā hā/ gsal byed sngags stong tsam brjod la/ bhyoḥ kā li kā li dhe wi kā li badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ci nus mthar spro bar mos na gser skyems dang bcas/ bhyoḥ

ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs ya la la: sku la dar dkar go zu gsol: rin chen thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan pu ru ru: phyag g.yas sna tshogs mda' dar 'dzin: g.yon pas 'phrul gyi me long bsnams: ratna mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phyang ldan: klu yi chu rta sngon po chibs: sga srab dar stan khrigs se khrig: rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i shugs 'chang ma: gsang ba gter gyi grogs mdzad ma: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ma: las bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes/ /rno mthong gsal ba'i sgron me ston/ /gtsug lag lha dang rtsis kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes kyi bdag /yul ri'i gzhi gnas ma lus la/ /dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes/ /rno mthong gsal ba'i sgron me ston/ /brtag bya'i bya ba gang 'di dag /legs nyes blang dor ma 'dzol bar/ /the tshom med par mngon sum du/ /ye shes spyan ldan khyed kyis ston/ /sngon tshe gu ru'i bka' bzhin du/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ mthar ye dharma brjod la/ bdag gis brtag bya'i bden pa brdar bas legs nyes ci yong gsal por blang dor nor ba med par ston cig / bzlas shwa dang phreng ba sogs la phu btab/ the tshom med par dbab par bya'o/ phreng ba la bcad pa'i grangs ni sum tsho ru gcod dgos pa yin/ shwa yin na dung shwa la sngags/ shwa dang phreng ba gang byas kyang chog (1) shwa mig gcig la babs na/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ gangs dkar rtse la seng chen 'gying*/ /g.yu ral sprugs pas gling bzhi srung*/ /chos rgyal bla ma rgyal po sogs/ /ban bon mi chen khong la bzang*/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ mi nor zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang phyugs gsum 'phel/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ mi khyod gtso bo mi chen gyi rgyud yin pas/ lag gang gi nor spyod/ rgyab gang gi gos gyon/ kha gang gi zas za/ spang gang gi rta rgyugs/ mig gang gi ltad mo blta/

bde skyed ldan pa'i mo 'di bzang ba yin/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ lus kyi bang mdzod la srog gi g.yung drung 'khyil/ lo gsum bar du btsan dug rjen zas byos kyang mi 'chi/ mi mgo tho bas brdungs kyang mi 'chi/ tshe srog brag las sra bas bzang ngo*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bu dang bu mo yi mtsho rdol bas legs/ /bza' mi 'grogs yun ring*/ bza' mi bzang la mang ngo*/ ༈ bu chung gi srid phywa/ tshe ring phan thog pas bzang*/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ btsan phyug 'phan dar bzang*/ lam phywa ni/ gser sder g.yu gzhong nor bu'i rdzas kyis bkang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra med gnyen dang 'phrad pas bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs ngo che la phun sum tshogs pas bzang*/ zas sha chang gnyis la ngoms shing za/ bsang gsol dang g.yang skyabs lha mo'i gsol kha/ rten 'dzugs byas na bzang*/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ blo 'di lha yi byas/ bsam don 'grub pas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la btsan gsol dang g.yang skyobs byas na shin tu bzang*/ ༈ khang pa dang e 'phrod ce na/ mi dang lha gnyis ka 'phrod/ dga' mgu yi rang*/ mi dar phyug dar khyim dang rwa ba gang bkra shis pas bzang*/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ don gang zhus na yang gnang bar 'dug pas bzang*/ ༈ don phywa ni/ ngo so grogs dang bcas par gang bsam 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ dga' spro dang bcas par myur bar sleb pas bzang*/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong grogs lha yis byas mi kha gleng gyod med pas bzang*/ ༈ nyen gyod yod med ni/ nyen gyod med/ gtam snyan stong gsum khyab/ ༈ slob dpon dang e 'phrod ce na/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs myur du zhus na shin tu 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ lha rje la gtang rag gzab/ shin tu 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ bu chung 'di chos pa e yong zhe na/ bu chung 'di chos byas na shin tu bzang*/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg rim 'gro e 'phrod ce na/ shin tu 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ nad pa e sos zhe na/

srog lhas 'tshos/ tshe nyi zla ltar mnyam pas mi shi bas bzang*/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ bdud dang ma mo gson 'dre gdon/ bdud bzlog /ma mo'i mdos/ 'dre mo bkar yas sogs bya/ ༈ bor stor e rnyed ce na/ g.yang sgo ma ral pas myur du btsal na rnyed pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra jag rkun gsum e thul zhe na/ dgra pham rang rgyal kha lon pas bzang*/ ༈ sems can bsten pas e 'phrod ce na/ shin tu 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ mdza' rogs e rnyed ce na/ rnyed pas bzang*/ ༈ srid e chags zhe na/ srid pa pho rgyud song bas bzang*/ ༈ shags kha rgyal lam zhe na/ kho'i mgo la mu gab zhwa gyon nas 'dug pas rang rgyal la kha smras med pas bzang*/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ chang ni zhim pas gser skyems bdud rtsis gtams dang 'dra bas bzang*/ ༈ rtse mo'i rigs e 'phrod ce na/ dga' bar 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs zhe na/ kha char myur du 'bebs pas bzang*/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ dkor shin tu 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa e 'phrod ce na/ lam 'phrang med pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ mi khyod la dgra lhas mgon pas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gar 'gro lam la dgra med pas bzang*/ (2) shwa mig gnyis pa babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho la khrag gi char pa 'bebs/ gangs dkar rtse la gnam lcags thog rdo lhung zer bas ngan/ rgyal bka' sgrog /cho ga 'tshogs/ mtshan 'bar gso/ rgyun bsten gsol mchod rigs/ bka' phur gshin gsum/ gdugs dkar bzlog bsgyur/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg /spong dag sogs la 'bad pa gal che/ ༈ khyim ni e 'phrod ce na/ ngan pas gser gyi ka ba 'gyel/ g.yu yi gdung ma chag /yas kyi bdud g.yos/ mas kyi sri langs/ shi chad 'ong bas shin tu'ang ngan/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ gzhis la 'dug na shi chad 'byung*/ byis su 'gro na bor stor 'byung*/ g.yas nas rnyed na g.yon nas 'chor/ lus kyi stobs shor/ kha yi gtam zad pas ngan no/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ mi 'phrod pha me'i dur sri langs/

nad drag po 'ong nyan che/ rgyal bka' dag sgrog sogs rim 'gro stobs chen dgos/ ༈ srid phywa e 'phrod ce na/ bud med kyi srid phug tu 'dre mos gnod pa 'byung bas ngan/ ༈ bu chung gi srog phywa ni/ shing kha'i bye'u chung khras bcom pa dang 'dra/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ shi chad dang god kha yong ngo che bas ngan/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ blo 'dre yis bslus pas bsam don mi 'grub pas ngan no/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs phyi nas tshur yong med khar phar 'chor nyen yod/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ mi la mdze 'ong*/ phyugs la god kha yong*/ 'pho skyas yang yang yong bas ngan/ ༈ khang pa e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod pas sa 'dir bkra mi shis/ nam phugs mi nor rjes med du 'gro bas ngan no/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ mi gnang kha 'gyod snying stong 'ong bas ngan no/ don med stong log byed/ phed stong phrag par khur bas shin tu ngan/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ mgron mi 'ong bas ngan/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong nyes yong bas ngan/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod pas shin tu ngan/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ phan las gnod pa mang bas mi 'phrod/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod sman dpyad bshol na legs/ ༈ bu chung gi chos phywa ni/ chos mgo mi thon mi kha che bas ngan/ ༈ nad pa e sos zhe na/ 'dre ngan gyi srog bcad nyen che bas ngan/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ gza' dang rgyal pos gdon/ gza' mdos dang*/ rgyal mdos/ gu ru zhi drag gi tshogs 'bum btang na legs/ ༈ bor stor e rnyed ce na/ bor stor m-i yis khyer des bya'o/ ༈ dmag jag e thul zhe na/ 'chi bdag 'dra ba myur du slebs pas mgo chag rkang grug yong bas rang pham/ mi nor thams cad mi la shor bas shin tu ngan/ sems can e 'phrod ce na/ phan mi thogs pas mi 'phrod ngan/ ༈ mdza' rogs e rnyed ce na/ mi rnyed gal te rnyed na gyod dang kha mchu god kha 'ong bas ngan/ ༈ srid e chags she na/ mi chags srid kyi mtsho mo skam pa'i ngo*/

༈ shags kha 'byed na e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod shin tu ngan/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ chang mi zhim pas ngan/ ༈ bzo rigs e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod bshol na legs/ ༈ lo e legs she na/ mi legs/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs she na/ kha char mi 'bebs than pa 'ong bas ngan/ ༈ rtse mo e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod ngan/ ༈ lam phywa e 'phrod ce na/ bor stor yong bas ngan/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ dkor mi yong bas ngan/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra btsan la khas grags shig 'ong bas ngan/ (3) shwa mig gsum pa la babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi 'og nas gser gyi nyi ma dgu shar/ sa padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng na rin po che sna dgu'i khri brtsegs pas gang la'ang bzang por shar/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ mi mang phyugs 'phel bu nor gyi char 'bebs pas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ pho phywa ni/ pho lha dgra lha mchod cing bzang*/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ tshe ring nad med pas bzang*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ srid phug che/ nad med gnyen gyis byams gces che la yun ring bzang*/ ༈ bu chung srid phywa ni/ lo lnga'am bcu tshun la bar chad mi 'ong*/ dbang thang che zhing mi chen 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ gser gzhong mar khus gang*/ zas nor longs spyod 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ shin tu legs pas rab kyi mchog yin bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs phun sum tshogs par 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ rmang gzhi rin chen gser las byas/ 'gyur med g.yung drung rin chen yin/ mi nor zas gsum 'dzoms/ longs spyod 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ 'phral du ma gnang yang phug tu gnang ngo 'dug ༈ khang phywa e 'phrod ce na/ lha bzang po 'khor bas mchod nas bsten na bzang*/ nor stor ngo 'dug ༈ don phywa ni/ don ci bsam 'grub rang nyid dga' bas bzang*/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ kha zas ja chang myur du bzos dang myur du sleb/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong grogs lha yis byas pas tshong khe zhing tshong kha rgyal bas bzang*/

༈ nyes 'gyod yod med ni/ nyes 'gyod med pas bzang*/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce na/ slob dpon 'di rang gi chog /shin tu bzang*/ ༈ bu chung gi chos phywa ni/ tshe ring nad med 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ lam sna lha yis khrid pas bzang*/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ gzhan la ma shor na 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg e 'phrod ce na/ lha rje la gtang rag gzob dang*/ 'phrod ngo che bas bzang*/ ༈ nad pa e sos zhe na/ nad gzhi che bas rim 'gro la 'bad na sos pa gda' skad/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ bdud btsan gyis gdon/ bzlog pa drag po/ btsan mdos/ brgya bzhi/ mgo gsum bcas sgrub/ ༈ bor stor rnyed dam mi rnyed ce na/ gser gyi mdzo g.yag ri nas shor na sna thag ka bar btags pas lho phyogs nas btsal na rnyed pas bzang*/ ༈ dmag jag rku gsum e thul ce na/ ru dar gnam la phyar bas bswo sgra sgrog /mtshon cha dgra la btab pas mi nor gnyis thul ba'i ngo shar bas bzang*/ ༈ sems can 'di bsten na 'phrod dam zhe na/ 'phral du dge zhing*/ phugs su phan thogs/ ༈ mdza' rogs e rnyed ce na/ rnyed de phan thogs shing bzang*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bu ru 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ gtam lab e 'phrod ce na/ 'phrod de rang nyid rgyal gtam snyan thos ngo yod/ ༈ chang e zhim zhe na/ rdo dkar por khroṃ bris la lums nang du bzhag na chang zhim par 'gyur bas bzang*/ ༈ bzo rigs byas na/ legs pas bzang*/ ༈ lo legs sam zhe na/ so nam rnams la legs pas bzang*/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs zhe na/ shin tu 'bebs pas bzang*/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ dkor 'phel phan thog pas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ lam dar bas 'jam dgra med pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra lha dar bas dgra ming mi grags bzang*/ (4) shwa mig bzhi par babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ ri bo mthon po'i rtse yi na bun dang 'dra/ yong yong 'dra yang yong dus med/ tha ma 'ja' bzhin yal nas 'gro bas ngan no/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ mi nor bang mdzod 'thor nyen che bas ngan/

༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ gnya' gnon dang dgra rkun ma nyes kha yog yong nyan 'dug /dgra rkun dang dug la 'dzems dgos/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ tshe yi dmu thag chad pas skyon che/ bla bslu dang*/ 'chi bslu/ tshe dbang tshe sgrub rtags thon bcas sku rim la 'bad/ ༈ nyes 'gyod yod med ce na/ nyen 'gyod yong shi chad god kha 'ong bas ngan no/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ tshe stod skyid la tshe smad sdug byis pa chung gsum sos dka' bas ngan no/ ༈ bu chung gi mo la/ bla tshe the'u rang dang gson 'dres rkus pas ngan no/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ shi god bor stor yong 'dug pas ngan/ bya ba legs lam gang byas kyang mgo thon mi yong ngan/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ bya ba mang la 'go thon pa gcig kyang med pas ngan no/

༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ kha smras dang gleng 'gyo mang bas ngan/ ༈ khang pa e 'phrod ce na/ khang stong che bas mi nor gnyis ka phung bas ngan/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ mi gnang gzhan la zhus na legs/ ༈ don phywa ni/ gang bsam mi 'grub ngan/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ mgron lam chu yis gcod pas yong ngo med/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ pham par 'dug pas ngan/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod bzhag na legs/ ༈ bu chung gi chos phywa ni/ chos byas na bar chad mang bas ngan/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod pas gzhan la zhus na legs/ ༈ nad pa e sos she na/ nad pa la kha'i bya sgro dang 'dra bas gar 'gro nges pa med pas ngan/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ sde brgyad dang klu yis gnod/ bka' brgyad/ klu 'bum/ bsang gsol/ rim 'gro stobs chen 'grub na legs/ ༈ bor stor rnyed dam zhe na/ blo rgyab tu bskyur/ re ba ma che mi rnyed pas ngan no/ ༈ dmag jag rku gsum e thul zhe na/ dmag dpon rkang pa chags dmag mi shi chad 'ong bas mi thub bshol na legs/ ༈ sman dpyad e 'phrod ce na/ sman dpyad gtar bsreg bshol na legs/ ༈ sems can e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod/ ༈ mdza' grogs e rnyed ce na/ mi rnyed/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bu yin na ming spos lus bsgyur ba sogs ma byas na srog 'tsho dka' bu mo yin na 'bring*/ ༈ gzhan la gtam rgyal lam zhe na/ rang gzhan gnyis ka phung ba'i rgyu yin pas bshol na legs/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ chang nang du the'u rang 'dug pas chang mi zhim/ ༈ bzo rigs e 'phrod ce na/ dge bar mi 'gyur bas ngan/ ༈ lo legs sam mi legs zhe na/ lo nyes mu ge che bas ngan no/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs she na/ 'brug glog sgra che yang char mi 'bebs/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ dkor dang grong chog rag dka' bas ngan/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ dgra rkun gyis gnod ngo 'dug pas ngan/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra 'chi bdag 'dra ba yong*/ mi gsod nor 'chor 'gro bas ngan no/ (5) shwa mig lnga pa la babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/

mi nub rgyal mtshan phyar/ snyan grags stong gsum gang bar khyab pas bstan pa dar la yun ring bas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ khyim bdag sa yi lha mo bstan mas byas pas lo legs bkra shis nor 'phel mi tshe bskyel bas bzang*/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ khyod la pho lha dgra lhas mgon/ ci byas lam du 'gro/ dga' ba'i nam langs/ skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ tshe ring nad med shin tu bzang*/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ khyod kyi srog lcags khang dgu rim du tshud/ mgo tho bas brdungs kyang mi 'chi bas bzang*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bud med bzang mo bag gsar la bu dang bu mo spel bas bzang*/ 'phral bas phugs skyid pas bzang*/ ༈ bu chung gi mo la/ bu chung 'di nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'dzam gling gsal/ btsun pa byas na bla ma 'ong*/ skye bo byas na dpon po 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ rang la nor med pas sdug bsngal mi dgos nor lha gnyan pa dzambha lhas byed 'tsho skyong shes na de kas chog ༈ blo phywa ni/ 'phral phugs kun la bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ rang gi gang 'dod grogs dang 'phrad pas bzang*/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ bzang*/ ༈ khang pa bzang ngan ni/ mi rgyud bzang la phyi dal che/ ༈ zhu ba e yong ce na/ don 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ myur du 'ong*/ yun bsring phyi dal che/ ༈ nyes 'gyod yod med ni/ nyes 'gyod med la gang 'dod 'grub/ ༈ don phywa ni/ gang byas lam du 'gro/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong grogs lha yis byas pas rang mi rgyal ba'i ka med 'phral lhod la phugs brim pas bzang*/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce na/ slob dpon ni tshe rabs mang po'i slob dpon yin shin tu bzang*/ ༈ bu chung chos phywa ni/ bu 'di tshe rabs du mar sbyang 'phro yod pas chos byas na bzang*/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ sman pa 'di bzhugs na ngo so che shin tu bzang*/ brtson 'grus bskyed/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg e 'phrod ce na/ 'phral du 'bring zhing*/ phugs su dge

/gang byas lam du 'gro zhing bzang skad/ ༈ nad pa e sos zhe na/ nad gzhi che srog skyon med pas bzang*/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ rgyal btsan dang gri bos gnod/ gu drag gi dbang dang gtor bzlog bsnyen sgrub sogs rim 'gro stobs chen la 'bad dgos/ ༈ stor ba e rnyed ce na/ nye 'khor du 'dug 'phral du song rtsad chod rnyed/ ༈ dmag jag pham rgyal ci yong zhe na/ rang thob par 'ong*/ ༈ sems can e 'phrod ce na/ 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ mdza' grogs e rnyed ce na/ mdza' grogs 'di tshe sngon gyi grogs yin pas bzang*/ ༈ srid e chags zhe na/ srid pho ru yin na bzang*/ ༈ gtam dang rgyal kha e lon zhe na/ rang bsten srung ma mchod na rang rgyal kha lon/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ 'dre mo bkar yas byas na bzang*/ ༈ bzo rigs e 'phrod ce na/ 'phrod la bzang*/ ༈ lo e legs she na/ 'bru 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs zhe na/ kha char dus su 'bebs pas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ lam lha mchod lam bde grogs bsten pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra med byas pa'i gnyen dang 'phrad/ gtam snyan thos pas shin tu bzang ngo*/ (6) shwa mig drug pa la babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ sa padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng g.yu yi dpag bsam ljon shing skye/ ljon shing rtse la bya rgyal khu byug gi gsung snyan phyogs bcur sgrog pas sang phod da tsam gtam snyan rgyal khams yongs la khyab pas bzang*/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ 'dod 'jo'i ba la be'u skye/ zas nor longs spyod 'phel/ ma yi pang la bu skye/ zas nor dbang du 'du/ las ci byas kyang bzang*/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ bla ma mi dpon rje 'bangs ser skya yongs la bzang*/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ tshe srog rdo rje'i brag las sra/ dmu thag lha dang 'brel/ na tsha rkyen 'gyod med/ ban bon stong gi mthu kha yod kyang mi thub pas bzang*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bud med 'di la klu mo 'khor bas/ bu nor 'phel zhing 'phral phugs kun la bzang*/ bu chung srid phywa ni/

thu ba g.yas nas pho lhas skyob/ g.yon nas mo lhas bskyab pas bzang*/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ gang bsam shin tu bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs ngo che/ bsam pa 'grub pas bzang*/ sa mkhar yul 'dzin rmu thag gsham du sbrel/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ longs spyod g.yang 'phel mi dar lha dar yin/ khang pa dpag bsam lo 'dab rgyas/ nor lha mchod na phyugs lug 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ nyes 'gyod yod med ni/ g.yang 'gugs dang lha srung mchod na nyes 'gyod med/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ thang dkar rgod la shor/ gshog drug rgyas pas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs gang bsam pa 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ sa mkhar yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ rmu thag gnam du sbrel nor phyugs longs spyod g.yang mtsho 'khyil/ mi dal lha dal yong*/ mi rabs bcu gsum bar brtan cing bkra shis par 'gyur/ dpag bsam ljon shing la lo 'bras rgyas pa 'dra bas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ thugs dpal be'u sgo phyes/ zhabs pad mi 'dzum mdangs gsal/ mi khyod ci 'dod gyur du gnang*/ shin tu dge ba'i ngo yin/ ༈ don phywa ni/ bsam pa'i don yang 'grub/ kha mdog mdang skyes snying dga' mul le/ don 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ mgron zas khur bcas myur du 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong rgyal nor dang bcas 'phral phugs kun la phan thogs pas bzang*/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce ni/ slob dpon thugs rje byin rlabs che/ tshe rabs gsum gyi slob dpon 'di/ bka' drin che bas shin tu 'phrod/ phan shin tu thogs/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce ni/ sman pa'i sman rkyal bdud rtsis bkang ba gzhan la ma shor 'di rang gis chog ༈ bu chung gi chos phywa ni/ 'di phyi gnyis ka la phan pa'i chos yong bas bzang*/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg 'phrod dam zhe na/ yun ring ma 'gyang myur du bgyis na nad pa sos/ srog skyon med pas bzang*/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ klu dang sa bdag gis gnod pas/ klu mchod klu gtor thongs/

klu 'bum snang brgyad klu yi spang bkong sa bdag 'khrug bcos byas pas phan/ ༈ bor stor e rnyed ce na/ g.yang sgo ma bye bas myur du rnyed/ ༈ dmag jag rkun gsum e thul zhe na/ dmag dpon gzhu mchog sgril/ dmag dpon gyis dgra 'ded/ dgra bo myur du phung*/ dgra lha gsol mchod byas nas kha pho bsdams pas chog ༈ sems can 'di 'phrod dam zhe na/ shin tu 'phrod pas g.yang 'khor nor phyugs 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ mdza' rogs e rnyed ce na/ 'dzum gyis mdun bsus/ zas dang skyems kyi ngor/ thag thogs med par bzang thal che/ ༈ srid e chags zhe na/ srid mo ru gda'/ g.yang sgrub byas na pho ru 'ong*/ gser bas bzang*/ ༈ gzhan dang gtam lab e 'phrod ce na/ rang rgyal myur du 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ bzo rigs gang la'ang dge/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ lan chags gtor ma gang mang btang na chang zhim por 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ lo e legs zhe na/ lo legs skya rgyas 'ong*/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs zhe na/ kha char 'phral du ma babs kyang dal du 'bab nas than pa mi 'ong*/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ bkra shis 'o ma'i mtsho mo 'khyil bas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ lam lhas sna khrid byes lam 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra dpung zhig nas mtshon cha'i so ngar yal/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad legs lam ci bsam 'grub/ ma rig gsal sgron mun gsal 'od po che/ ye shes lha mig thob pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di yang dgos ched rnal 'byor rnams/ /ma rig dmus long dug lnga'i las kyis bsgribs/ /chos byed zhen 'dzin bag chags rang nyid bsgribs/ /dud 'gro kha yan las ngan rang bsags bsgribs/ /bla ma dkor gzan rang mgo rang gis bsgribs/ /dge bshes btsun gzugs sdom khrims nyams pas bsgribs/ /yi dam chos skyong phud nyams 'bag pas bsgribs/ /gter srung bka' srung mchod gtor dman pas bsgribs/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag 'khrug srog gcod bsgribs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag thab 'khon mnol gtsog bsgribs/

/ri rgya rngon bshig mna' tho tha tshig bsgribs/ /sems can ser sna 'jur gegs tshogs bsags bsgribs/ /tha mal sems can a 'thas gol bas bsgribs/ /de yi nyes skyon 'od gsal mun pas g.yogs/ /gcig mgo gcig bskor zog por gsung gsal zhu/ /ma gsal mchog gsum bka' la bden med zer/ /mchog gsum bden med ma yin bslu ba med/ /de phyir the tshom spongs la bden pa brdar/ /mi chos zog rdzun smra dang mtshungs mi 'gyur/ ces so/ sems can rmongs pa gsal byed bdag gzhan kun la phan phyir ḍākki pra yi lha mo'i shwa mo kun gsal sgron me nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di'ang*/ rtsa gling zlos gar gsum pa gsang sngags bstan rgyal gyis lcags khyi hor zla brgyad pa'i mgo yi nyi mar bris pa dge bar gyur cig /nyes 'gal mchis na pra gsal lha la bshags so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // (phu) ༄༅/ ma hā gu ru la na mo: dge bsnyen gsol mchod byed par 'dod na: dmar gtor sbrul mgo can sbrul gyis dkris pa 'khor gyis bskor: gter bsrung bsang mchod byed skabs su: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis rlabs: hūm̐: sngon tshe padma'i bka' nyan pa: gter srung chen po dge bsnyen che: sku la g.yu khrab mthing rmog gsol: phyag na mdung dar rgyal mtshan bsnams: chibs su rta nag rting dkar chibs: klu yi dbang mo gter bdag ma: mi mo bzhin bzang sbrul gdong can: phyag na be te'i gter sgrom bsnams: yab yum 'khor dang sprul pa brgyad: mi sngon sna tshogs 'dod yon thogs: ma thog yud kyi gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i mnyes mchod 'bul ba ni: 'dod yon klu bshos sngon po dang : bsang dang gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod don sgrubs: klu g.yang dngos grub char ltar phobs: bskyel bsu rog dan mthu chen sgrubs: chos dang mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzod: hūm̐: sdang ba'i dgra la rbad rtsa na:

mtsho nag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus: brag ri nag po'i khong seng nas: klu yi rgyal po las la bskul: sngon tshe gsang bdag gtum po dang : padma 'byung gnas bka' bzhin tu: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma 'di: mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa dang : sems can yongs la sdang ba dang : rnal 'byor bdag la 'gras pa'i dgra: ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : tshad btsug 'gras 'tshol do bdo ba'i: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun: gtor ma 'di dang mnyam par bzhes: byad ma bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: nag po ti pa ra tsa nā ga phe laṃ sha truṃ ma rā ya dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag don snying la kha kha khā hi khā hi: gtor ma gtsang sar phul: bsang dang gser skyems 'bru yi mchod: 'di ni sgrub par mchod bstod kyis: phrin las sna tshogs rog dan mthun rkyen sgrub cing klu yi dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur: o rgyan gter bdag gling pas rdo rje lcags rong nas rig ldan gyi grogs dang bcas nas/ klu yi rgyal po la thod dkar po'i lag nas gsang gter du bgyis te mkha' 'gro shwa na ma yi ge las/ bod yig du nang chen badzra ā yur lakṣi ra'i pho brang gi nye 'dabs su sbas thabs su bsgyur ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel// // yang phur sbyin sreg 'don zin ni/ dang po bca' bzo phran tsam bkod pa la/ yang phur gong gtor bsdus pa/ las bzhi gtor ma/ me lha'i gtor ma mar la bca'/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dang po zhi ba la zhal zas/ rgyas pa la ril bu/ dbang la tshogs/ drag po dmar gtor liṅga/ dbang lnga phyi mchod nang mchod gzugs sgra dri ro sogs bca' ba'am par btab pa bsham/ dang po sbyin sreg nang nas/ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka nas rim bzhin mchod pa rnams byin rlabs/ dūrba rgya gram mam gangs ri rdo rje yis me mgo mnan/ sngags ni/ oṃ ram̐ su pa kṣa nas bhi wa kṣa bar 'don/ de nas me dar 'dzugs mtshams su/

tiṣṭha badzra bya/ oṃ ram̐ shu la shu ti? nas me lha bskyed/ rang bzhin sbar bar gyur nas me sgron rlung g.yab 'dzugs/ me mtshams bcad nas oṃ dharma tsakra ye swā hā nas/ hūm̐: chos sku'i dbyings nas rang bzhin sprul pa'i lha: sogs nas bzhugs gsol mchod pa nas sarba sa mu dra khā hi nas me lha'i rtsa sngags/ oṃ badzra agne ye swā hā: oṃ badzra raṃ a hu ti? sogs nas mar khu lan gsum phul/ de nas phyi mchod nas/ hūm̐: phyi yi mchod pa dpag yas nam mkha'i? sogs nas oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mgor me lha'i rtsa sngags dang mar khu sngags rnams re re bzhin sbrags dgos/ bsnyen pa sbrel ma tshar gsum re la dgang blugs re phul/ phyi mchod nas gsang mchod sgrol mchod sogs mchod pa yongs kyi bar mtshams su zhi rol bya/ 'dod gsol de kho na nyid kyi/ ho/ rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyi

sogs nas oṃ dharma dhā tu dzñā na ho hūm̐: bar 'don/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes khro bo rab 'bar dpa' bo'i sku: sogs nas waṃ shuddha ri ta ye swā hā nas mchod rol bya/ de nas dngos gzhi me lha bskyed chog ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas badzra ko la shrī shu ye swā hā nas spyan 'dren tshom bu yar gdan drangs/ hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar sogs nas mchod pa yan btang*/ de nas sbyin sreg gzhung gi rtsa sngags/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ nas oṃ badzra raṃ a hu te nas ka bhya swā hā yan tshar bdun btang*/ de nas sngar ltar phyi mchod nas shabda bar las byang gtso bsnyen sbrel ma lan bdun bya/ mchod rol bya/ gsang mchod sgrol mchod? rdzas bzhi sogs la rim bzhin dhe hūm̐ kṣa swā hā bar sngar bzhin mchod rol sogs bya/ de nas zhi ba'i phrin las/ hoḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sogs nas shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā bar btang*/ bstod pa la/ hūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang chen? sogs nas zhi mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar btang mchod rol bya/ gzhan rgyas pa dang drag po dbang rnams rigs 'gre/ de nas mchod bstod la dang po oṃ bar agne dang ka bhya swā hā bar mchod bkra bstod bkra bya/ me lha'i gtor ma me la phul/ bstod pa las byang bstod pa bya/ sum brdung de nas tshom bu dkyil 'khor steng ser phreng gyis gdan 'dren bya/ de nas phyogs bzhi'i dar rnams bsdu/ me lha'i dkyil 'khor bsdu/ de nas las byang dkyil 'khor mtha' bsdu/ ༄༅/ sngags kyi man ngag zab khrid kha shas bzhugs so// mig kha bas mi phyid pa'i sngags ni: rtsa la ma ma ha sa sha sa da: gangs la sngags nas mig la lhan: rmi lam gsal ba'i sngags ni: ta ta ti ti ma ma li li ya: skar ma zhogs chu la sngags nas 'thung dgos: phyugs la spyang ki srung ba ni: oṃ pa ya li ya le swā hā:

sa la stong sngags nas dud 'gro la gtor bas thub nges so: yang spyang chings ni: haṃ shaṃ swod swā hā: sngags pas thub: rta la btsan gyi gnod pa srung sngags ni: dza dza ram ram sbad sbad: lcag tshan la sngags nas brabs: mi zog gi nad gcod sngags ni: wa ra shag: sngags chu pho la sna khung g.yas: mo la sna khung g.yon nas blug dgos: khrag gcod sngags ni: rdo rje'i srog la bram ze rbad: zhes phu gdab: chang zhim pa'i sngags ni: oṃ zung zung ching ching ril ril: nyer gcig phabs la sngags: chang 'dre'i sngags ni: sdug 'dre'i snying la gzer ya: ngo la phu byas na phan: cham pa srung ba ni: oṃ sgrib swā hā: sna khung la phu bya: bor stor mi 'byung ba'i srung skud ni: skud pa nag khra la mdud pa bdun brgyab sngags ni: mi ri ti tse ke pe me: phrag pa'i gong ba la btags: lus po mi 'khyag pa'i sngags ni: oṃ ti sa ra ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'bri mar la sngags nas lus la byug: btsan srung ba'i sngags ni: skud pa dmar po la mdud pa gsum bya: ka ro sa ma la ga bhe ri kha: rta phyugs la btags: 'dre mo kha chings kyi sngags ni: skud pa dmar po la mdud pa gsum bya/ ya ba sha ra ba ga kha ma sa: mi nor gang dgos la btags: rta mnangs na: ma lu ti baṃ sod/ sngags chu sogs bya: byis pa mtshan ngu mi byed pa'i sngags ni: tri ci shang ku ru byis pa la rakṣa: srung skud la sngags nas lag par mdud: khyi mi 'ju ba'i sngags ni: oṃ dri kha dgra bo droṃ mā ra ya rbad: rma sngags ni: rtsa lam sod dkar dun: mi phyugs chu 'gag gi sngags: hūb chu hūb chu rdul chu rdul chu swā hā/ mar la sngags bya'o: rma gnyan skrang thab kun la phan sngags: thab kyi rgyal po me sod: me yi rgyal po bram ze sod: zab bo: dug rigs 'joms pa'i sngags ni/ sngags chu bya zhing : na sa'i phyi nas bsku: sngags rgod 'di ltar: oṃ nag po tsha ti sod: dug srin mgo dmar sod: a shi dug shan sod:

chu la brgya rtsa brgyad btab nas 'thung ngo : zab bo: zho chang la god kha sdang na: oṃ ma dur rbad: rde'u dkar nag la nyer gcig sngags na the tshom med: yang nyams sgrib sel ba'i sngags ni: yaṃ ya spra se phaṭḥspra ti sa aṅgu sha daḥdharma kā ya siddhi siddhi hūm̐: chu gtsang la bzlas te khrus dang btung ba byas na yugs sa ma'i mnyam du nyal lam: dme can gyi lag nas zas sogs cis kyang mi gnod de grib sel gyi mchog dam pa'o zhes so: yang sna khrag gcod pa'i thabs la: oṃ rtsa ti rtsa ti siddhi siddhi hūm̐ phaṭḥ khrag sna rbad do: zhes ci mang bzlas nas phu btab kyang rung : mtheb ngos su sngags lhan no: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yang byi ba kha chings ni/ oṃ ya sha ya sha kha sha kha sha dur ba dur ba byi ba gdug pa can gyi kha chings chings: brgya bzlas te nas la sngags: nas 'bru res byi ba re re ded nas zos par bsams la gtor: shin tu zab 'di nyid sdig pa che bas gsang zhes gter ma'o// //
